data.jd_text:
Project London is looking for a Senior Architect to join our Dubai studio as we continue to grow our presence in the UAE.
 



  





 You must be based in Dubai
 



  





 We are a London founded architecture, interiors and project management studio, now bringing the same level of process, detail, commercial rigour and client care to Dubai. Our work is primarily high end private residential, including villas, apartments, bespoke new builds, refurbishments and full interior led transformations.
 



 This is a senior role for someone who can combine strong design judgement with technical competence, site confidence and the ability to manage projects properly from concept through to completion. We are looking for someone who understands that good architecture is not just about beautiful images. It is about clear thinking, proper coordination, robust detailing, buildability, budget awareness and protecting the client’s interests throughout.
 



  





 The Role
 



 The Senior Architect will take responsibility for leading architectural design and technical delivery across a range of private residential projects in Dubai. You will work closely with the Director in Dubai, as well as our interiors, project management and procurement teams, external consultants, contractors, suppliers and client teams.
 



 You will be expected to manage projects with confidence, communicate clearly and bring order to complex design and construction processes. The right person will be comfortable working both in the studio and on site, and will have the experience to spot issues before they become problems.
 



 As Project London UAE grows, this role will offer genuine involvement in shaping how the studio operates, how projects are delivered and how we set standards in the Dubai market.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Lead architectural design packages from early concept through to detailed design and construction information.
 



 Prepare and oversee drawings, specifications, schedules and technical documentation.
 



 Develop layouts, spatial planning, elevations, sections, details and coordinated design packages.
 



 Coordinate with interior designers, MEP consultants, structural engineers, landscape designers, contractors and suppliers.
 



 Review consultant and contractor information to ensure quality, accuracy and alignment with the design intent.
 



 Support authority and developer approval processes, including Emaar, Dubai Municipality, Trakhees and relevant community or master developer requirements.
 



 Attend site meetings and carry out site inspections to review workmanship, progress and compliance with the drawings.
 



 Identify design, technical and coordination risks early and propose practical solutions.
 



 Assist with tender documentation, contractor queries and technical clarifications.
 



 Support project managers with programme, sequencing, cost control and client reporting.
 



 Maintain high standards of drawing presentation, technical accuracy and file organisation.
 



 Represent Project London professionally with clients, consultants and contractors.
 



  





 Requirements
 



 Degree in Architecture or equivalent professional qualification.
 



 Minimum 8 to 10 years’ professional experience, ideally with at least some UAE or GCC project experience.
 



 Strong experience in high end residential architecture.
 



 Excellent technical detailing and construction knowledge.
 



 Confident working across concept design, technical design, tender and construction stages.
 



 Good understanding of Dubai authority, developer and community approval processes.
 



 Strong AutoCAD skills are essential.
 



 Confident on site and comfortable challenging contractors when required.
 



 Strong coordination skills across architecture, interiors, MEP, structure and specialist suppliers.
 



 Excellent written and spoken English.
 



 Highly organised, proactive and commercially aware.
 



 Able to manage multiple workstreams without losing sight of detail.
 



 A calm, professional manner with clients and project teams.
 



  





 The Person
 



 We are looking for someone who takes pride in doing things properly. Someone who can bring design sensitivity, technical rigour and a steady hand to fast moving projects.
 



 You should be comfortable working in a growing studio environment, where everyone contributes and where standards matter. This is not a role for someone who wants to hide behind drawings. We need someone who can think, communicate, coordinate and take responsibility.
 



 You will suit the role if you are:
 



 Practical as well as creative.
 



 Detail focused without losing sight of the bigger picture.
 



 Comfortable with clients, consultants and contractors.
 



 Able to bring calm and clarity to complex situations.
 



 Interested in raising standards in the Dubai residential market.
 



  





 Why Join Project London
 



 This is an exciting opportunity to join Project London UAE at an early stage of its growth, while being backed by an established London studio with a strong reputation in high end residential architecture, interiors and project delivery.
 



 You will work closely with the Director in Dubai and have real involvement in the development of the studio, the way projects are delivered, and the standards we set as we grow. This is not a role where you will disappear into a large corporate structure. You will be close to the decision making, close to the clients and close to the work itself.
 



 We are building something carefully in Dubai, not chasing volume for the sake of it. The aim is to deliver exceptional private residential projects with the same rigour, attention to detail and client care our London clients expect.
 



 For the right person, this is a chance to help shape a growing studio, contribute meaningfully from day one and be part of a business with genuine ambition in the UAE market.
 



  





 Package
 



 Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
 



 Full time role based in Dubai.
 



 Immediate or early start preferred.
 



  





 How to Apply
 



 Please send your CV, portfolio and answers to the questions below to:
 



 sm@projectlondon.co.uk
 



 Subject line
 



 Senior Architect Application, Dubai
 



 We would particularly like to see examples of residential projects where you have been involved in technical design, coordination and site delivery, not just concept imagery.
 



  





 Application Questions
 



 Please answer the following four questions when applying. 
 **Anyone who does not answer all four questions will not be considered.** 



1. **Please summarise your relevant experience and explain why you believe you would be a strong fit for this Senior Architect role at Project London UAE. Please include the types of projects you have worked on, your level of responsibility and what you would bring to the team.**
2. **Please describe one completed residential project where you were responsible for taking the design from concept through to technical detailing, tender or site delivery. What was your role, what were the main challenges and what did you personally resolve?**
3. **In Dubai, residential projects often involve tight coordination between architecture, interiors, MEP, structure, authority approvals, contractors and suppliers. Please give an example of where you identified a coordination issue before it became a site problem. How did you handle it?**
4. **Please attach or link to one drawing package, detail sheet or technical example that best represents your own work. Briefly explain what you personally produced and why it demonstrates your suitability for this role.**

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team
* The Plant Director actively champions the adoption of modern manufacturing technologies, operational best practices, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, reliability, and competitiveness.
* The role works closely with cross‑ functional teams to ensure seamless execution, transparent communication, and sustained long‑ term value creation for the business.


**Job Dimensions**
* Number of Staff Supervised: Direct Reports: 8, Total: 340
* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.
* Set and deliver aggressive yet achievable facility goals aligned to long term company strategy.
* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.
* Act as the primary interface with local regulatory authorities (e.g. JAFZA, DCD, Trakhees/EHS).


 Operational Excellence \& Efficiency
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancement initiatives.
* Optimise manufacturing processes, capacity, and asset utilisation in line with the Medium Term Plan.
* Implement flexible workforce models aligned with SOPs and demand variation.


 Quality \& HSE
   

  

* Ensure all products meet or exceed defined quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Embed a strong quality culture and operational discipline across the plant.
* Ensure full compliance with Environmental, Health \& Safety standards


 Financial Performance
   

  

* Manage site profitability, cost control, and budget adherence.
* Lead S\&OP execution to balance demand, capacity, revenue, and customer commitments.
* Optimise inventory levels and drive inventory reduction initiatives.
* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high performing management team.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building across functions.
* Foster a collaborative, performance driven, and values based culture.


 Customer Focus \& Business Excellence
   

  

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
* Promote cross functional collaboration across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and Sales.
* Champion new technologies, digitalisation, and best in class manufacturing practices.


 New Product Introduction

 KPIs
   

  

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* OTIF delivery
* Budget vs. Actual
* Profitability and MPV
* Scrap, rework, and customer complaints
* Inventory turns and cost recovery
* Leadership capability and succession readiness

 The Plant Director operates within a manufacturing environment serving utility, infrastructure, and industrial customers across the Middle East and export markets. The role leads a multi disciplinary operations organisation, overseeing manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, maintenance, and HSE, within a competitive, cost sensitive, and delivery driven market.
   

  

 Reporting to the Manufacturing Operations Director, the role works in close collaboration with regional Sales, Projects, Engineering, Procurement, and corporate functions to align plant capability with customer demand, strategic growth plans, and localisation requirements. The position interfaces regularly with local regulatory and governing bodies in Dubai to ensure compliance, certification, and operational continuity, while balancing operational excellence, people development, and long term business sustainability
   

  

**Qualifications, Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree or above in management, electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering or related fields.
* Understand manufacturing business, people management, supply chain management, financial management, quality management, and innovation.
* Possess experience in middle or senior management minimum of 10\-15 years.


**Job\-Specific Skills**
* Communication
* Values and respects others, Building relationships, Teamwork
* Process Loss Elimination Techniques
* Continuous improvement
* Project Management
* Creative Thinking
* Change Innovation
* Develops others
* Builds successful teams, Supports \& coaches the team
* Consulting skills
* Visionary leadership
* Achieving results, Customer driven
* Critical decision making
* Develops organisation budgets
* Organizational safety
* Financial astuteness
* Broad experience of developing and implementing short to long\-range objectives and strategies to achieve business goals.
* Proven capability of operating successfully at a senior management level.
* Understanding of electrical mechanical design engineering, competence in electrical power engineering.
* Demonstrate financial acumen including planning and cost control capabilities and proven experience of managing projects to budget.
* Proven track record in delivering manufacturing and supply chain best practice
* Strong working ethic in the delivery of satisfying the profitable requirements and expectations of internal and external customers.
* Effectively recognise and manage conflict
* Broad experience of working in a multi\-national, matrix organisation.
* Strong communications and presentation skills.
* Strong English written and verbal communication skills.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Creates strong team \& guiding partner
* Promotes team accountability \& strong sense of understanding

data.jd_text:
**Life at Dubai Future Foundation** 




 Dubai Future Foundation (DFF) aims to realize the vision of Dubai’s leadership, to institutionalize the envisioned future and forward\-thinking methodologies, and positioning Dubai as the leading city of the future. In partnership with its local and global partners from governments, companies, startups, and entrepreneurs, DFF drives joint efforts to collectively imagine, design, and execute the best possible future for humanity.
 



 Under the supervision of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, Chairman of the Executive Council of Dubai, and Chairman of the Board of Trustees of DFF, the DFF runs and oversees many future\-facing projects and initiatives, such as the Museum of the Future, The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE, Dubai Future Accelerators, One Million Arab Coders, Dubai Future Academy, Dubai Future Solutions, Dubai Future Labs, Dubai Future Forum, and more.
 



  





 For more information on the initiatives, projects, and programs of Dubai Future Foundation, please visit the website: www.dubaifuture.ae
 



  





**The UAE World Economic Forum’sCentre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution** 




 The Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution UAE (C4IR UAE) is a collaboration between the Dubai Future Foundation and the World Economic Forum and is the first global affiliate centre having opened in April 2019\.
 



  





 The UAE Centre is hosted by the Dubai Future Foundation and serves as a global public\-private platform for the collaborative development of technology governance and policy research to offer global visibility to 4IR activities in the UAE. As such, each project portfolio works on a global scale, in collaboration with the World Economic Forum teams and C4IR network, and is tailored to the local ecosystem.
 



  





 Previous and ongoing products of the C4IR have included reports on UAE blockchain use cases and implementation toolkit, the AI procurement toolkit, tokenization and digital assets report and proof of concept, a C\-Suite toolkit for AI. The Centre has also hosted Smart Toys Award and has recently published on the impact of AI on creative economies. All published work is available on www.c4ir.ae
 



  





 The C4IR network is a focal point within the international community for multi\-stakeholder dialogue and concrete cooperation on governance challenges and opportunities presented by advanced technologies from the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4IR).
 



  





**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




 The Centre interfaces with senior stakeholders of local and federal government entities across the UAE to support, shape and influence policies associated with 4IR technologies and their impacts on the UAE’s economy and society.
 



  





 The Programme Head will regularly interface with local and regional stakeholders, across the UAE government, along with the CEO and Deputy CEO of the Dubai Future Foundation. She or he will also provide insight and updates to the Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence, Digital Economy, and Remote Work Applications. In addition, the Programme Head will manage the Centre’s Steering Committee and interface regularly with the WEF Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution in San Francisco.
 



  





**Programme Head** 




 The C4IR UAE Programme Head will be responsible for leading the Centre, including developing and implementing the annual strategy, and managing the plans, workflows, budgets, and priorities of the Centre. The Programme Head will also play an active role within the DFF structure and will provide insight and expertise when required.
 



  





**Responsibilities \& Reporting Lines** 




 The Programme Head reports directly to the Executive Director of the Dubai Future Institute within DFF.
 



  





 The Programme Head is a complex and articulated position that holds overall responsibility for managing the Centre, including the following:
 



  





 • Ensure the Centre achieves the highest possible visibility and impact through high\-quality products and key activities.
 



 • Ensure the Centre maintains a healthy pipeline of high\-impact products which shall include research reports, policy reports, proof of conceptwork, development of policy proposals, as well as a range of public\-facing engagements.
 



 • Manage internal and external collaborators, including contractors and network members, of varying seniority, to deliver the expected products.
 



 • Sets clear, ambitious targets, activities and workflows for the team. Provides guidance on associated resources required.
 



 • Will support as needed the core activities of DFF.
 



 • Represent the Centre and DFF at internal, national, and international events.
 



  





**Project Management** 




 • You are responsible for leading the full project cycle including managing budgets, project milestones, coaching and developing the team, setting objectives, monitoring and tracking and post\-project reporting.
 



 • You will brainstorm and work with the team to creatively and critically assess ideas, and evaluate processes that could be re\-engineered to identify future projects for delivery.
 



 • You will delegate and assign tasks to the team to ensure the delivery of project deadlines.
 



 • You will need to openly communicate with team members to ensure that all projects are running smoothly and regularly feed back to the Executive Director – Future, Foresight and Imagination on operations and administration.
 



 Third Party Relationships
 



 • You will be responsible for creating a network of expertise, bringing in new connections with experts that will benefit the organisation and building regional and international relationships.
 



 • You will work closely with other departments and entities to understand, analyse their needs and develop strategic content.
 



 • You will work closely with the Communications team to provide high\-level advice on how to activate research, long\-term planning, allocation resources for projects.
 



 • You will be responsible for initiating and maintaining long\-term relationships with other Dubai Future Foundation/Centre partners while actively looking for ways to collaborate supporting them.
 



  





**Why is this role important?** 




 To achieve the biggest impact you will need to affirm the Centre’s role as a convenor of stakeholders in the 4IR space, inform and shape policy, and support the establishment of the centre as a regional beacon for producing high quality research and action, and ensure the Centre is top\-of\-mind among top decision\-makers in Dubai and the UAE.
 



  





**What does the Dubai Future Foundation offer?** 




 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with passionate people, support shapers of the future as well as work that has an impact, not only on the organization or the UAE but all of humankind.
 



  





 You will have the chance to work on exciting and new projects, work in a highly diverse and fast paced environment that fosters creativity, disruptive ideas and innovation.
 



  





 The Centre Head will have the opportunity to participate in / present at international meetings and gain visibility. These may include participation at the WEF annual meeting in Davos, Global Technology Retreats and other engagements.
 



  





**What does the Dubai Future Foundation offer?** 




 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with passionate people, support shapers of the future as well as work that has an impact, not only on the organization or the UAE but all of humankind.
 



  





 You will have the chance to work on exciting and new projects, work in a highly diverse and fast paced environment that fosters creativity, disruptive ideas and innovation.
 



  





 The Centre Head will have the opportunity to participate in / present at international meetings and gain visibility. These may include participation at the WEF annual meeting in Davos, Global Technology Retreats and other engagements.
 



  





**Who we're looking for?** 




 • You will hold an advanced university degree in economics, emerging technologies, public management, or a related field.
 



 • You will have a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience evidenced in research, policy analysis, including experience in national/international/private sector context, with demonstrated capacity for leading significant projects or programmes, including in policy change/innovation.
 



 • You will have a demonstrated ability to plan, organise and conduct technical and policy analysis/research and programme development.
 



 • You will have a thorough knowledge, understanding and experience in 4IR issues, including Artificial Intelligence, blockchain, digital assets, precision medicine, robotics, genomics, etc.
 



 • You should have an excellent network of experts within your field and have strong relationship development capabilities. A strong national and international network relevant to the scope of the Centre will be an important addition.
 



 • You should have a demonstrated history of leading and managing strong performing teams in your previous roles.
 



 • You will be a team player and be generous with sharing your knowledge, supporting the Centre/Dubai Future Foundation team and creating content as well as professional development opportunities.
 



 • You provide evidence of attention to detail, persistence and creativity.
 



 • You are well\-versed in research publication processes.
 



 • You will be fluent in English \& Arabic.

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:**




 To lead exhibition and sponsorship sales delivery for AixEnergy Asia 2026, owning the commercial pipeline end\-to\-end and converting it into contracted revenue against the budget target. The Commercial Director carries an individual revenue number, manages the AixEnergy agent network, and works alongside the VP to close exhibition packages, sponsorship inventory, and feature areas. The role is the senior commercial operator on the AixEnergy team and is accountable for the Year 1 close and the Year 2 rebooking pipeline captured on\-site plus any additional AixEnergy edition launches.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:**




 Own the AixEnergy Asia 2026 exhibition and sponsorship pipeline end\-to\-end: prospecting, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and contract close. Carry an individual revenue target and report progress weekly against the Revenue Pathway forecast.
 



 Open and convert priority accounts across hyperscalers, data centre operators, energy and utility companies, EPCs, industrial real estate developers, and AI infrastructure vendors. Build credible peer\-level relationships with senior commercial decision\-makers and convert verbal interest into signed contracts.
 



  





 Manage and grow the AixEnergy agent network. Set agent targets, brief on pricing and proposition, and quality\-control agent\-sourced leads before they enter the AixEnergy pipeline.
 



 Work on sponsorship sales to convert sponsorship inventory: title partner, strategic partners, theatre and feature sponsorships, and on\-site activations.
 



  





 Maintain Salesforce hygiene to dmg events standard: every opportunity logged, staged, weighted, and updated weekly. Provide accurate weekly forecasts to the VP and into the WSR (Weekly Sales Report) cadence, with clear flags on slipped, won, and at\-risk deals.
 



  





 Maintain working knowledge of the AI infrastructure and energy markets: track competitor events, pricing benchmarks, exhibitor movements, and account\-level developments that affect AixEnergy's pipeline and pricing. Feed market intelligence back into the proposition and the floor plan.
 



 Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance to ensure the commercial pipeline is fed, supported, and delivered. Brief Marketing on priority targets and EDM cadence; align with Operations on floor plan, build, and exhibitor delivery; coordinate with Finance on contracting, invoicing, and collections.
 



  





 Deliver a strong on\-site rebooking result for AixEnergy 2027, including target rebooking rate (40%\+) by end of show, signed Letters of Intent for 2027, and a qualified Year 2 pipeline document handed to the team within 30 days of the close of the 2026 edition.
 



  





**Job Context:**




 AixEnergy Asia 2026 is a launch\-edition event. The Commercial Director is joining at a critical phase of the cycle and is expected to close the gap to budget through direct sales, agent activation, and conversion of the existing pipeline. The event is co\-located with Gastech 2026 in Bangkok but operates as a standalone product with its own P\&L, exhibition, sponsorship inventory, and conference. The Commercial Director reports to the VP ADIPEC \& Business Development and works alongside the Operations Director, the Marketing Director and the Head of Content. The role requires a senior operator capable of working independently in an early\-stage commercial environment, holding peer\-level conversations with hyperscale and energy executives, and delivering against a hard September 2026 close.
 



  





**Qualifications, Experience, \& Skills:**




 Technical / Functional: Minimum 7 years senior B2B exhibition and sponsorship sales experience, with a track record of personally carrying and delivering revenue targets in excess of US$1m. Demonstrable success selling at a senior, peer\-level into AI infrastructure, data centres, energy, utilities, or industrial sectors. Experience launching first\-edition events strongly preferred. Working knowledge of Salesforce or equivalent CRM is essential. Familiarity with ASEAN markets, particularly Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia, is an advantage. Experience working with sales agents and channel partners. Understanding of how exhibition, sponsorship, and conference content combine into a single commercial proposition. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
 



  





 Personal Attributes / Interpersonal: Senior commercial presence; comfortable holding peer\-level conversations with hyperscale procurement leads, energy company executives, and EPC commercial directors. Closer’s instinct: identifies the path to contract early and drives the deal to signature. Self\-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate effectively in a launch\-phase environment without established processes or large team support. Resilient under pressure; comfortable with hard targets, weekly forecast scrutiny, and a non\-negotiable September 2026 close. Disciplined with CRM hygiene and forecast accuracy. Collaborative across Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance; treats the pipeline as a shared commercial asset. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Willing to travel internationally as required, including to Bangkok ahead of and during the September 2026 event.
 



  





**dmg events is an equal opportunity employer. If you have not had feedback from us within 14 days, please consider your application as unsuccessful for this round.**

 Maintain working knowledge of the AI infrastructure and energy markets: track competitor events, pricing benchmarks, exhibitor movements, and account\-level developments that affect AixEnergy's pipeline and pricing. Feed market intelligence back into the proposition and the floor plan.
   

  

 Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance to ensure the commercial pipeline is fed, supported, and delivered. Brief Marketing on priority targets and EDM cadence; align with Operations on floor plan, build, and exhibitor delivery; coordinate with Finance on contracting, invoicing, and collections.
   

  

 Deliver a strong on\-site rebooking result for AixEnergy 2027, including target rebooking rate (40%\+) by end of show, signed Letters of Intent for 2027, and a qualified Year 2 pipeline document handed to the team within 30 days of the close of the 2026 edition.
   

  

**Job Context**
 AixEnergy Asia 2026 is a launch\-edition event. The Commercial Director is joining at a critical phase of the cycle and is expected to close the gap to budget through direct sales, agent activation, and conversion of the existing pipeline. The event is co\-located with Gastech 2026 in Bangkok but operates as a standalone product with its own P\&L, exhibition, sponsorship inventory, and conference. The Commercial Director reports to the VP ADIPEC \& Business Development and works alongside the Operations Director, the Marketing Director and the Head of Content. The role requires a senior operator capable of working independently in an early\-stage commercial environment, holding peer\-level conversations with hyperscale and energy executives, and delivering against a hard September 2026 close.
   

  

**Qualifications, Experience, \& Skills**
 Technical / Functional: Minimum 7 years senior B2B exhibition and sponsorship sales experience, with a track record of personally carrying and delivering revenue targets in excess of US$1m. Demonstrable success selling at a senior, peer\-level into AI infrastructure, data centres, energy, utilities, or industrial sectors. Experience launching first\-edition events strongly preferred. Working knowledge of Salesforce or equivalent CRM is essential. Familiarity with ASEAN markets, particularly Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia, is an advantage. Experience working with sales agents and channel partners. Understanding of how exhibition, sponsorship, and conference content combine into a single commercial proposition. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
   

  

 Personal Attributes / Interpersonal: Senior commercial presence; comfortable holding peer\-level conversations with hyperscale procurement leads, energy company executives, and EPC commercial directors. Closer’s instinct: identifies the path to contract early and drives the deal to signature. Self\-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate effectively in a launch\-phase environment without established processes or large team support. Resilient under pressure; comfortable with hard targets, weekly forecast scrutiny, and a non\-negotiable September 2026 close. Disciplined with CRM hygiene and forecast accuracy. Collaborative across Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance; treats the pipeline as a shared commercial asset. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Willing to travel internationally as required, including to Bangkok ahead of and during the September 2026 event.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking an accomplished Director – Major Projects \& Infrastructure to lead the strategic planning and delivery of major transport and infrastructure design programmes across the Middle East. This senior leadership role is responsible for portfolio performance, client engagement, operational oversight, and technical governance across complex multi\-disciplinary projects, ensuring high\-quality delivery, strong commercial outcomes, and trusted relationships with key government and private\-sector stakeholders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring proven experience leading large\-scale highways, transport, and integrated infrastructure programmes, with the credibility to operate at executive level across clients, authorities, delivery teams, and business leadership.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Leadership \& Strategy**
* Provide strategic leadership for a portfolio of major transport and infrastructure programmes, aligning delivery priorities with business objectives, client needs, and regional market opportunities.
* Shape market positioning and support business growth through key account development, pursuit strategy, proposal leadership, and executive\-level client engagement.
* Establish clear governance, decision\-making frameworks, and performance expectations across programmes to support consistent, high\-quality delivery.
* Represent the business externally with clients, partners, and industry stakeholders, strengthening market profile and helping secure future opportunities.
* Work closely with peers and the broader leadership team in an effective and collaborative manner.


**Project \& Programme Management**
* Lead the delivery of major transport and infrastructure projects from concept through detailed design and construction support, ensuring programmes are structured, resourced, and governed effectively.
* Own programme performance against schedule, budget, margin, cash flow, and quality targets, with clear accountability for forecasting, financial control, and overall portfolio health.
* Drive programme controls including risk management, change control, reporting, KPI monitoring, schedule assurance, and recovery planning across multi\-package and multi\-stakeholder environments.
* Oversee resource planning and coordination across multi\-disciplinary teams to maintain delivery efficiency and effective interface management.


**Client \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key clients, government authorities, and strategic partners across the region, including ministries, commissions, municipalities, and major development entities.
* Act as the senior client interface for major programmes, leading executive discussions, resolving complex issues, and maintaining confidence in delivery performance and commercial outcomes.
* Oversee stakeholder coordination and authority engagement, including support for approvals, permitting, and resolution of issues affecting programme progress.


**Technical Excellence**
* Provide technical leadership across engineering solutions, mobility strategies, and design methodologies, ensuring that projects are innovative, practical, and aligned with client objectives.
* Ensure robust technical assurance and compliance with international standards, local authority requirements, design safety obligations, and organisational quality systems.
* Champion digital engineering, BIM, model\-based delivery, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, efficiency, and consistency across programmes.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and inspire high\-performing multi\-disciplinary teams, setting clear expectations for delivery, collaboration, and professional standards.
* Build organisational capability through effective resource planning, performance management, knowledge sharing, and development of specialist and leadership talent.
* Support recruitment, succession planning, and retention strategies to strengthen long\-term capability across the transport and infrastructure business.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* 20\+ years of experience delivering major transport and infrastructure projects, with at least 10 years in the Middle East.
* Proven leadership experience on mega‑projects such as highways programmes, mobility corridors, rail/metro interfaces, smart mobility projects, and integrated infrastructure developments.
* Strong background in multi‑disciplinary design management, including roads, highways, bridges and utilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large consultant and contractor teams within complex programme environments, with strong capability in resource planning, delivery oversight, and interface management.
* Excellent knowledge of international and regional codes, design standards, and approval processes.
* Sound understanding of design safety, HSE leadership, regulatory compliance, and authority approvals processes across major infrastructure programmes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and client‑facing skills with experience engaging with ministries and major authorities.
* Strong commercial and contractual acumen, including experience with bid leadership, consultancy frameworks, contract strategy, procurement interfaces, change management, and programme financial performance.
* Experience managing programme performance through governance, reporting, KPIs, and executive\-level decision\-making in high\-profile delivery environments.
* Experience working with large engineering consultancies on high\-profile regional projects.
* Chartered/Professional Engineer status (CEng, PE, PEng, etc.) is highly desirable.

**Where identity, money, and movement connect.** 




  





**MISSION** 




 As a Technical Project Manager, Payments your mission is to successfully plan, execute, and deliver projects while ensuring adherence to scope, timeline, budget, and quality standards. **Location:** 
 Dubai, United Arab Emirates

 We are seeking an experienced Human Resources Director to lead the HR function for a growing construction business based in Dubai. This role will focus heavily on talent acquisition, workforce planning, compensation and benefits strategy, and building scalable HR frameworks to support project\-based operations across the UAE and wider region.
 



 The HR Director will act as a strategic partner to executive leadership, ensuring the organisation attracts, develops, and retains top\-tier talent while maintaining compliance with UAE labour laws and industry regulations.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
 


* Develop and implement a comprehensive talent acquisition strategy aligned with business growth and project pipeline demands.
* Lead high\-volume recruitment across technical, engineering, project management, and corporate functions.
* Build strong talent pipelines for critical construction roles (e.g., project directors, engineers, quantity surveyors, site managers).

 2\. Compensation \& Benefits
 


* Design and implement competitive compensation and benefits frameworks aligned with market benchmarks in the UAE construction industry.
* Lead salary benchmarking exercises and ensure internal equity across roles and geographies.
* Develop incentive schemes linked to project performance and business outcomes.
* Oversee benefits administration including health insurance, allowances, bonuses, and expatriate packages.
* Ensure compliance with WPS (Wage Protection System) and UAE Labour Law requirements.



 3\. HR Strategy \& Leadership
 


* Develop and execute the overall HR strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Establish HR policies, procedures, and governance frameworks suitable for a project\-driven environment.
* Lead organisational design initiatives to support business expansion.
* Provide strategic counsel to senior leadership on people\-related matters.



 4\. Employee Relations \& Compliance
 


* Ensure full compliance with UAE Labour Law and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee employee relations matters including disciplinary processes and conflict resolution.
* Develop retention and engagement strategies to reduce turnover across site\-based and corporate employees.



 5\. Performance Management \& Development

* Support leadership development and succession planning initiatives.
* Promote a culture of accountability, safety, and high performance.



  





 Candidate Profile
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).

* Proven experience designing compensation and benefits frameworks in the UAE market.
* In\-depth knowledge of UAE Labour Law and HR compliance requirements.
* Experience managing multi\-site or geographically dispersed workforces.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

 To manage the regional Cx Team and in certain instances Lead / Supervise the entire commissioning process on specific sites including all commissioning contractual deliverables and JEG QSP documentation. Coordinate with all departments to ensure a smooth handover from construction through to commissioning and client handover, including extensive follow\-up with contractors, vendors and the client site team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Direct line of report \- Operational – Operations Director / Site Specific – Project Director


**Functional Duties**
* Review the active / tender projects portfolio scope of works and identify the correct structure and team required to deliver the projects and incorporate them into the overall Projects Organograms.
* Ensure that all Cx team staff levels are adequate, manage recruitment and function overhead as required to ensure the Cx Team manpower is always at optimum levels and skilled as required
* Identify skill deficiencies in Cx team members and manage training development plans to ensure all team members are upskilled and certified as applicable for assigned tasks.
* Manage and coordinate with project specific site Cx Teams to ensure all sites are utilizing standard JEG reporting documentation and complying with JEG company SOP’s / site and client specific documentation to be utilized as required.
* Ensure all items / actions as defined below in “Specific Site Duties” are actioned via the assigned Cx Leads and associated teams if not directly assigned to manage directly.
* Commercial input regarding Cx budgets set for projects and functional operations as directed.
* Review and coordination with QA/QC Leads and ensure QA/QC requirements are identified for implementation
* In coordination with site MEP Leads ensure correct codes, standards, job specifications, project procedures, local mandatory regulations are properly identified, correctly specified in detail, and met or exceeded
* Ensure Electrical and Mechanical installation teams maintain standards in accordance with the approved Method Statements, Technical Orders/Manuals and ISO Standards as applicable.
* Close coordination and oversight with Divisional Authorizing Engineer and site SAP’s / AP’s as applicable.
* Assist with ensuring that the quality management system (QMS) is fully implemented in an organized and efficient manner whilst working closely with related engineering, construction, fabrication and commissioning departments.
* Provide support as requested for Method Statement preparation and client presentations as required.
* Prepare overall Project Executive Summary Reports and attend weekly meetings as required for progress updates on projects
* Escalate to Line Manager any issues arising that may affect project schedule or project execution plans.
* Advancing quality achievement and performance improvement throughout the project
* Coordination with ALL vendors for documentation (RAMS, ITP’s, Red Line Drawings, L2 \& L3 Start Up Scripts, SAT)
* Plan Mobilization Dates and Resources for 3rd Party vendors and Commissioning Contractors in coordination with the Project Controls Lead.
* Plan and Manage the Testing \& Balancing Team activities.
* Assist Design Team in developing the Equipment Tagging Register for Equipment Labelling (Traffolyte / SS)
* Coordination of vendors/engineering for all inter connections between packages (HW \& SW)
* Liaise with the QA/QC Inspectors for progress updates during the installation process.
* Liaise closely with the ELV Lead for BMS readiness, per package as per the commissioning program.
* Manage the QA/QC snagging list and ensure follow up of closures with the Construction Managers, not to delay the commissioning schedule.
* Prepare and distribute a Commissioning Issues Log independently to the Internal MEP snag list during the Commissioning Phase. (FAT à L2 à L3 à SAT à IST)
* Manage closely the static testing of MV \& LV power cabling, ensuring the installation adheres to approved drawings. Any “To/From” deviations to be escalated immediately.
* Prepare and issue a weekly Commissioning Dashboard report in coordination with the Project Controls Lead.
* Prepare and issue a 2\-week static and pre\-functional testing look ahead program in coordination with the Project Controls Lead \- To be updated and issued on a weekly basis.


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Time served apprenticeship an advantage.
* Electrical, Mechanical, Instrumentation Engineer
* Minimum 15 years work experience on construction projects.
* Qualifications commensurate with position:
* Role applicable degree from a reputed university / Trade Qualifications NVQ, etc.
* Experience in Data Centre Projects min 5 years.
* Equipment category specific training
* LOTO Experience Responsible Person (REP)
* Competent in the use of PC applications (Microsoft Office suit or equivalent).

This role is critical to ensuring the Director stays organized, informed, and efficient across all business priorities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, and proactive—capable of managing time independently and staying focused in a fast\-paced environment. You should have a proven track record supporting executives or business leaders, with strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to resolve issues quickly with minimal supervision.
   

  

 This position involves leading the execution of business initiatives through smooth project management, client coordination, and proactive lead generation. You will oversee key commercial opportunities from initial prospecting to final delivery, ensuring each project aligns with the Talent’s annual strategic goals. This includes managing timelines, structuring workflows, following up on action items, and keeping internal teams aligned throughout the project lifecycle. You will also serve as a key link between the Business Director, Talent, and external partners, ensuring clear communication and timely execution at every stage.
   

  

 Success in this role requires excellent time management, flexibility under pressure, and a consistent ability to prioritize competing demands while delivering high\-quality support.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead Generation and Updates
+ Identify potential leads using the internal screening process and follow up within 48 hours.
+ Proactively track all leads and projects to ensure timely follow\-ups, next steps, and update them on Monday.com.

* Business Development \& Negotiation
+ Filter, research, and meet with qualified prospects before escalating to the BD.
+ Coordinate deal negotiations, review contract terms, and ensure they align with internal standards.
+ Promptly respond to external emails including fans, prospects, gifts, PR, and podcast requests.

* Project Management \& Campaign Oversight
+ Create project scopes, objectives, and KPIs in alignment with each brand deal.
+ Develop and track detailed task plans to ensure timely, on\-budget delivery.
+ Oversee deliverables, logistics, quality control, and cross\-functional communication.
+ Maintain ownership of all project logistics (with assistant support), ensuring execution remains fully aligned with signed contract terms.
+ Perform risk management to anticipate and reduce project risks.
+ Deliver post\-campaign ROI and performance reports with internal data support.

* Client \& Talent Coordination
+ Maintain and update the media deck monthly in collaboration with the social/branding team.
+ Coordinate talent involvement in campaigns, ensuring on\-time content delivery.
+ Organize events, logistics, and ensure smooth communication between BD and internal departments.

* Contract \& Financial Oversight
+ Review, flag, and help finalize contracts; ensure proper documentation and filing.
+ Liaise with Finance for payment follow\-ups and ensure timely invoicing and collections.
+ Store all agreements securely in Google Drive and maintain accurate tracking.

* Operational Reporting \& Communication
+ Maintain up\-to\-date information in Monday.com and CRM.
+ Provide timely reports, insights, and summaries to the BD.
+ Respond swiftly to urgent WhatsApp or email requests and help the BD stay on track with all priorities.
+ Prioritize conflicting needs and manage multiple projects simultaneously with a focus on deadlines and quality.
+ Constantly improve workflows and templates for smarter execution.


**What You’ll Need**
* 
+ Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
+ 5–7 years of experience in client management, brand partnerships, business development, or project execution.
+ Strong project management and organizational skills.
+ Ability to manage work under pressure independently and with flexibility.
+ Excellent time management, prioritization, and multitasking skills.
+ High emotional intelligence and openness to constructive feedback.
+ Strong writing and speaking skills.
+ Resourcefulness and ability to problem\-solve quickly in high\-stakes situations.


**Skills Required**
* Project Management:
+ Define scopes, KPIs, timelines, and budgets
+ Track detailed project plans and daily tasks
+ Mitigate risks and ensure timely, high\-quality delivery
+ Deliver post\-campaign reports with insights and results

* Communication \& Coordination:
+ Liaise with prospects, partners, and internal teams
+ Ensure seamless coordination between BD, Finance, Creative, and Talent
+ Own all project updates and communication channels

* Contracts \& Compliance:
+ Review and track contracts
+ Flag legal or operational concerns
+ Ensure proper archiving and contract lifecycle management

* Tools \& Tech:
+ Proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), Monday.com
+ CRM/database upkeep
+ Familiarity with media deck creation and reporting templates


**﻿You’ll Love This Job If You Are**
* 
+ Strongly organized, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple fast\-moving pieces at once.
+ A confident communicator with excellent written and verbal English (Arabic is a plus).
+ Naturally proactive, with a high sense of ownership and the ability to work independently.
+ Someone who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, client\-facing environment.
+ Emotionally mature, discreet with confidential information, and deeply reliable.
+ Comfortable working directly with C\-level leaders, clients, and creative teams.
+ A forward\-thinking professional who brings ideas, solutions, and accountability.

data.jd_text:
A Technical Project Manager within PRG’s Middle East operations is responsible for a wide range of deliverables across our music, corporate, large\-scale special events and sports sectors. The individual is client facing and will need to be creative and resourceful to be successful in a role that services those clients, both regionally and globally, be they production agencies, promoters, tour management, event organizers or corporate entities.
   

  

 Our Project Managers are responsible for full commercial, logistical and technical production of their events with a clear focus on fiscal/margin control. The role is challenging, and the successful candidate must have a good understanding of the technical delivery environment, possessing excellent communication skills, commercial awareness, people management skills and technical knowledge.
   

  

**The team members typically have a mix of the following skills or experience**
* Ability to support the development of presentation material to submit bids or quotes.
* A knowledge base that will support the preparation or detailed equipment specifications from a client brief or drawings/visuals provided.
* Experience in CAD and/or ability to work from drawings.
* Sufficient awareness or knowledge in the preparation of power calculations, power distribution and cable specifications.
* Commercial awareness.
* Experience in obtaining quotations and raising LPO’s for sub hires of project related equipment.
* Ability and experience in working with the team to ensure Health \& Safety standards are met on site.
* Working knowledge to contribute to maintain rigging standards, including load calculations and the application/monitoring of such installations on site.
* Aptitude to collaborate with the department leads to facilitate the development and circulation of system schematics and working drawings.


**Required Competencies**
* Proven track record within the live events industry, specifically in audio, lighting, rigging \& video.
* 5\+ year’s previous experience in a similar role is essential.
* Demonstrable ability to prepare a technical proposal to a customer’s outline specification against budget.
* Strong negotiating skills.
* Excellent communication skills \- both verbal and written.
* Hold a current health and safety qualification IOSH or equivalent is desirable.
* Excellent customer facing and interpersonal skills.
* Strong networking skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong customer relations.
* Excellent computer skills including all Microsoft Office applications with experience creating drawings using CAD / Vectorworks programs.
* Experience using equipment rental software is an advantage.
* Comprehensive understanding of the Company’s product range and procedures.
* A good understanding of electrical safety at work and safe working practices.
* Competent in the translation of data from specifications and plans.
* High degree of numeracy and literacy, with a disciplined approach to attention to detail.
* Ability to work as part of a team and interact with a diverse peer group in a deadline driven environment.
* Ability to work to your own initiative and have clear goals and personal objectives.
* Financial awareness and business acumen.
* Ability to prioritize and cope with a demanding workload.
* Willingness to travel to other PRG locations and venues when required.
* Prepared to work additional hours when necessary.
* Positive attitude to extra duties and new challenges.
* Ability to understand and comply with the Company’s Health and Safety Rules.
* Ability to follow and undertake safe lifting practices as instructed.
* Reliable with a good time keeping record.
* Full clean driving license is essential.


**Core Responsibilities**
**Health \& Safety** 
 Ability to maintain a safe, clean and hazard\-free environment and understand and comply with the Company’s Health and Safety Rules. Ensure any issues are reported accordingly.
   

  

**Communication** 
 Ability to follow and constructively work alongside others as required, contributing towards team efficiency and the betterment of the business.
   

  

**Attitude** 
 A positive attitude gets the work done and motivates others to do the same without dwelling on the challenges that inevitably come up in the job. A positive attitude is something that is most valued by supervisors and co\-workers, and that also makes the job more pleasant and fun to go to each day.
   

  

**Reliability** 
 You can simply be counted on to do whatever job.
   

  

**Adhere to reasonable management instruction** 
 Ensure that the Company’s policies, rules, procedures and obligations are observed in carrying out the above duties.
   

  

 The above list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be exhaustive. Employees are expected to adopt additional tasks when required. These tasks will be in keeping with the general profile of the role.
   

  

**Pre\-production**
* Field incoming enquiries and ensure an accurate brief is obtained, developing a comprehensive understanding of the client’s project requirements.
* Develop and present to the client a commercial response in line with the Company’s pricing policy and expected financial performance.
* Provide our clients with all areas of project management support and technical guidance, including technical and equipment specifications, logistics solutions, scheduling and 3rd party provisions within the scope of our delivery.
* Technical management of all elements of projects undertaken including lighting, rigging, video, audio and scenic elements.
* Prepare and collate detailed method statements, risk assessments and any other on\-site Health and Safety documentation.
* Attend production and site meetings as required.
* Manage and/or oversee project cashflow, procurement, variations/change orders whilst adhering to the Company’s credit control policies.
* Construct/amend suitable contract terms and work these through to invoicing by collating and reporting change orders, agreeing and monitoring payment terms and reporting requirements to the Company’s management.
* Budget for, and manage, sub\-hired equipment, freelancers and other brought\-in items against the project budget as established in the agreed contract.
* Book equipment on the Company equipment rental software system, Winhits, ensuring ship/return dates and equipment transfers are accurate, updating any changes in a timely fashion. Liaise with the Operations department and Head of Departments (HOD’s) to ensure that they are kept up to date.
* Assist with and facilitate client demos and programming sessions.


**Pre \& Onsite**
* Brief the Technical staff with the elements of the show and supply a hard copy of the proposal/brief. This is to include rig and de\-rig times, layout of set/room, rehearsal times, show times, refreshment times, contact names and telephone numbers of venue and client and individual crew responsibilities on site.
* Supervise show build/installation on site.
* Be the point of contact for show specific support, ensuring customer requirements whilst onsite are fulfilled.
* Be aware and comply with the Company’s Health and Safety Policy and Codes of Practice.
* Ensure crew are adhering to the dress standards set by the company or client and that Health and Safety standards are met at all times in terms of PPE.
* Supervise any freelance staff who are working on site on our behalf.
* Liaise with other contractors or sub\-contractors employed by Client to ensure that their show element is correctly integrated and on schedule.
* Attend each event that you are directly involved with and liaise with the client on site in order to deliver a high\-quality event for them.


**Off Site**
* Attend and participate in the Company’s weekly meetings.
* Keep up to date with PRG’s policies, products and services.
* Ensure at all times the confidentiality of information relating to PRG or its clients, projects or personal staff information.
* Ensure, that the Company’s policies, rules, procedures and obligations are observed in carrying out the above duties.
* Represent the interests of PRG as a group and its regional operation throughout the delivery process.

data.jd_text:
We're a Dubai\-based IT solutions studio specialising in structured cabling, enterprise networking, AV integration, CCTV, access control, cybersecurity, and full IT fit\-out delivery.
 



 Our clients include financial institutions, private equity offices, family offices, real estate developers, and professional services firms across the UAE.
 



  





 We operate as a senior\-engineer studio, not a volume contractor.
 



 Every project is led by experienced engineers, and our reputation is built on precision, technical depth, and trusted client relationships.
 



  





 We're hiring a Sales Manager to build our commercial function from the ground up.
 



 You'll design and execute the sales strategy, recruit and develop a team of three Sales Executives, and take full ownership of pipeline growth across project\-based and managed service revenue streams.
 



  





 You'll report directly to the Managing Director and play a central role in shaping the next phase of the company's growth.
 



  





**Expectations** 




 → Build and lead a sales team of three, defining territories, vertical specialisations, and individual KPIs
 



 → Own the full sales cycle — from outbound prospecting through to contract signature
 



 → Develop pipeline across structured cabling, AV, networking, CCTV, access control, and managed IT services
 



 → Implement CRM processes and forecasting disciplines to track pipeline health and conversion
 



 → Drive outbound activity via LinkedIn, email sequences, industry events, and direct engagement
 



 → Build a referral network across fit\-out contractors, MEP consultants, and facilities management companies
 



 → Identify cross\-sell and upsell opportunities — turning project wins into recurring managed service contracts
 



 → Represent OPS IT at industry events and networking opportunities across Dubai and Abu Dhabi
 



  





**Your Team** 




 You'll recruit and develop three Sales Executives, each with a defined focus:
 



  





 1\. Projects \& Fit\-Outs — new\-build and fit\-out opportunities through contractor partnerships and construction announcements
 



 2\. Enterprise \& Managed Services — recurring revenue through IT support contracts and network monitoring agreements
 



 3\. Financial Services \& Regulated Sectors — DIFC and ADGM corridors, targeting PE offices, family offices, and regulated entities
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 • 5\+ years of B2B sales experience, with at least 2 years leading or managing a sales team
 



 • Track record of hitting revenue targets in the UAE market
 



 • Experience selling IT infrastructure, technology solutions, AV, or related services to commercial clients
 



 • Proven ability to recruit and develop high\-performing salespeople
 



 • Strong understanding of the UAE commercial real estate, construction, and fit\-out landscape
 



 • Proficiency with CRM platforms and sales enablement tools
 



 • Excellent English communication skills — Arabic is a strong advantage
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 • Existing network among facilities managers, IT managers, and procurement teams in the UAE
 



 • Experience selling into regulated sectors (DIFC, ADGM, healthcare)
 



 • Familiarity with Apollo.io, HubSpot, or similar outbound platforms
 



 • Conversational understanding of networking, structured cabling, or AV technologies
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 • Competitive base salary \+ performance\-based commission tied to team revenue
 



 • Company vehicle or vehicle allowance
 



 • Mobile phone
 



 • Medical insurance
 



 • Direct line to the Managing Director — no layers, no bureaucracy

 At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration
data.jd_text:
**About the Company** 




  





  





 At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration. From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time. Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues. The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.



  









**Qualifications** 




  





  




* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management.
* Demonstrated management and project management skills.



  









**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy.
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection.
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority.
* Excellent professional image/presentation.
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style.
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills.
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio.
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.



  





  





 Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered. Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.

Executive Opportunity: Head of Regional Sales (MEA)
 



  





 Zenith Technologies
 



 Location: Riyadh, KSA based
 



 Start Date: Immediate
 



 ⸻
 



 About Zenith
 



  





 Zenith Technologies, founded in Melbourne and established across Australasia and the Middle East, is a recognized leader in Homeland Security, Intelligence Systems, and Advanced Security Technologies.
 



  





 For over 15 years, Zenith has partnered with governments, ministries of interior, defense organizations, and elite law enforcement agencies to deliver end\-to\-end mission\-critical solutions that fuse physical, digital, and cyber domains. Our solutions are engineered entirely in\-house, giving us unmatched flexibility to innovate, customize, and deliver at scale.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Our Portfolio
 



  





 Zenith’s portfolio reflects a track record of world\-first innovations and proprietary platforms that transform how governments and agencies secure their nations. Key domains include:
 



 • Intelligent Mobility \& Enforcement Systems – including the world’s first AI\-powered Intelligent Lightbar, combining ANPR, live data analytics, communications, and edge AI for real\-time enforcement and situational command.
 



 • Next\-Generation ANPR \& Video Analytics – advanced fixed, mobile, and covert platforms enabling real\-time vehicle intelligence, threat detection, and multi\-domain data correlation.
 



 • AI\-Powered Data Fusion \& Analytics – proprietary platforms that ingest and integrate structured and unstructured data streams, delivering actionable intelligence and predictive insights to decision\-makers at speed.
 



 • Open\-Source Intelligence (OSINT) \& Social Media Monitoring – cutting\-edge solutions for live monitoring, deep\-data correlation, and AI\-enhanced threat intelligence across open sources, social media, and digital ecosystems.
 



 • Command \& Control Solutions – scalable, integrated C4i platforms enabling strategic oversight, rapid response, and mission\-critical decision\-making across multiple agencies.
 



 • Cyber\-Physical Security Integration – bridging digital and physical domains to deliver end\-to\-end national security resilience against emerging threats.
 



  





 Zenith’s unique strength lies in IP ownership and in\-house R\&D, enabling us to deploy fully integrated ecosystems rather than fragmented systems — a decisive advantage in the Homeland Security, National Resilience, and Law Enforcement sectors.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 The Role
 



  





 Zenith is seeking a Head of Regional Sales (MEA) to drive strategic expansion across the GCC, with primary focus on the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
 



  





 Reporting directly to the Group CEO, this executive will lead Zenith’s market growth, government engagement, and multimillion\-dollar program delivery across one of the world’s most dynamic security environments.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Key Accountabilities
 



 • Define and execute regional sales strategy aligned with Zenith’s growth objectives.
 



 • Lead high\-level engagements with Ministries of Interior, law enforcement, and homeland security agencies across KSA and GCC.
 



 • Manage full lifecycle: pipeline development, bid and proposal management, high\-stakes negotiation, and closure of complex projects.
 



 • Build, lead, and inspire a high\-performing regional sales force.
 



 • Establish and deepen strategic alliances with leading system integrators and security partners.
 



 • Deliver strong commercial outcomes while ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and market leadership.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 • 10\+ years in senior sales leadership within Homeland Security, Security Technology, or Defense.
 



 • Minimum 5 years of demonstrable success in the GCC, with direct experience engaging KSA MOI.
 



 • Proven track record in structuring and closing multimillion\-dollar government security contracts.
 



 • Strong professional networks across security, defense, and law enforcement communities in the region.
 



 • Master’s degree (Business or Engineering), MBA preferred.
 



 • Fluent in both Arabic and English.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 What Zenith Offers
 



  





 This is a high\-impact executive mandate within one of the most respected innovation\-driven players in the homeland security sector. Zenith offers:
 



 • Attractive executive package (base \+ commission).
 



 • Opportunity to shape national\-level security transformation.
 



 • A platform to operate at the intersection of AI, intelligence, and homeland security innovation in one of the fastest growing regions globally.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Submit your CV (PDF/Word) to employment@zenith.com.au
 



 Subject line: “Head of Regional Sales (MEA) – \[Your Name]”
 



  





 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 noon’s mission: Every door, every day.

 Oversee daily production operations in the cold kitchen facility, ensuring production targets are met while maintaining food safety standards. data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Electrical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data centre projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in electrical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in electrical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre electrical systems, including power distribution architectures (N, N\+1, 2N, 2N\+1 configurations), medium voltage and low voltage distribution, UPS systems (static, rotary, modular), generator plants and fuel systems, automatic transfer switches, power monitoring systems, busway and busduct design, and distributed and block redundancy topologies for mission critical environments
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, short circuit analysis, arc flash analysis, protection coordination studies, voltage drop calculations, power quality analysis for mission\-critical facilities, as well as earthing and lightning protection system design
* Experience with high voltage substations and utility power infrastructure, including substation design, switchgear selection and layout, transformer sizing and specification, utility coordination, power purchase agreements, and grid connection requirements for small to large\-scale data centre campuses
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant electrical engineering standards, including IEEE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, BS standards, and Uptime Institute Tier topology requirements
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**General Expectations**
* Lead electrical systems design for data centre and mission critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including power distribution systems (HV, MV, LV), UPS configurations, generator plants, emergency power systems, lighting, grounding, and lightning protection
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data center owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between electrical, mechanical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement
* Represent the Mission Critical department in senior\-level client meetings, industry forums, and strategic planning discussions
