data.jd_text:
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life\-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
   

  

 The Senior Director Ethics \& Compliance, KSA is responsible for leading the integration of high performance with high integrity in Lilly KSA. The role will partner with the KSA Management Team, the ICH, IBU and Global E\&C Teams, and relevant business partners to implement the Global 7 elements E\&C Program and cultivate a Speak up Culture in KSA. The role requires working with the E\&C Manager in KSA and other affiliate functions to provide expert Ethics and Compliance guidance on affiliate strategies, decisions and activities. (including risk assessment, policies, communications, training, monitoring, etc.) in a way that effectively supports the affiliate risk management and identifying areas to improve business systems based on monitoring findings and business needs. This position is expected to have regular interactions with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with ethics and compliance objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 E\&C Program Management:
   

  

* Collaborate/consult and influence leadership to ensure the key elements of an effective compliance program are built into local governance and decision forums, business and operational processes, and training.
* Ensure reliable controls are in place and understood by the business to address key risk areas (existing and emerging) to mitigate/prevent – in the “what”, “how” and “why” so that business activities are appropriately implemented.
* Collaborate with the business together with the KSA E\&C Manager to regularly develop and implement dynamic compliance risk assessments and integrate mitigating measures into business processes.
* Support E\&C procedure localization and providing input to global procedure updates.
* Contribute to developing and driving monitoring plans, root cause analysis, and meaningful corrective actions/preventive actions in close collaboration with an integrated approach across other functions (Finance, Center of Excellence, HR, Medical, Marketing, Sales, etc.).
* Actively contribute to key meetings in E\&C (e.g., monitoring forums, staff, etc.) and with business partners (e.g., lead teams, ICCG committees, etc.).
* Seek out and bring in external perspectives on processes to eliminate, simplify, automate, and leverage technologies to enhance E\&C capabilities and focus on business partnership.
* Responsible for driving E\&C\-related compliance communications and training needs for the business.
* Effectively communicate the ‘state of control’ to leadership teams.
* Ensure business processes and operational procedures are consistent with Global Policies and Standards.
* Lead, together with CFO, the CAS audits implementation and follow\-up at local level.


**Business Influence And Cross Function Collaboration**
* Through deep business acumen and effective influence across different layers of the organization/leadership, ensure business discussions and decisions encompass and consistently take into consideration appropriate ethics and compliance elements, and that there is clear business ownership of ethics in all decisions taken.
* Influence leadership and business practices through effective communication of internal policies/standards and external environment risks.
* Ensure an open and collaborative environment that promotes teamwork, open communication, and collaborative interactions to foster a culture of integrity.
* This role collaborates with other ECOs from ICH to improve capabilities, mitigate regional risks and establish E\&C Strategy in the region.
* Lead the compliance review and compliance agreement development for new business development deals.
* Represent Lilly in the local industry association and in the interactions with regulators.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 WSP Middle East is seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Mining based in Riyadh, KSA, to establish and lead our Major Programs Mining \& Minerals business line in the region. This strategic leadership role will combine business development, project delivery oversight, commercial and financial management, and client relationship excellence to drive growth and successful delivery in one of our key sectors. As a leader within the Middle East region, with global connectivity, this role will require a blend of technical expertise, project leadership, business development acumen, and strategic client engagement.
   

  

 You will be responsible for shaping the direction of the mining business line, building strong teams, and delivering complex, major mining programs that align with WSP’s global standards and regional ambitions
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Business Development \& Strategy:**
* Serve as the founding leader for WSP’s Mining \& Minerals major programs business in the Middle East, establishing market presence and credibility.
* Navigate regional regulatory frameworks, cultural dynamics, and client expectations to build a sustainable business footprint.
* Define and execute the growth strategy for the Mining \& Minerals business line across the Middle East.
* Identify and pursue new market opportunities, capitalize on your existing relationships with government entities, mining operators, and strategic investors.
* Lead bid preparation and proposal development, including pricing, risk assessments, and contract terms.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients, and effectively represent WSP in meetings, workshops, and site\-based engagements.
* Prepare proposals, technical reports, and client\-facing documentation aligned with project and business objectives.
* Lead the setup and execution of PMC frameworks for large\-scale mining programs.
* Develop delivery models tailored to regional client needs, including owner’s team services and integrated project controls.


**Strategic Oversight of Advisory \& Design Streams:**
* Provide strategic leadership for the Mining Advisory and Design service lines.
* Ensure alignment with global technical teams and leverage international expertise to support and grow regional delivery.
* Drive integration across service lines to create a unified client offering – from pit to port, from exploration to closure.


**Project Delivery \& Operations:**
* Provide leadership and oversight for the successful end\-to\-end delivery of major mining projects including feasibility studies, mine planning, delivery, and closure phases.
* Implement and enforce project delivery governance, quality standards, safety protocols, and risk management frameworks.
* Collaborate closely with multi\-disciplinary teams to ensure seamless project execution and client satisfaction.


**Client Relationship \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Develop and maintain trusted advisor relationships with key clients, government agencies, regulators, and industry partners.
* Represent WSP at industry forums, conferences, and stakeholder meetings to enhance brand positioning and business opportunities.
* Be proactive in identifying opportunities to improve client outcomes and exceed expectations.


**Commercial \& Financial Leadership:**
* Take full P\&L accountability for the Mining \& Minerals major programs business line, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.
* Manage commercial agreements, contracts, claims, and scope changes to protect company interests and maximize profitability.
* Drive cost control initiatives and optimize resource allocation.


**Leadership \& Team Development:**
* Recruit, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team of mining professionals across technical, commercial, and operational disciplines.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in mining engineering, Mineral Processing, Geology, or related field; master’s degree or MBA preferred.
* Minimum 15–20 years of experience in the mining sector, with exposure to consulting and operator\-side roles in the Middle East region.
* Familiarity with regional mining regulations, standards, and market dynamics is highly desirable.
* Proven track record in business development and establishing new business lines or service offerings.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience managing P\&L, contracts, and financial performance.
* Demonstrated success in leading large\-scale mining projects or programs in the Middle East or similar regions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment and drive change effectively.

data.jd_text:
The Data Cleansing Program Director leads the Government\-Wide data cleansing program — driving large\-scale data quality uplift across multiple government entities. You will own the cleansing strategy, orchestrate a multi\-vendor delivery model, oversee enterprise data modelling, and ensure that cleansed datasets are published into the Government\-Wide catalogue and sharing platforms — sustainably, with strong governance, ongoing monitoring, and continuous improvement.
   

  

* Define and lead the Government\-Wide data cleansing strategy aligned with data quality standards, policies, and government priorities
* Establish a structured framework to prioritize critical datasets and drive phased execution across entities
* Standardize, automate, and scale the end\-to\-end data cleansing lifecycle — leveraging advanced tools and AI\-driven solutions; govern reusable accelerators
* Establish and oversee a multi\-vendor delivery model — coordinated execution, performance management, and scalability across entities
* Oversee large\-scale data quality improvement initiatives aligned to defined quality dimensions, rules, and thresholds
* Oversee development of entities' enterprise data models — aligned with Government\-Wide data standards, central information models, and interoperability requirements
* Ensure creation, standardization, and publication of cleansed datasets into the Government\-Wide data catalogue and sharing platforms — enabling accessibility and reuse
* Oversee development of data quality dashboards to track KPIs and cleansing progress
* Establish and lead program governance bodies — driving timely, quality delivery, issue resolution, and stakeholder alignment
* Establish and govern sustainable data quality and cleansing frameworks for long\-term maintenance and continuous improvement
* Provide regular reporting to senior leadership on program progress, risks, and impact on data maturity and value realization


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Data Management, IT, Engineering, or related field
* 20\+ years in data management, data quality, or large\-scale transformation programs (preferably with exposure in Europe or North America)
* Proven track record leading enterprise\-wide or national data cleansing / data quality initiatives, including multi\-vendor delivery models
* Strong expertise in data quality frameworks, profiling, and remediation techniques
* Familiarity with modern data platforms — Informatica, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar
* Demonstrated experience managing large vendor ecosystems and complex multi\-stakeholder programs
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills at senior government or enterprise level
* Excellent English communication; Arabic a plus

data.jd_text:
1\. About Front End
   

  

 Front End Limited Company is a Saudi\-headquartered industrial solutions group, named
 **"Innovator of the Year" at the Oil \& Gas Middle East 2025 Awards** 
 and 100% aligned with Saudi Vision 2030, Front End operates across eight integrated verticals:
   

  

* Energy — EPC \& project delivery, valves, actuators \& testing, subsurface
* Industrial Facilities — EPC \& turnkey services, valves \& safety systems, facility O\&M
* Geoscience — subsurface \& seismic, site \& geotechnical studies, airborne \& UAV surveys
* Space — satellite data \& analytics, monitoring \& insights, weather \& resilience
* Offshore — construction \& installation, surveying \& monitoring, drilling \& decommissioning
* Artificial Intelligence — strategy \& transformation, cloud \& modernization, AI operations
* Autonomy \& Mobility — UAV \& drone operations, marine \& subsea systems, air mobility
* Mining — exploration \& surveying, offshore mining, compliance \& sustainability


**This role sits within Front End's Environmental \& Sustainability initiatives** 
 , an extension of the Industrial Facilities vertical, focused on delivering circular\-economy and decarbonisation infrastructure for the Kingdom. While the successful candidate will be dedicated to the pyrolysis biochar project, they will be part of a multidisciplinary organisation that blends industrial execution capability with advanced technology, geoscience, and AI — giving the project access to capabilities that few peer organisations can match.
   

  

 2\. Role Purpose
   

  

 The Project Manager will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the
 **BST\-06 MAX pyrolysis biochar plant** 
 at the SBF site in Riyadh — a flagship environmental and sustainability initiative converting organic waste streams into biochar and renewable syngas in support of KSA Vision 2030 circular\-economy and net\-zero targets.
   

  

 Reporting to the Front End Projects Director, the Project Manager is accountable for the safe, on\-time, on\-budget, and quality\-compliant execution of the project from mobilisation through commissioning and operational handover (target commissioning:
 **June 2026** 
 ). The role serves as the single point of accountability between Front End, the client (SBF), the equipment supplier (Beston Group), regulatory authorities, and all subcontractors.
   

  

 3\. Project Context
   

  

 The project comprises the design, civil construction, installation, commissioning, and operational handover of a pyrolysis biochar production unit. The plant will:
   

  

* Divert organic and agricultural residues from landfill
* Produce biochar for soil regeneration and carbon sequestration
* Generate renewable syngas as a process energy source
* Operate within KSA municipal environmental regulations and SBF site\-specific HSE standards


 The project also serves as a reference deployment that will inform Front End's broader sustainability portfolio across the Industrial Facilities and Mining verticals.
   

  

 4\. Scope of Responsibility — Project Lifecycle
   

  

 The Project Manager owns delivery across the full project lifecycle, structured per PMI/PMBOK standards:
   

  

**Phase 1 — Initiation \& Site Preparation (Civil Works)**
 Lead site mobilisation, stakeholder onboarding, and baseline confirmation. Direct all ground preparation activities — site clearing, levelling, compaction, drainage — and oversee foundation design review, concrete slab and equipment plinth construction, and utility trenching for power, water, and drainage tie\-ins.
   

  

**Phase 2 — Planning \& Equipment Receipt / Installation**
 Manage logistics of equipment arrival from Jeddah port (customs clearance, transport, laydown). Direct crane operations, heavy lifting, mechanical assembly, and anchoring of the BST\-06 MAX carboniser, feed systems, syngas outlet components, and ancillary equipment in line with Beston Group drawings and specifications.
   

  

**Phase 3 — Execution \& Commissioning Support**
 Coordinate on\-site Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) replication and operational commissioning with the Beston Group team. Verify civil and structural compliance with design intent and HSE requirements. Manage punch lists and close out civil and mechanical snags.
   

  

**Phase 4 — Monitoring, Control \& Operational Handover**
 Oversee initial operations to confirm the plant performs safely within its approved footprint. Manage infrastructure modifications, access road maintenance, containment areas, and ongoing HSE coordination with SBF authorities. Lead formal handover to the operations team with full documentation.
   

  

**Phase 5 — Project Closeout**
 Complete as\-built documentation, lessons\-learned register, financial reconciliation, and contractual closeout with the client and supplier.
   

  

 5\. Key Responsibilities (PMBOK Knowledge Areas)
   

  

**Integration \& Scope Management**
* Develop and maintain the Project Management Plan, Scope Statement, and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)
* Manage change control through a formal change request and approval process
* Serve as the primary interface between Front End, SBF, Beston Group, and regulatory authorities


**Schedule Management**
* Develop and maintain the master construction programme (MS Project or Primavera P6\) aligned with the June 2026 commissioning target
* Track critical\-path activities, manage float, and report schedule variance weekly


**Cost Management**
* Manage the project budget; track committed vs. actual cost
* Approve subcontractor invoices and variation orders within delegated authority
* Report cost performance (CPI/SPI) to the Project Director monthly


**Quality Management**
* Implement Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for civil, structural, and mechanical works
* Ensure compliance with KSA building codes, SASO standards, Beston Group specifications, and ISO 9001 quality principles
* Conduct daily site inspections; maintain photographic records of all construction milestones


**Resource Management**
* Lead and direct subcontractors engaged in earthworks, concrete, steelwork, mechanical, and utilities installation
* Coordinate temporary site services: site office, welfare, security fencing, material storage


**Communications Management**
* Produce weekly progress reports, monthly stakeholder dashboards, and written daily site logs
* Chair weekly project coordination meetings and monthly steering committee reviews


**Risk Management**
* Maintain the Project Risk \& Issues Register; escalate geotechnical, structural, regulatory, or schedule risks promptly
* Develop mitigation plans for high\-priority risks; review register weekly


**Procurement \& Contract Management**
* Manage subcontractor contracts, scope, and performance
* Coordinate with supplier (Beston Group) on warranty, spares, and technical support obligations


**Stakeholder Management**
* Liaise with Saudi authorities for site permits, environmental operating licences, and industrial area compliance
* Coordinate with SBF facilities management on power supply, access routes, water/drainage tie\-ins, and waste management
* Manage client relationships and expectations throughout the lifecycle


**HSE \& Environmental Compliance**
* Ensure all site activities comply with KSA municipal environmental regulations and SBF site\-specific HSE requirements
* Oversee lifting plans, toolbox talks, permit\-to\-work systems, and incident reporting
* Champion sustainability outcomes consistent with the project's environmental mission


 6\. Key Performance Indicators
   

  

* Commissioning achieved by June 2026 (schedule adherence)
* Project delivered within approved budget (CPI 1\.0\)
* Zero Lost\-Time Incidents (LTI) and full HSE compliance
* All regulatory permits and operating licences secured prior to commissioning
* Quality close\-out: all punch\-list items resolved before handover
* Successful FAT replication and operational handover acceptance by client


 7\. Required Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Construction/Project Management from an accredited university
* Master's degree in Project Management, Engineering Management, or Sustainability is a plus


**Certifications (Required)**
* PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent (PRINCE2 Practitioner, IPMA Level B/C)
* Valid Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) registration or eligibility to obtain
* NEBOSH International General Certificate or equivalent HSE qualification


**Experience**
* Minimum 7 years in site\-based project delivery, with at least 3 years in an industrial or process plant environment
* Demonstrable track record managing heavy equipment foundations, industrial slab construction, and utility infrastructure in KSA or the wider GCC
* Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams (civil, mechanical, electrical, HSE)


**Technical Skills**
* Proficient in reading structural, mechanical, and P\&ID drawings
* Competent in AutoCAD or equivalent CAD software
* Proficient in MS Project, Primavera P6, or equivalent scheduling tools
* Familiar with KSA building codes, SASO standards, and municipal environmental permitting


**Language**
* Professional working proficiency in English (required); Arabic strongly preferred


 8\. Preferred / Desirable Experience
   

  

* Prior delivery of waste\-to\-resource, biochar, pyrolysis, gasification, or industrial thermal processing plants
* Experience in environmental and sustainability capital projects (circular economy, carbon reduction, ESG\-aligned)
* Heavy\-lift and crane operations management — lifting plan review, toolbox talks
* Vision 2030 giga\-project experience (SBF, NEOM, Diriyah, Red Sea, or equivalent)
* Experience with environmental operating permit applications in KSA industrial zones
* Familiarity with carbon credit/sequestration verification frameworks (Verra, Gold Standard)
* Working knowledge of ISO 14001 (Environmental Management) and ISO 45001 (OH\&S)
* Exposure to adjacent Front End verticals (energy, industrial facilities, geoscience, mining) is advantageous given potential cross\-project collaboration


 9\. Core Competencies
   

  

* Leadership \& decision\-making under pressure
* Stakeholder management across multicultural and multi\-organisational teams
* Problem\-solving and conflict resolution
* Commercial and contractual awareness
* Commitment to safety and environmental stewardship
* Strong written and verbal communication


 10\. Authorities
   

  

* Approve site\-level technical decisions within the scope of the approved design
* Approve subcontractor work and variations within delegated financial authority
* Stop\-work authority on any HSE or quality non\-conformance
* Escalate scope, schedule, cost, or risk exceptions to the Project Director


 11\. Why Join Front End
   

  

* Be part of a Vision 2030–aligned organisation recognised as Innovator of the Year at the Oil \& Gas Middle East 2025 Awards
* Lead a flagship environmental and sustainability project with regional visibility
* Work alongside teams across energy, industrial facilities, geoscience, space, offshore, AI, autonomy \& mobility, and mining
* Build a track record on a reference project that will shape Front End's broader sustainability portfolio

**Job Description**
 SH\&E MANAGER
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Responsibility for Safety Management in the Cliff Stabilization project for SAPL Qiddiya Infrastructure Partner (QIDP). Responsible and accountable for ensuring that all work is in full coordination with Qiddiya Investment Company (QIC). QIC is providing strategic direction on a city\-wide basis. Reports directly to the Project Director.
   

  

 Under general oversight of a safety, health, and environmental (SH\&E) director, Project Director, provides expertise, advice, and technical assistance to one or more project or program managers in implementing company risk management practices and in complying with the prevailing regulatory and client SH\&E requirements. Represents the company in all SH\&E matters pertaining to internal and external activities as associated with assigned projects and programs. Reports by dotted line to one or more project or program managers and reports directly to the Parsons corporate SH\&E functional group through the SH\&E director.
   

  

 Specific Responsibilities
   

  

* Leads full\-time, part\-time, and collateral duty project and program SH\&E specialists in implementing work plans and the company’s risk management practices.
* Represents the business unit SH\&E director on project or program worksites.
* Advises and assists project manager, program manager and/or other project and program personnel in conforming to Parsons’ Environmental, Safety, Health, and Risk Program (ESHARP) management system and Parsons’ policies and procedures.
* Develops site\-specific work plans, SH\&E compliance programs, training programs, and orientation plans fully conforming to relevant SH\&E regulations, Parsons’ ESHARP management system, and client requirements.
* Collaborates with project and program managers to evaluate (sub)contractors’ SH\&E performance, planning, and culture to be consistent with the company’s risk management practices and core values.
* Audits projects and programs and their worksites against corporate standards; creates and submits written audit reports.
* Inspects worksites to detect hazards and provides expertise to project personnel to eliminate/control the SH\&E risks associated with exposure to the hazards; creates and submits written inspection reports.
* Implements Parsons’ occupational injury and incident reporting and management processes.
* Initiates and conducts thorough incident investigations and root cause analyses using defensible protocols.
* Collaborates with project or program managers, craft workers, and other project or program personnel to identify effective corrective actions; creates and submits comprehensive investigation reports and lessons learned.
* Performs trends analyses on audit findings, inspection findings, and incident reports; creates and submits regular analysis reports.
* Represents Parsons during external regulatory or loss control inspections of project or program worksites.
* Assists with risk assessments for upcoming work and provides SH\&E subject matter expertise to work planning processes.
* Seeks active and personal participation from the project or program manager, craft workers, and other project or program personnel to identify SH\&E improvements and to implement the improvements.
* Assists the project or program manager with new hire orientation.
* Performs regulatory and best practice SH\&E training.
* Creates and maintains SH\&E training records.
* Participates in routine safe work briefings with craft, office, and (sub)contractor workers.
* Performs other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate.


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

* Extensive knowledge of Federal and State health and safety regulations and reporting procedures
* Advanced knowledge of safety\-related national consensus standards (e.g., ANSI, NFPA)
* Exceptional interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills
* Ability to perform in a supervisory/managerial capacity


 Education and Typical Experience
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Occupational Safety and Health or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 10\+ years of related work experience in the field of Health and Safety, including some supervisory experience


 Licenses and Certifications
   

  

* Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) is preferred


**Key Relationships**
* Supervision Received \- SH\&E Director; Project/Program Manager (various levels)
* Supervision Given \- SH\&E Specialists
* Internal Contacts \- All employees on construction projects
* External Contacts \- Suppliers; Clients; Safety Organizations; Government Organizations


 Parsons equally employs representation at all job levels no matter the race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability or genetic information.
   

  

 We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! Imagine next and join the Parsons quest—APPLY TODAY!

* Enjoy working in a fast\-paced results\-driven environment.

**Job Summary**
 The Project Director is responsible for the overall leadership and delivery of large\-scale data centre projects in Saudi Arabia within a general contracting environment. The role has full accountability for project performance, including safety, programme, cost, quality, and commercial outcomes, ensuring compliance with Saudi regulations, local authority requirements, and contractual obligations. Working closely with clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders, the Project Director builds, develops and leads multidisciplinary teams to deliver mission\-critical data centre facilities to the highest standards, while managing local supply chains, Saudization requirements, and fast\-track project demands in the KSA market.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Leadership \& Delivery:**
* Provide end\-to\-end leadership for complex, mission\-critical data centre project from mobilisation through commissioning and handover.
* Take full responsibility for project performance, including programme, cost control, quality, safety, and risk management.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, technical specifications, and regional regulations.
* Lead project governance, reporting, and decision\-making at senior and client levels.
* Appointment of individuals to key project positions.
* Work across company functional departments to engage support for on time delivery.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Act as the primary senior point of contact for clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring confidence in delivery and responsiveness.
* Manage client expectations and lead negotiations on variations, claims, and commercial matters.


**Commercial \& Contractual Oversight:**
* Oversee commercial strategy in collaboration with commercial team.

**About CodeNinja**
 CodeNinja is a next\-generation technology consulting firm specialising in AI\-powered transformation, enterprise software delivery, and Quality Engineering. Headquartered in the Gulf region and operating across the MENA, South Asia, and global markets, CodeNinja partners with Tier\-1 banks, government entities, and large enterprises to design, build, and run mission\-critical technology programs.
   

  

 With deep expertise in QA transformation, test automation, DevOps modernisation, and AI/ML engineering, CodeNinja's teams combine global delivery standards with in\-market contextual knowledge — ensuring outcomes that are compliant, scalable, and commercially aligned with client objectives.
   

  

 For the Client's Test Management Enablement \& Automation engagement, CodeNinja brings a dedicated 12\-person specialist team spanning Test Management, Automation Engineering, AI/ML, and Performance Testing — all governed under a structured 20\-week program delivery framework.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Delivery Manager / Project Manager serves as the overall engagement owner and single point of accountability for the Client's Test Management Enablement \& Automation program. This role is responsible for governance, delivery assurance, and stakeholder management across all three workstreams within a structured 20\-week timeline — operating at the intersection of QA transformation, client engagement, and programme execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end engagement delivery, ensuring milestones and KPIs are consistently met across all three workstreams within the 20\-week timeline

* Serve as the primary escalation path for the Client's stakeholders on all delivery, scope, and commercial matters
* Govern scope control, change requests, and commercial boundaries — ensuring formal sign\-off at each phase gate
* Coordinate resource allocation and sprint planning across onsite and offsite delivery teams
* Produce weekly status reports, monthly executive dashboards, and quarterly maturity reviews
* Ensure full compliance with the Client's security policies, SAMA IT Governance requirements, and NDA obligations


**Requirements**
* 15\+ years of delivery management experience in enterprise IT programmes, with at least 5 years in banking or financial services
* Proven track record managing QA transformation, automation, or DevOps modernisation programmes for Tier\-1 banks
* Experience operating within SAMA\-regulated environments and navigating Saudi financial sector governance expectations
* Strong executive stakeholder management skills — comfortable presenting at CIO/CTO level
* Proficiency in Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies with formal certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or CSM)
* Hands\-on experience with Jira\-based project tracking, CI/CD pipelines, and test management tooling
* Fluent in English; Arabic language skills are a strong advantage
* Preferred Certifications: PMP®, PRINCE2® Practitioner, CSM, ITIL v4 Foundation, SAFe Agilist (bonus)


**Why Join CodeNinja?**

* Access to continuous upskilling — certifications, AI/ML tooling, and emerging QA methodologies
* Competitive compensation with performance\-linked incentives and career progression pathways
* A culture that values technical excellence, ownership, and innovation without bureaucracy

 All candidates will be subject to standard background verification. Onsite positions require compliance with the client's site access, security, and NDA policies. CodeNinja is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified individuals regardless of background.

**Description**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead the Amazon Marketplace Experience Transformation (AMET) function for Delivery Associates (DAs) and Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) across Africa, Middle East, and Turkey. In this critical role, you will be based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, focusing on local operations while developing and executing the regional strategy. You will leverage multiple listening channels to identify experience priorities, consolidate feedback, and work cross\-functionally to address key improvement opportunities. This position requires exceptional stakeholder management and strategic thinking to create meaningful programs that enhance the overall driver and DSP experience across diverse markets.
   

  

 Your expertise in program management, strategy development, and influence without authority will be essential as you partner with external entities to create impactful campaigns, present strategies to senior leadership, and drive initiatives that transform the delivery partner experience. You will serve as the strategic voice for delivery partners, ensuring their needs are represented in business decisions while balancing operational excellence and partner satisfaction
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and execute the strategic roadmap for delivery partner experience across Africa, Middle East, and Turkey, while maintaining focused implementation in Saudi Arabian operations.
* Collect and analyze insights from multiple listening channels to identify experience priorities, then work cross\-functionally with operations teams, ACES, and DEX teams to address structural challenges within established SLAs.
* Draft comprehensive strategy documents and present recommendations to senior leadership, driving alignment and securing resources for key initiatives.
* Establish and manage partnerships with external entities to create campaigns and benefits for Delivery Associates and DSPs, including organizing annual partner meetings and launching ignite events throughout the region.
* Lead country expansion efforts and new program launches within AMET, ensuring consistent implementation of best practices while adapting to local market needs.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* 5\+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in English\-language communication skills, both written and verbal
* Experience in Arabic\-language communication skills, both written and verbal


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

data.jd_text:
**Company Description**
 At QIMA, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust.
   

  

 Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.
   

  

 We combine on\-the\-ground expertise with digital solutions that bring accuracy, transparency and intelligence for quality and compliance data.
   

  

 What sets us apart is our unique culture. Our 5,000 Qimates live and make decisions every day by our QIMA Values. With client passion, integrity, and a commitment to making things simple, we disrupted the Testing, Inspection, and Certification industry. Are you ready to hop on this exciting ride with us and help us achieve our mission?
   

  

 Our Consumer Products Division is dedicated to helping brands, retailers and manufacturers worldwide deliver safe, quality and ethically made products to their consumers. Every day at work, our inspectors, auditors, lab techs, and certification specialists use their expertise to help safeguard the products you use every day in your home: from clothes and footwear to toys and baby products, to electronics, appliances, and furniture.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Role in Brief**
 The Manager \- Client Service \& Global Program will manage the Client Services and Program Department, maintaining a high level of service quality, understanding client needs, and developing strong client relationships, while ensuring compliance with regulatory programs such as SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT. This role will report directly to the Head of Certification Unit working as part of our Client Service \& Program team.
   

  

 The purpose of QIMA’s Client Service \& Program team is to deliver seamless certification experience to our clients by managing key programs and ensuring the highest standards of client satisfaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Supervise the Program Management \& Client Service Team and ensure continuous monitoring of service quality and operational efficiency.
* Manage and maintain client relationships to enhance the customer service experience, ensuring service quality and efficient operations.
* Identify and seek further business opportunities while developing relationships with new clients.
* Oversee client’s programs and maintain understanding of regulatory program requirements including SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT.
* Support the Sales Team to resolve client enquiries and problems with consistency and accuracy.
* Handle ad\-hoc assignments as required.
* Champion an AI\-first mindset by promoting the use of AI tools and technologies in day\-to\-day operations and encouraging experimentation and adoption of AI\-driven solutions to improve efficiency, strengthen processes, and elevate service quality.


**Qualifications**
**To succeed in this role, you have:**
* Diploma or degree holder in any discipline; Electrical, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering background is a plus.
* Fluent in written and spoken English; Chinese or Arabic speaking is an advantage and preferable.
* 5\+ years of working experience in operations and client service within a certification body; experience in testing laboratory management and in\-depth technical knowledge are an advantage.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving skills.
* Experience in managing a team, customer service, and client management.
* Self\-initiated, independent, and a good team player.
* 5\+ years of total experience; experience in certification bodies with team management responsibilities is highly valued.
* Familiarity with regulatory programs such as SASO, GSO, SFDA, and MOAIT is a strong advantage.
* A genuine enthusiasm for Artificial Intelligence and its practical applications in operations, quality control, or client management; experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity and decision\-making is a strong plus.


**Additional Information**
 Because our differences make the difference, at QIMA we are proud to promote inclusive diversity and equal opportunities! Our policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.
   

  

*QIMA recognizes and recruits all its talents.*

data.jd_text:
**Who We Are**
 Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry\-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.
   

  

 WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com
   

  

 For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
   

  

**More About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly experienced and dynamic Riyadh\-based PR Group Account Director (or Account Director) to join our Destination, Sport, Entertainment \& Culture team. In this pivotal role, you will lead high\-impact public relations initiatives for some of the region's most significant and exciting projects. You will be responsible for driving strategic client relations, fostering robust media engagement across the Arabic media landscape, and providing exemplary leadership to your team.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead the development and execution of strategic PR and communications plans, overseeing integrated campaigns across destination, sport, entertainment, and culture sectors.
* Cultivate and manage strong client relationships, leading regular meetings, handling ongoing requests, and ensuring the timely delivery of high\-quality outputs.
* Develop and own deep relationships with key Arabic media contacts, including journalists and editors, to drive proactive and reactive media engagement and secure impactful coverage.
* Oversee the strategic planning and flawless execution of all media FAM trips, coordinating closely with KSA Account Executives for logistical support.
* Craft compelling briefing documents, media briefs, key messages, and background materials, ensuring alignment with client strategic narratives and media positioning.
* Provide expert on\-ground communications support for major events, launches, and press engagements, ensuring seamless coordination with media and stakeholders.
* Monitor and analyze campaign performance, timelines, and deliverables to ensure successful execution, strategic alignment, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead, guide, and mentor the KSA team, fostering clear accountability, efficient project delivery, and consistent quality control across all client deliverables.


**Experience That Contributes To Success**
* Proven experience as an Account Director or Group Account Director within a public relations agency setting.
* Extensive and demonstrable background in public relations within the destination, sport, entertainment, or culture sectors.
* Strong media relations expertise, with a particular focus on and established connections within the Arabic media landscape.
* Exceptional ability to develop and produce high\-quality Arabic content and compelling communication materials.
* Fully bilingual proficiency in both written and spoken Arabic and English is essential.
* Demonstrated leadership skills, with a track record of effectively guiding, mentoring, and overseeing PR teams.
* A strong portfolio showcasing successful strategic planning, integrated campaign management, and client relationship excellence.
* Practical experience in providing on\-ground communications support and managing press engagements for high\-profile events.


**You Belong At Burson**
 Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.
   

  

 At Burson, we’re an agency of learn\-it\-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a \#BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

 When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our  California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!
   

  

 At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented
 **Senior** 
**Technical Director** 
 to join our team!
   

  

 In this role, you will get to provide technical leadership and strategic oversight for the design and engineering delivery of large\-scale highways and roads infrastructure programs across Saudi Arabia. You will act as the senior technical authority, ensuring engineering excellence, compliance with standards, and the successful integration of design across complex, multi\-disciplinary infrastructure projects.
   

  

 This role is focused on design governance, technical assurance, and engineering leadership, supporting major highway corridors, expressways, interchanges, and road networks from concept through detailed design and construction support.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Acting as the senior technical authority for highways and roads infrastructure projects, providing leadership across all design and engineering disciplines.
* Leading and overseeing the planning, development, and delivery of highway and road designs across all project phases, including concept, preliminary, detailed design, and construction support.
* Managing and coordinating multi\-disciplinary engineering teams, including roadway, structures, drainage, utilities, traffic, ITS, and interfaces.
* Establishing and enforcing technical standards, design criteria, procedures, and assurance processes for highways and roads programs.
* Reviewing and approving design deliverables to ensure compliance with client requirements, Saudi standards, Parsons’ quality systems, and best engineering practices.
* Working closely with Program Directors and Project Managers to ensure design solutions align with scope, schedule, budget, and constructability requirements.
* Providing technical leadership in resolving complex engineering challenges, risks, and interfaces associated with large\-scale road and highway networks.
* Guiding and overseeing the work of design consultants, ensuring technical compliance while maintaining appropriate professional accountability.
* Supporting business development and pre\-contract activities by acting as a technical advisor during bids, proposals, and client presentations.
* Contributing to the development of technical strategies, innovation initiatives, and continuous improvement in highways and roads design delivery.
* Engaging with clients, authorities, and stakeholders on technical matters, representing Parsons at senior technical forums and reviews.
* Leading the technical team, including mentoring and developing technical talent within the organization, strengthening long\-term engineering capability.


**What Required Skills You’ll Bring**
* Master's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Chartered Membership of recognized institution.
* 20\+ years of experience in highways and roads infrastructure design and engineering.
* Proven experience providing technical leadership on large\-scale highways, expressways, interchanges, and major road corridor projects.
* Strong background in design management and engineering governance for complex infrastructure programs.
* Comprehensive understanding of Saudi Arabian design standards, specifications, and regulatory requirements for highways and roads.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate multi\-disciplinary engineering teams and external design consultants.
* Strong technical judgment with the ability to balance design excellence, constructability, cost, and schedule considerations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience operating in a client\-facing, consulting environment on major infrastructure programs.
* Chartered Engineer status or equivalent professional registration.


**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring**
* Experience working on government\-led or giga\-scale infrastructure programs in Saudi Arabia.
* Exposure to smart mobility, digital engineering, and sustainable highways design practices.
* Experience supporting bids and proposals for large highways and roads infrastructure programs.
* Strong understanding of sustainability principles and their application to highways and transportation infrastructure.
* Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast\-paced, and evolving program environments.


 Parsons equally employs representation at all job levels no matter the race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability or genetic information.
   

  

 We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! Imagine next and join the Parsons quest—APPLY TODAY!

**Locations**

 Who We Are
   

  

**Location: Doha \| Riyadh**
 The Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures\-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

**About BCG Platinion**
 BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time\-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading\-edge tech platforms, at scale.
   

  

**Practice Area**
 BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York\-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh\-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design.
   

  

 We support our clients’ total digital transformation through technology, design, cybersecurity, and risk management \& financial engineering capabilities. And together with BCG, BCG Platinion’s interdisciplinary team of technical experts enable customized technical solutions and accelerate delivery value through new business platforms, application consolidations, and major system implementations.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Principal IT/Digital in the Energy Practice, you will work closely with our client's leadership teams to understand their key challenges, define IT strategies, win buy\-in for your recommendations and lead fellow BCG case team members to transform client potential into performance with high\-impact assignments. You will deploy customized IT strategies, digital platforms and architecture in order to leverage the digital potential of our customers in order to deliver long lasting value. You will evaluate and coach our clients' technology teams, manage quality and risk while maintaining client expectations and escalations. Besides the functional guidance of the project team you will also be operationally responsible for the execution and management of the solution. Together with our clients you will develop convincing IT strategies, concepts and solutions that have a lasting impact on the organization, operating model, digital, and/or data landscape.
   

  

 You will manage diverse teams of consulting talent. Your role will be to help those teams flourish by provoking thought, team mentoring, knowledge sharing, giving frequent feedback and creating opportunities for team members to learn and grow. You will also personally develop and grow by being exposed to new and complex challenges daily.
   

  

 Clients will also seek your advice as a thought leader on business issues that extend beyond the immediate scope of you project work. Finally as a Principal you will contribute to the Practice Area development and help to strengthen the BCG Platinion brand as a AI and digital leader.
   

  

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
* Driving results in complex environments
* Solving business and technology problems
* Building strong client relationships
* Leading and developing teams
* Communicating complex topics clearly
* Collaborating across teams


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 8–12\+ years in IT consulting or digital transformation
* Experience in Energy sector (e.g., Oil \& Gas, Petrochemicals)
* Track record in IT transformation delivery
* Expertise in IT/ Digital architecture, cloud, data \& AI topics
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management
* Excellent academic degree
* Excellent English communication skills, Arabic is a plus.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You will work in a collaborative environment with continuous development opportunities, growing toward Director\-level roles while deepening expertise in Energy and IT/ digital transformation.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**
 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

data.jd_text:
**Company Overview**
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 Directly manage and guide specialized technical leads, including the Incident managers, Support \& Operations team, Upgrade \& Deployment Lead, KPI Reporting \& Analytics Lead, Drive Test Lead, and Knowledge Transfer Lead.
   

  

**Job Description**
 A Service Delivery Manager (SDM) provides oversight of the operational health of the customer system, from service delivery through lifecycle support. The SDM ensures and may manage internal \& external resources to deliver services and maintain their compliance with customer contractual commitments.
   

  

 The SDM establishes standard procedures designed to ensure consistently high service performance, monitors employees and evaluates customer feedback to develop quality improvement processes. The SDM is responsible for customer success as defined by success criteria during the transition phase
   

  

 A Service Delivery Manager is assigned to one or more of MSI’s customers depending on the size of the system and its complexity. A SDM is expected to have or develop a detailed knowledge of the customer’s system and their operational staff.
   

  

**Responsibility**
 The main role of the Service Delivery Manager is to facilitate customer success by adhering to global service delivery processes related to the customer. The Service Delivery Manager also acts as the main interface between MSI and the customer.
   

  

 The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is a critical leadership role responsible for overseeing specialized Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) and deployment functions for the STC Nationwide Kodiak MCX network. Operating alongside the Customer Service Manager (CSM), the SDM leads dedicated technical teams to ensure seamless application upgrades, rigorous performance tracking, and effective knowledge transfer to support the mission\-critical environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Upgrades \& deployments: oversee the dedicated Upgrade and Deployment team (consisting of 4 personnel) responsible for executing software patching, rollbacks, updates, and deployment across all lab and production systems.
* Performance monitoring \&reporting: direct the KPI Reporting \& Analytics team to generate comprehensive system performance reports, Kodiak Analytic reports, and drive test reports to ensure service quality and SLA compliance.
* Testing \& verification: oversee change management verification, Wave mobile application acceptance testing, and drive testing operations (in coordination with 3rd party vendors).
* Knowledge transfer \& enablement: manage the Knowledge Transfer lead to facilitate comprehensive user engagement, onboarding, fleet mapping preparation, and continuous training development for the customer.
* Cross\-functional collaboration: work closely with the Customer Support Manager (CSM), Incident Managers, and supporting functions (like HR, Commercial, and Procurement) to align strategic goals and ensure continuous service improvement.


**Required Operating Environment Context**
 The role supports a 24x7x365 support model handling highly complex, mission\-critical push\-to\-talk (MCPTT) applications.
   

  

 The candidate will be subject to local Saudization requirements, which may require specific educational degrees related to the role to be granted a work permit.
   

  

 Deliverables
   

  

* Take part in the formulation of standard procedures regarding service delivery.
* Lead the transition and transformation of project operations to Managed Services.
* Ensure that procedures and plans formulated for the customer are in line with the organization’s goals.
* Ensure that procedures formulated are fully implemented to achieve service level objectives.
* Attend important meetings on behalf of the service delivery team or appoint representatives.
* Make recommendations for changes to technology or procedures for the customer.
* Prepare periodic reports and present such reports to the customer stakeholders.
* Analysis of system performance and facilitate improvement recommendations.


 Cost and Efficiency
   

  

 A common fiscal responsibility of the Service Delivery Manager is to ensure delivery processes are efficient and cost effective. To reduce costs and streamline the process without adversely impacting the client experience, they might eliminate paperwork, unnecessary service steps or non\-value\-added features. For technology service providers, an emphasis should be placed on the efficient delivery of hardware and software services.
   

  

* Suggest new strategies to maintain or improve on the quality of service delivery \& minimize cost.
* Carry out research regularly and attend seminars to learn improved service delivery procedures and processes.


 Customer Satisfaction
   

  

 A key role for the service delivery manager is to constantly assess customer feedback and make necessary improvements. Managers typically conduct evaluations with customers on the phone, in person, via e\-mail or through postal mail. When scores fall below the preset thresholds, the manager may conduct additional research and take steps to correct deficiencies. For example, some customers might feel like parts of the process are slow or delayed. By identifying and analyzing the issues, the service delivery manager can work on eliminating bottlenecks.
   

  

* Collect data and information on client satisfaction, inquiry, and complaint.
* Plan, manage and execute customer meetings for service delivery reporting and improvements.
* He/she will ensure that clients’ satisfaction is always guaranteed and will consistently collate data on customer satisfaction, inquiry and complaint.
* Responsible for maintaining a positive relationship with customers.
* identifying customer needs and ensuring that the service provider is able to meet these needs with an appropriate catalogue of services.
* The Service Delivery Manager has responsibility for being the Customer’s advocate within Motorola and being Motorola’s face to the Customer.
* Support the customer to best use the features and deliverables of Managed Service.
* Performs analysis of issues and problems.
* Lead efforts to escalate across internal functional groups to resolve service or client business impacting issues.
* Provides support relative to contractual commitments and SLA's.


 Management
   

  

* Educate the members of the service delivery team on new plans and implication on service delivery.
* Assess the individual and collective performance of the team members.
* Organize and head meetings with the service delivery team.
* Responsible for training of service delivery resources.
* Reporting.


 Basic Requirements
   

  

* Diploma or degree in Engineering (Electrical) or related discipline
* ITIL v4 certification
* High level of understanding of Communication systems and IP Networks
* 2\+ years experience with planning and transitioning a project to operations and maintenance phase
* 5\+ years experience managing a service delivery team, ideally focused on operations and maintenance
* High\-level experience in telecoms or public safety
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and presentation in English and Arabic)
* Excellent customer service skills with a focus on Total Customer Satisfaction
* Effective consultation and liaison skills
* Good planning and time management skills
* Ability to prioritise, multi\-task and meet deadlines
* Excellent theoretical and practical problem\-solving skills
* Well\-developed interpersonal and teamwork skills
* Ability to work unsupervised
* Technical literacy


 Travel Requirements
   

  

 25\-50%
   

  

 Relocation Provided
   

  

 Domestic
   

  

 Position Type
   

  

 Experienced
   

  

 Referral Payment Plan
   

  

 No

 Motorola Solutions Arabia, Inc., Saudi Branch
   

  

***EEO Statement***
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.
   

  

 We are proud of our people\-first and community\-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. **Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Client Project Manager is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for leading and directing concurrent client projects classified as standard or complex.

* Coordinates activities of the project teams through task delegation and resource assignment.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Excellent communication skills are essential; this role requires a confident, resilient communicator who can challenge constructively and defend delivery commitments when required.
* Ability to work in high‑pressure environments.
* Ability to manage urgent and complex tasks simultaneously.
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness.
* Passionate, high‑energy, self‑driven, and results‑oriented.
* Strong influencing ability whilst taking a collaborative approach.
* Competent in project change management.
* Strong IT services background is mandatory, with experience delivering projects related to infrastructure, systems, or enterprise technologies.
* Exposure to software application delivery and/or AI‑related projects is a strong advantage.
* Strong problem‑solving and analytical skills to identify and address issues that may arise during project implementation.


**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

 On\-site Working

**About The Role**
 Role Overview
   

  

 The
 **Senior Account Manager** 
 is responsible for the day\-to\-day on the ground project coordination to help deliver a long\-term large scale digital project.
   

  

 This role will be embedded with the client team and act as a primary on\-the\-ground point of coordination in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Senior Account Manager will work closely with our client’s internal departments and teams to gather feedback to communicate with the rest of the Journey team. The Senior Account Manager is responsible for delivering large and small scale projects according to brief, timeline and budget alongside developing strong relationships with the client team.
   

  

 Due to the nature of the work, the ideal candidate has experience supporting capital projects within cultural institutions and understands how creative work integrates into longer construction and institutional timelines.
   

  

**The Project**
 This giga\-project is a landmark destination city built around the philosophy of the “Power of Play,” integrating entertainment, sports, and culture at unprecedented scale within a livable urban environment. Spanning a wide range of districts and planned to support 500,000 residents, it brings together world\-class attractions, major global events, and diversified leisure offerings while contributing to broader national transformation ambitions.
   

  

 This Next\-Gen Visualisation programme supports this vision by establishing a scalable digital production ecosystem—including a continuously updatable Unreal Engine “Marketing Twin”—that enables consistent, high\-quality storytelling across multiple stakeholders. This platform integrates asset governance, real\-time workflows, and creative guidelines to ensure the digital representation of the city evolves in parallel with its physical development and can be used reliably by internal and external partners.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The essential functions include, but are not limited to:
   

  

**Project Co\-ordination \& Delivery**
* Manage day\-to\-day delivery of multiple phases of a large project, ensuring alignment with approved scope, schedule, and budget
* Act as a central coordination point between client teams, internal studio teams, and external partners
* Translate client discussions and decisions into clear actions, timelines, and responsibilities
* Track milestones, dependencies, and approval across all workstreams
* Responsible for project budget of £10m\+
* Develop and maintain project schedules aligned with capital project phases and client milestones
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks related to schedule, budget, scope, and coordination


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as a consistent point of contact for designated projects
* Attend and support client meetings, workshops, and site walks
* Build trusted relationships through clarity, reliability, and proactive communication


**Required**

* Arabic speaking
* 5\+ years experience in an account management role within a creative, cultural, architectural, or production environment
* Experience managing complex and high\-profile projects
* Strong understanding of schedules, budgets, and dependency management
* Experience working alongside or supporting capital projects or long\-term institutional initiatives
* Experience with project management tools / software
* Strong verbal and written communication skills (Arabic and English)
* Organized and efficient

 this role is based in Riyadh, working remotely with the wider Journey Studios

 ر.س330,000 \- ر.س405,000 SAR

 WSP is seeking an experienced Project Manager to play a pivotal role in driving both work winning and operational delivery across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This strategic role brings together business development and project execution, contributing directly to the organisation’s growth and long term success in the region.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying and securing new opportunities, building and maintaining strong client relationships, and ensuring the effective mobilisation and delivery of projects from award through to completion.
   

  

 As a key driver of growth and delivery performance, the Project Manager will lead capture strategies and tender submissions for major public and private sector clients, while maintaining oversight of project execution, commercial performance, and delivery outcomes post award.
   

  

**Key requirements include:**
* Strong commercial acumen and contractual awareness.
* In\-depth knowledge of the Saudi construction market.
* Proven experience in winning and delivering major projects.
* Ability to operate strategically while retaining hands on delivery oversight.


 This role offers the opportunity to work on high profile projects while playing a central role in shaping the organisation’s continued growth across Saudi Arabia.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Work Winning / Business Development (Pre\-Contract)**
* Lead the full bid lifecycle: EOI, prequalification, tender review, proposal strategy, preparation, and submission.
* Develop and execute capture strategies for key clients including ministries, PIF entities, and major private developers.
* Review tender documents in detail to identify scope gaps, commercial risks, pricing exposure, and contractual obligations.
* Lead the development of pricing strategies aligned with market conditions, competitive positioning, and company margin targets.
* Perform cost benchmarking against historical data and current market rates.
* Lead internal pricing reviews and sign\-off meetings with senior management.
* Participate in commercial negotiations, clarifications, and value engineering discussions with clients.
* Maintain a bid cost database and lessons\-learned register to improve future pricing accuracy and win rates.
* Support contract finalization to ensure alignment between tender pricing assumptions and awarded scope


**Project Operations (Post\-Contract)**
* Lead project mobilization in accordance with contractual scope, deliverables, and agreed commercial terms.
* Ensure thorough contract review upon award to validate scope boundaries, pricing assumptions, exclusions, and risk allocation.
* Administer contracts in line with contract conditions, ensuring compliance with all contractual obligations.
* Establish project execution plans, cost baselines and resource deployment forecasts.
* Oversee project P\&L performance, including revenue recognition, gross margin protection, and cost control.
* Update cost\-to\-complete each month for assigned projects.
* Manage invoicing processes, ensuring timely submission, certification, and collection in coordination with finance.
* Lead commercial management of variations, scope changes, and additional services.
* Identify and proactively manage commercial risks, claims exposure, and dispute matters.
* Ensure proper documentation of correspondence, instructions, approvals, and change records to protect contractual position.
* Manage subconsultant agreements including scope definition, performance monitoring, certification of payments, and back\-to\-back commercial alignment.
* Conduct regular project performance reviews with senior management.
* Close out projects commercially and contractually, including final account settlement and lessons\-learned documentation.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical), Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, or related discipline.
* PMP certification or equivalent preferred.
* Minimum 8 years of experience within engineering consultancy or construction management.
* Proven experience in both bid management and project delivery in Saudi Arabia.
* Good knowledge of Saudi construction industry, clients and procurement processes.
* Experience working on major infrastructure, mixed\-use, or giga\-projects.
* Excellent communications and negotiation skills.
* Fluency in English required; Arabic strongly preferred.


**Competencies**
* Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen.
* Leadership capabilities.
* Strong analytical and risk management skills.
* High level of professionalism and client\-facing confidence.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

**Description**

The firm has consulting practices in healthcare, property \& casualty insurance, life insurance and financial services, and employee benefits. Founded in 1947, Milliman is an independent firm with offices in major cities around the globe.
   

  

 The candidate would be expected to support consulting work for clients in the Middle East \& GCC region. This role is open to Saudi nationals.

**Project support \& coordination**

**Technical \& analytical support**

**PowerPoint expertise**

* Continuously improve presentation templates and visual standards, ensuring alignment with brand and client expectations.


**Suitable Candidates**

+ Excellent organizational, communication, and time management abilities.

* Key Competencies:
+ Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to synthesize data into clear, impactful presentations.
+ Detail\-oriented and capable of managing multiple priorities under tight timelines.
+ Adaptable team player with strong problem\-solving skills and a client\-focused approach.

* Travel: Flexible with travel to support project objectives

Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 As the Investment and Business Development Director, you will spearhead the company's efforts in identifying and capitalizing on investment opportunities for sustainable urban development projects. Drawing upon your extensive experience in investment management and your deep understanding of the engineering industry, you will lead initiatives to attract funding, secure partnerships, and drive the financial success of our projects.
