data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 The Head of Training Administration leads the design, development and delivery of innovative blended learning solutions that align with organizational competency needs, and compliance requirements, ensuring continuous professional growth and improved business performance.
   

  

 The role is accountable for driving training effectiveness through needs analysis, team leadership, quality assurance, and leveraging technology to maximize learning impact while maintaining comprehensive training records and coordination of seamless training delivery. Additionally, the role holder is charged with sourcing external training solutions and manages external training providers to meet evolving business requirements.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Plan, lead and organize the activities of the Section to ensure that Qafco’s Learning \& Development plans / schedules are met through the optimization and efficient utilization of available manpower, and external training providers.
* Ensure that Sectional staff members are motivated to realize their potential and significantly contribute to the organization.
* Participate in the annual budget preparation process and provide input to the Department Manager.
* Carry out the responsibility of collecting information and workout budget for the Section.
* Continually monitor progress and priorities and make necessary adjustments, where required, to ensure effective cost control.
* Ensure availability of qualified and competent human resources by initiating recruitment, development, and training, where necessary.
* Motivate, develop, and appraise performance of employees within the area of responsibility.
* Analyze the training needs aligned to the competency requirements and business goals to establish annual training plans, ensuring relevance and effectiveness.
* Implement the blended learning models, emphasizing the 10\-20\-10 framework, which encourages integrating formal training and social learning activities.
* Coordinate the Qafco\-Teaches\-Qafco (Train The Trainer) initiatives to ensure learning delivery as per required standards and quality.
* Lead the creation of diverse, engaging, and rigorous learning content aligned to learning paths, ensuring they meet the required standards and quality.
* Lead the team responsible for curriculum development, delivery, quality assurance and evaluating training effectiveness, including return\-on\-investment (ROI) measurement.
* Ensure the accuracy and currency of academic and developmental progress reports for all participating nationals.
* Keep superior informed on Section’s progress against plans to enable monitoring and co\-ordination of overall L\&D activities.
* Manage the learning management system (LMS) for administering, delivering, tracking, reporting learning activities, maintaining accurate training records for compliance and future reference.
* Implementation of e\-learning solutions including Artificial Intelligence (AI) to support business needs and promote continuous learning.
* Collaborate with the business and lead the implementation of individual development plans to support skills development and performance enhancement.


**Desired Candidate Profile**
* Bachelor’s degree (preferably in Human Resources or related fields) from a recognized University.
* Professional certification (e.g., CIPD, SHRM, or equivalent) is desirable.
* Certified Workplace Assessor certification will be advantageous.
* At least 10 years’ experience in Learning and Development, with a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role.
* Proven experience in the curation and implementation of company\-wide learning solutions in support of organizational transformation.
* Proven experience in utilizing learning management systems and emerging learning technologies.
* Knowledgeable in the design and implementation of competency frameworks

**Overview**
 University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST) was officially established by the Emiri Decision No13 of 2022, and it is the first national university specializing in academic applied, technical, and professional education in the State of Qatar. UDST has over 70 bachelor's and master's degree programs, diplomas, and certificates. The university houses 5 colleges: The College of Business, the College of Computing and Information Technology, the College of Engineering and Technology, the College of Health Sciences, and the College of General Education, in addition to specialized training centers for individuals and companies. UDST is recognized for its student\-centered learning and state\-of\-the\-art facilities. Its world\-renowned faculty and researchers work on developing the students’ skills and help raise well\-equipped graduates who proudly serve different sectors of the economy and contribute to achieving human, social, and economic development goals nationally and internationally.
   

  

 With more than 700 staff and over 8,000 students, UDST is the destination of choice for applied and experiential learning. The University is recognized for its student\-centered learning and state\-of\-the\-art facilities. Our faculty are committed to delivering pedagogically\-sound learning experiences that incorporate innovative learning technologies. Our aim is to enhance students’ skills and help develop talented graduates who can effectively contribute to a knowledge\-based economy and make Qatar’s National Vision 2030 a reality.
   

  

 Our eligible employees enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, in accordance with applicable UDST policies. These benefits include:
   

  

* Generous academic annual leave
* Tax free salary
* Fully furnished upmarket accommodation (inclusive of utilities: water \& electricity)
* Annual flights for spouse and 3 children (up to 18 years old)
* Children’s education allowance
* Relocation/Shipping allowance
* Professional development opportunities
* International health insurance
* In\-house immigration services (to help you through the residency process)
* Full access to our recreational facilities
* Research and professional development support.


 The College of Health Sciences invites applications for Midwifery faculty at Lecturer rank.

**Your Commitment**

The Certification Lead is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end delivery of cybersecurity certification programs and assurance services. The role oversees certification assessments, critical sector audits, and the development of standardized methodologies and frameworks. It ensures the effectiveness, consistency, and continuous improvement of certification operations while translating strategic objectives into executable programs. The role also leads stakeholder engagement, team management, and the delivery of national\-level cybersecurity certification initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**:**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of all certification services and programs
* Oversee certification review assessment for all certification programs
* Responsible for critical sector audits as the Certification Lead
* Establish, monitor and enhance standardized audit methodologies, practices, and certification standards.
* Continuously assess and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Certification program.
* Translate the strategic direction from the department head into actionable projects and programs.
* Plan, build and operate cybersecurity certification standards and related assurance mechanisms
* Plan, prioritize, and oversee delivery of projects and initiatives within the Certification Services portfolio
* Provide solutions for challenges encountered in the operation and promotion of assurance services.
* Follow\-up with the top management on resources and requirements for the benefits of the department.
* Manage, monitor and support the planning, preparation and delivery of certification related public events (workshops, trainings, conferences, etc.)
* Interact with stakeholders, providing expert feedback on challenges and insights to the operation team.
* Coordinate with other departments activities in relation to assurance.
* Manage stakeholder interaction for collaboration with internal and external projects
* Manage, mentor and lead the certification team and improve service delivery (operational guidance, professional development, and capability enhancement)


 Requirements
   

  


**Education \& Experience:**



* Master’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, or related field, or minimum 15 years of relevant experience.
* At least 6 years of experience in cybersecurity assessment, IT auditing, or certification\-related roles.
* Strong background in cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance.



**Certifications (Preferred):**



* CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer.
* COBIT, CRISC, CGEIT, or other governance and risk management certifications.



**Technical Skills:**



* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity and information security standards (ISO 27001, NIA, COBIT, Common Criteria, etc.).
* Understanding of accreditation and certification frameworks (ISO 17021, 17024, 17065, 17025, 27006\).
* Experience in developing standards, technical directives, SOPs, and audit documentation.
* Strong background in risk management and compliance assessment.
* Proven project management experience delivering initiatives on time, within scope, and budget.
* Experience in regulatory compliance and national cybersecurity standard development.



**Core Skills:**



* Strong technical report writing and documentation skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including briefing senior executives.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in complex environments.



**Behavioral Competencies:**



* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities effectively.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to quality and accuracy.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Ability to work independently and drive initiatives proactively.


**Language:** 
 English (required)

* Conduct post\-project evaluations to identify lessons learned and best practices for future projects.

 Headquartered in Switzerland, we employ over 50,000 people in 60 countries and generate revenues of around $16 billion USD. We welcome you to apply today.

* In coordination with SEC 2 Logistics function in France, supervise and control all project and fulfilment related milestones such as scopes, timelines, expenses and risks impacting projects
* Identify, log, and track risks \& opportunities and report regularly to the Project Managers
* In coordination with customs specialists, verify and ensure all import documentation issued by the suppliers / factories is accurate, completed and according to the importing regulatory standards
* Cooperate with the customs team and with other internal/external stakeholders to ensure on time custom clearance and delivery to site with emphasis on avoiding additional costs such as penalties, storage and demurrages.

* Support all documentations and organize the local performance within Saudi Arabia’s 14 projects

* Continuously Update \& Maintain all logistics related tools utilized by Power Conversion
* Issue resolution on all logistics related defects, managing RCAs and NCRs
* Coordinate with Sourcing and Supply Chain to ensure all delivery and shipment release requirements are met
* Ensure corrective actions and containment plans are in place to avoid incident repeatability
* Be engaged with the finance team to ensure custom duties are processed promptly
* Ensure all logistics transactions are executed in accordance with GEV \& Country Compliance regulations

* Compliance to GEV EHS life saving rule and STOP WORK culture

data.jd_text:
**Senior Project Manager – Saudi Arabia/Al\-Khobar**
 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant international team.
   

  

 Siemens Digital Industries is a leading innovator in automation and digitalization. Our mission is to support customers in maximizing growth, profit opportunities and ecological footprint in the discrete and process industries. Ready to create your own journey?
   

  

 Join our Digital Industry as Senior Project Manager and help us transform the everyday by finding solutions and making the world a more inquisitive place for tomorrow.
   

  

**You‘ll make an impact by:**
* Managing customer projects end\-to\-end across the full project lifecycle, from handover through final acceptance, with responsibility for cost, schedule, quality, EHS and customer satisfaction.
* Actively steering project planning, execution, monitoring and control in line with PM@Siemens standards.
* Managing risks, opportunities, changes and claims, including identification of mitigations and commercial impacts.
* Coordinating cross\-functional and cross\-regional project teams, including engineering centers, partners and subcontractors.
* Supporting proposal, contract clarification and customer discussions by contributing project execution know\-how and solution understanding.


**Your success is grounded in**
* 10\+ years of experience in solution or automation project execution, with several years acting as fully accountable Project Manager for medium to large, cross\-organizational projects.
* Strong mastery of project management across the full lifecycle, including project planning, scheduling, cost control, forecasting, reporting, and governance according to PM@Siemens standards.
* Proven competence in risk and opportunity management, change management, claim management, and contract interpretation, including identification of commercial impacts and mitigation strategies.
* Solid understanding of industrial automation and process control solutions, including Distributed Control Systems (DCS), PLC and HMI\-based systems.
* Hands\-on project exposure to Siemens automation and digitalization products and systems such as SIMATIC PCS 7 (DCS), SIMATIC S7 (PLC), WinCC / HMI systems, and integration of industrial communication technologies.
* Familiarity with functional safety concepts and standards (e.g. IEC 61508\) as applied in automation projects.
* Strong commercial and financial project understanding, including cost controlling, cash flow, invoicing, forecasting, and collaboration with commercial project management and finance functions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage diverse stakeholders, including customers, internal engineering teams, global engineering centers, suppliers, and partners, without direct line management responsibility.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical solutions and Siemens capabilities clearly to customers.
* High level of intercultural competence and experience working in international, virtual, and cross\-regional project environments.
* Fluency in English for professional project communication; ability to operate confidently in customer meetings, reviews, and negotiations.


**Transform the everyday with us**
 We value your outstanding identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
   

  

 We celebrate the fact that our people are individuals and have different preferences and needs. If we all thought the same, we would never think of anything new! That’s why we recruit extraordinary minds from all walks of life. We are committed to furthering our culture of diversity, equity and inclusion. We encourage applications from a diverse talent pool and are happy to give the opportunity to discuss flexibility and reasonable adjustment requirements. Many of our teams are working optimally in a remote, virtual adding to our ability to offer more flexibility on how you handle your time.
   

  

 Please note: Only complete applications can be considered in the selection process.

**About us** 




 With our roots going back over (50\) years, we are one of the oldest and fastest growing Saudi\-based conglomerates that offers a diversified portfolio of products and services including infrastructure solutions on D\&B and EPC basis, development and co\-investment in real estate and renewable s, and manufacturing of renewable technologies.
 



 Recently we are experiencing a rapid growth and expansion locally and regionally; accordingly, we are looking for leaders who have big ideas that can embrace our vision to meet a variety of infrastructure needs all over the MENA region with three main business segment\- infrastructure solutions, development and co\-investment in real estate and renewable s, and manufacturing of renewable technologies.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 Lead and manage end\-to\-end delivery of multi\-utility infrastructure (EPC) projects, from planning and engineering through construction, commissioning, and final handover. Ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and in compliance with quality and safety standards.
 



  





**Job Relations** 
 :
 



 Internal \- All departments.
 



 External – Clients, Agencies \& Authorities, Suppliers, Transporters, and Subcontractors.
 



  





**Reporting to:** 




 Business Unit Manager (BUM) / Project Director (PD)
 



  





**Gender** 
 :
 



 Male/Female
 



  





**Level** 
 :
 



 Managerial
 



  





**Industry** 
 :
 



 EPC / Construction / Infrastructure
 



  





**Employment Type** 
 :
 



 Full Time
 



  





**Job Location** 
 :
 



 Saudi Arabia
 



  





**Main Duties \& Responsibilities** 
 :
 


* Manage full project lifecycle from award to Final Acceptance Certificate (FAC)
* Develop and monitor project schedules, milestones, and resource plans
* Ensure timely execution in line with contract scope, quality, and HSE standards
* Manage project budget, cash flow, and profitability
* Oversee billing, invoicing, and collection processes
* Administer contracts, manage variations, claims, and resolve disputes
* Supervise design and engineering activities across infrastructure systems (utilities, roads, drainage, telecom, etc.)
* Review and approve drawings, submittals, and technical deliverables
* Act as main point of contact with clients, consultants, authorities, and subcontractors
* Secure permits, approvals, and ensure regulatory compliance
* Plan and allocate resources (internal/external)
* Select and manage subcontractors, suppliers, and logistics
* Monitor performance and ensure contract compliance
* Oversee site setup, execution, and daily operations
* Ensure adherence to safety, quality, and company standards
* Report project progress, risks, and financial status to senior management
* Lead, mentor, and develop project teams



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Mechanical Engineering
* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification
* 10–12 years’ experience in infrastructure/EPC projects (min. 3 years in similar role)
* PMP or equivalent certification
* Strong knowledge of project planning tools (Primavera preferred)
* Solid understanding of infrastructure systems (utilities, roads, drainage, etc.)
* Strong financial, contractual, and project control skills
* Excellent communication and leadership skills
* Experience with ERP systems (e.g., D365\)
* Experience in multicultural environments

data.jd_text:
At Air Products, our purpose is to bring people together to reimagine what’s possible, collaborate and innovate solutions to the world’s most significant energy and environmental sustainability challenges. Grow with us as we embark on building tomorrow together by being the safest, most diverse and most profitable industrial gas company in the world.
   

  

**Reimagine What’s Possible**
 Job Description and Qualifications
   

  

 Rotoflow™, an Air Products Business, is a full\-service turbomachinery OEM \- providing a wide range of new equipment solutions and services to our customers globally in market segments such as industrial gases, petrochemicals, and hydrocarbons. Aftermarket services such as spare parts, repairs, upgrades, field services, engineering evaluations, reliability and performance assessments, troubleshooting, training, remote diagnostics/data monitoring, and shop services are some of the many offerings provided from regional service centers for both Air Products and non\-Air Products equipment.
   

  

 We are seeking an
 **Rotoflow** 
**Aftermarket Project Manager** 
 at our turbomachinery service center in KSA\- DSC, responsible for providing projects execution with engineering support for spare parts, repairs, upgrades, reverse engineering, and field service of all types of turbomachinery.
   

  

**You Will Enjoy**
* Be part of a team to grow a world\-class service and machinery business.
* Seeing the results of candidate’s direct efforts through successful execution of customer projects.
* Being empowered to satisfy customers and have influence on changes to work processes to meet customer expectations on speed and world\-class customer service.
* Collaborating with a cross\-functional team across commercial, engineering, procurement and manufacturing on a wide variety of projects with varying technical complexity and scope.
* Significant direct interaction with customers, in coordination with account managers, ensures Rotoflow exceeds customer expectations with solutions.
* Ability to grow and develop one’s career and take on increasing responsibility.


**Responsibilities**
* Work collaboratively with Proposal Managers to receive assigned orders, develop and implement appropriate execution plans that address execution, budget, and schedule, and put in place a team that can successfully execute.
* Manage and execute orders and projects concurrently in different phases, from order intake, execution, shipment, invoicing, and accounts receivable.
* Maximize revenue recognition and take necessary actions to fill the (planned vs actual) gaps.
* Ensure regular communication is provided to internal and external stakeholders and customers on the status of projects and develop relationships that will indirectly drive and boost sales.
* Lead and guide the execution team and provide directions on objective priorities to ensure tasks and deliverables are completed as planned.
* Manage changes on projects to keep projects on track and meet financial and customer targets.
* Provide feedback on lessons learned during execution to other functions to assure continuous improvement.


**Qualifications And Requirements**
* Technical Degree (BA/BS/BEng); mechanical/ Industrial engineering background a plus,
* Project Management Experience, \> 5 years is preferred, with excellent written and oral communication skills and demonstrated ability to effectively lead and organize engineering teams and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
* PMP certification is preferred.
* Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP is beneficial
* Detailed knowledge of rotating equipment's / turbomachinery, accessory systems, and related technologies and services is a plus.
* Goal oriented, self\-motivated, highly organized, with ability to drive success, with strong winning spirit and ability to motivate teams.
* Excellent creativity, problem solving, and decision\-making skills \- including an understanding of when to escalate both technical and administrative decisions.
* Aptitude and desire to quickly learn.
* Excellent time management skills.
* Ability and drive to continuously improve and eliminate unnecessary barriers or complexity to meeting customer needs
* Ability to create an environment of trust and consistently exhibit a positive attitude.


 We are the world’s largest hydrogen producer with over 80 years of industrial gas experience. We are hydrogen and industrial gas experts delivering safe, end\-to\-end solutions, investing in real, clean energy projects at scale, and driving the industry forward to generate a cleaner future.
   

  

 At Air Products, we work in an environment where we put safety first, diversity is essential, inclusion is our culture, and each person knows they belong and matter. To learn more, visit About Air Products.

data.jd_text:
**PROJECT MANAGER**
**About TelMAX Inc.**
 Based in York Region, telMAX is a private equity\-backed all fibre digital infrastructure platform that provides a 21 st century alternative to traditional telecom networks. Recognized for four consecutive years as Canada’s Fastest ISP with an industry\-leading net promoter score of over fifty, telMAX is continuing its rapid growth plan to bring its all\-fibre network to residential and business customers across Southern Ontario.
   

  

**Your Position \& How You Will Contribute**
 Reporting to the Senior Manager, Project Management, the Project Manager will be highly experienced and proactive to lead our Fibre to the Home (FTTH) projects. You will be responsible for developing project plans, predicting and monitoring the progress of all construction and materials acquisition activities, and ensuring successful project delivery on time and within budget. In this highly dynamic position, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow in your career and within the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Key Duties**
 Project Planning and Management
   

  

* Develop detailed project plans outlining scope, schedule, budget, and resources required.
* Predict, monitor, and control the progress of all construction and materials acquisition activities.
* Ensure that all project phases are completed on time and meet quality standards.


 Coordination and Execution
   

  

* Coordinate with various teams including engineering, construction, procurement, and external vendors.
* Ensure all teams are aligned and working towards the project objectives.
* Oversee the execution of the project plan, adjusting as necessary to meet changing needs and requirements.


 Stakeholder Communication
   

  

* Communicate project status, risks, and issues to key stakeholders, including senior management and clients.
* Prepare and present regular progress reports and updates.
* Facilitate project meetings and follow up on action items.


 Risk Management
   

  

* Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Monitor and address issues that may impact project timelines and quality.


 Budget and Resource Management
   

  

* Manage project budgets, ensuring that expenditures are tracked and controlled.
* Allocate resources efficiently and effectively to meet project demands.


 Compliance and Documentation
   

  

* Ensure all project activities comply with industry regulations, safety standards, and company policies.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including plans, reports, and contracts.


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement best practices.
* Conduct post\-project evaluations and lessons learned to enhance future project performance.


**Other Responsibilities**
* Help in setting up the resources and processes (contractors, internal resources)
* Work with contractors to detail specific project deliverables
* Develop timelines of goals and objectives for projects
* Delegating projects to teams best suited to complete them
* Tracking project performance and analyzing deliverables against requirements
* Ensuring that all budgetary objectives are met, adjusting as required
* Creating timely reports for executive committee meetings
* Predicting resource requirements based on build volume
* Scope – Design, Permitting, locates, drilling, fibre blowing, splicing, hand\-over to operations
* Coordination of invoicing from the contractors and ensuring work validation with construction management
* Ensuring the updating of internal systems
* Ensuring the archiving of as\-build drawings


**What You Bring**
* Strong relationship building, judgment skills, problem solving and follow\-up skills
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication abilities
* Ability to maintain confidentiality
* Excellent ability to prioritized and follow through in commitments
* Ability to lead and motivate cross\-functional teams
* Superior level planning and organizing skills, capable of seeing the big picture, understanding system pressures and planning at a detailed level
* Able to tailor your communication style to meet the needs of a variety of audiences, and achieve the desired result
* Comfortable learning new technical systems as needed


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in project management, preferably in the telecommunications industry with a focus on FTTH projects
* Proficiency with project management tools and software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera, Smartsheet)
* Strong understanding of construction and materials acquisition processes
* Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy and resourceful mindset
* Excellent organizational skills
* Strong time management skills, with the ability to handle multiple on\-going priorities
* Ability to handle confidential and non\-routine information with discretion and professionalism
* Highly professional and diplomatic, with a very positive disposition
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Ability to take initiative and work under pressure with minimal supervision
* Natural interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to work effectively and prioritize tasks.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn and adapt.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in project management, telecommunications, engineering, or a related field
* Experience in related areas or fields
* PMP or PRINCE2 certification is a plus
* College or University degree in related field


**ImPACT Values**
* Performance \& Commitment


 We hold ourselves to the highest standards, delivering exceptional results through dedication, accountability, and continuous improvement. Our commitment to excellence drives us to push boundaries, take ownership, and always follow through.
   

  

* Agility \& Collaboration


 We move fast, adapt with courage, and work together to solve challenges. Through empowerment and open communication, we foster a culture where bold ideas thrive. We leverage our collective strengths, achieve shared success and deliver exceptional results for our customers and teams.
   

  

* Customer Centricity


 In every decision we make, we think through the customer’s lens. We know that anticipating and exceeding their expectations isn’t just good service—it’s the foundation of who we are. By staying deeply connected to our customers’ needs, we build loyalty, enhance our reputation, spark positive word\-of\-mouth and drive company growth.
   

  

* Trust \& Integrity


 We build trust by acting with integrity, respect, and transparency in everything we do. We communicate with each other openly and presume positive intentions. By upholding these principles, we strengthen relationships, create a culture of respect, and empower teams to succeed together.
   

  

**Why You Should Join TelMAX**
* We are a growing, dynamic organization
* We offer a competitive variable compensation package
* Hybrid positions
* Benefits (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
* Health Spending Account (HSA)
* RRSP matching program


**Equity Statement**
 telMAX Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace, welcoming applications from all individuals. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA), accommodations are available on request for candidates during the selection process as well as throughout employment.

data.jd_text:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Purpose
 
 Conduct project planning and supervision to ensure timely completion and adherence to budget constraints. Project managers strategize and allocate project resources, formulate budgets, closely monitor progress, and consistently keep stakeholders informed throughout the entire project lifecycle.
 


 Key Accountability Areas
 
 Monitoring and Control:
 


* Manage time schedules, budgets, and cash flow for effective project control.
* Maintain the Mobilization plan for efficient resource allocation.
* Handle arrangements for manpower, materials, and utilities.
* Ensure compliance with Project Technical Specifications (PTS), schedule, and approved drawings.



 Quality Management:
 


* Implement Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) requirements.
* Conduct training for staff and workers at all levels to enhance skillsets and ensure compliance with quality standards.



 Project Administration:
 


* Oversee administrative, financial, and technical aspects related to the project.
* Confirm execution in accordance with PTS and approved drawings.
* Coordinate with the administrative team to address personnel management issues for on\-site employees.
* Develop a demobilization plan for both manpower and equipment at the conclusion of the project.


 Role Accountability
 - Ability to recruit, recognize and cultivate high performers and expose them in order to create a robust second line of management.

- Ability to recognize low performance and help or release them.

- Ability to treat people equally without any discrimination.

- The managers only assessment criteria being performance leading to delivery of required results.

- Ensure availability of delegation of authorities matrix to order to have sufficient delegations as per company policy.

- Must take full responsibility for his operation as per the job description and the required deliverables from this position, taking into consideration the general company guidelines.

- Able to anticipate problems and make the necessary proactive steps to prevent them

- Ability to take necessary and proper timely decisions.

- Deliver the required results in timely manner with required quality and cost.

- Must make a tangible difference to his area of operation. and exceed business expectations.

 As a Service Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will be at the forefront of executing service orders for the compression fleet, driving meaningful projects that enhance operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Your role will involve strategic planning and coordination, ensuring that projects are delivered within scope, time, quality, and budget, thereby contributing significantly to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions. * Execute compression service orders, including parts, repairs, field service, and complete outage projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

* Organize and lead teams, define responsibilities, develop schedules, and allocate resources to address specific project challenges effectively.
* Extend service order management to the Middle Eastern region as needed, ensuring seamless execution and delivery.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to achieve revenue, EBIT, on\-time delivery, and project delivery targets, while driving client satisfaction and supporting cash collection.

* Self\-driven and adaptable, with a positive attitude and the ability to solve challenges collaboratively.
* Familiarity with CRM (Salesforce) and ERP software (e.g., SAP) is highly desirable, enhancing operational efficiency.

 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a
 **Project Manager \- Credit Card Migration to join a well\-known Islamic Bank in Bahrain.** 
 The Ideal candidate will lead and deliver end\-to\-end credit card system and/or portfolio migration initiatives, ensuring successful execution across scope, time, budget, quality, and operational readiness. Own the migration governance, planning, stakeholder coordination, execution, cutover, and post go\-live stabilization while ensuring accurate data reconciliation and business sign\-off.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\) Project Governance \& Delivery Management** 



* Define and apply an appropriate project management framework and delivery governance (steering, working groups, RAID, milestones, reporting cadence) to ensure completion within agreed scope, quality, and timelines.
* Prepare the project brief/charter and initiation documentation; establish clear scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage scope changes through structured change control; drive decisions and approvals in a timely manner.
* Manage project risks/issues and ensure mitigation plans are actively owned and executed.



**2\) Credit Card Migration Planning \& Execution** 



* Own the end\-to\-end migration approach for new Credit Card system setup and/or system/portfolio migration, including strategy, sequencing, trial conversions, and final migration execution.
* Lead the planning and execution of parallel run and cutover planning.
* Lead data reconciliation and business sign\-off activities.
* Manage migration of account, card, transaction, installment, and fee data.
* Ensure readiness for authorization, clearing, billing, settlement, and collections flows.
* Ensure migration readiness across business, operations, technology, and vendors, including runbooks, cutover checklists, and rollback considerations.



**3\) Testing \& Environment Readiness (SIT/UAT/Parallel Run)** 



* Plan and manage SIT, UAT, and Parallel Run activities end\-to\-end, including test strategy, scope, entry/exit criteria, defect triage, and governance.
* Coordinate business users for UAT execution and sign\-off.
* Drive closure of defects, gaps, and reconciliation breaks prior to go\-live.



**4\) Data Migration, Reconciliation \& Controls** 



* Lead the data migration lifecycle: strategy, mapping, extraction, transformation, loading, trial runs, and reconciliation.
* Establish reconciliation controls and sign\-off packs between old and new systems.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness for key datasets and balances; drive resolution of discrepancies.



**5\) Scheme \& Platform / Vendor Coordination** 



* Work effectively with CMS platforms (VisionPLUS) and associated vendors/partners, ensuring delivery alignment, integration readiness, and clear responsibilities (RACI).
* Ensure the migration scope covers Visa/Mastercard data and scheme\-related flows in alignment with business requirements and operational cutover needs.



**6\) Shariah\-Compliant Product Considerations (Preferred)** 



* Ensure the solution and migration approach supports Shariah\-compliant card structures, preferably Tawarruq/Murabaha\-based settlement and profit calculation rules.
* Coordinate requirements validation and sign\-offs with relevant product owners and compliance stakeholders as applicable.



**7\) Go\-Live Command Center \& Hypercare** 



* Lead the cutover and go\-live command center, including war\-room governance, tracking, and escalation management.
* Lead post go\-live hypercare, ensuring issue triage, prioritization, resolution tracking, and stabilization closure with formal acceptance.



**Required Knowledge \& Experience (Must Have)** 



* In\-depth understanding of credit card lifecycle including: issuance, authorization, billing, settlement, reconciliation, collections, disputes, and chargebacks.
* Proven experience managing and executing credit card migration projects (system migration and/or portfolio migration).
* Knowledge of CMS platforms (VisionPLUS).
* In\-depth understanding and experience on: parallel run and cutover planning; data reconciliation and sign\-off; account, card, transaction, installment, and fee data; authorization, clearing, billing, and collections flows; data migration strategy, trial conversions, and reconciliation.
* Experience working on Visa/Mastercard data.
* Hands\-on experience managing SIT, UAT, and Parallel Run.
* Experience leading cutover planning and Go Live command center.
* Proven ability to lead post GoLive hypercare and issue resolution.



**Preferred / Advantage** 



* Understanding of Shariah\-compliant card structures, preferably Tawarruq/Murabaha\-based settlement and profit calculation rules.
* Experience in setting up a new Credit Card system (greenfield implementation) in addition to migration.



**Education \& Certifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline.
* PMI certification (or equivalent) is strongly preferred.



**Core Competencies \& Skills** 



* Excellent communication and stakeholder management across business, technology, and vendors.
* Customer focus and outcome\-driven delivery mindset.
* Strong planning and organizing skills with governance discipline and structured execution.
* Problem solving, analytical thinking, and a strong reconciliation mindset.
* Accountability and ownership; ability to lead under pressure during cutover/go\-live.
* Ability to negotiate, influence, and broker alignment across multiple stakeholders.



**Key Deliverables (Examples)** 



* Project charter, integrated plan, governance calendar, RAID log, and weekly/monthly status reports.
* Migration strategy and detailed cutover runbook (including rehearsal outcomes).
* Trial conversion results and reconciliation sign\-off packs.
* SIT/UAT/Parallel Run plans, defect dashboards, and final readiness assessment.
* Go\-live command center tracker and hypercare closure report.



**Stakeholders / Interfaces** 



* Cards Business/Product, Operations (billing/settlement/collections), IT delivery teams, Data/Integration teams.
* Vendors (CMS/VisionPLUS), scheme partners (Visa/Mastercard), and internal governance (PMO/SteerCo).

data.jd_text:
**In this role**
 The Intern Project Manager acts as the organizational core for our consultancy engagements. You will help move projects from the initial research phase through to final commercial advice, ensuring that the logic remains consistent and that every piece of information is ordered to help a board making a major decision in the Gulf region. This position is about managing the sequence of work and the clarity of data rather than just tracking tasks on a spreadsheet.
   

 Working closely with our senior team, you will witness how commercial calls are made in real time. Your contribution helps us maintain our standard of direct, jargon\-free advice by keeping project workstreams focused and evidence\-based. This is a fully remote role that requires a high degree of personal discipline and a serious approach to professional responsibility.
   

  

**About Gulf Associates**
 Gulf Associates is a management consultancy built around the commercial decisions that move enterprises forward in the Gulf region. We advise boards, family groups, and international investors on the choices that define their regional success, from market entry and complex partnerships to long\-term governance transitions. Our approach is direct. We focus on the commercial call itself rather than producing expansive reports. This means reading how counterparties and regulators actually behave and understanding the sequence of events over the coming years.
   

 Because we maintain a small book of active engagements, our senior team stays deeply involved in the work from first contact through to the commercial outcome. Every position at the firm is fully remote, allowing us to bring together specialists who understand different sectors and regional dynamics without being tied to a single physical hub. We look for people who prefer clear reasoning and who value the discipline of getting the job done right. Our culture is professional and discreet, reflecting the high\-stakes nature of the advice we provide to our clients.
   

  

**What you will do** 
* Draft concise briefs that summarize the current commercial environment for specific sectors across the region.
* Map counterparties and track their actions and statements within regional markets to build a profile of their behavior.
* Maintain the project timeline to ensure all preparation for client briefings happens according to our internal logic.
* Assist in the preparation of decision\-support materials that help clients understand the potential outcomes of their choices.
* Monitor regional news and regulatory updates to identify likely shifts in the business environment.
* Coordinate internal documentation to ensure all team members have access to the latest research and project notes.
* Support the senior advisory team by synthesizing complex data into simple, readable updates.


**What you bring** 
* A background in economics, political science, or business with a focus on how regional markets function.
* The ability to write clearly and professionally without relying on corporate buzzwords or filler.
* Natural attention to detail and an interest in how small events influence large commercial outcomes.
* A preference for logical thinking and the ability to organize multiple streams of information into a coherent order.
* The discipline required to work effectively in a fully remote environment without constant direct supervision.
* An understanding of the importance of discretion when handling sensitive commercial and legal information.
* A genuine interest in the long\-term economic development of the Gulf region and the role of sovereign capital.


**What the role offers** 
* A permanent, full\-time position in a fully remote working environment that offers geographic flexibility.
* Direct exposure to the decision\-making processes of senior commercial advisors and regional experts.
* A steep learning curve in the mechanics of regional expansion, partnership structures, and commercial diplomacy.
* A working culture that values clear logic and finished work over hours spent in unnecessary meetings.
* The opportunity to build a career in a specialized firm that handles high\-stakes challenges for sophisticated clients.


 Success at Gulf Associates is defined by the clarity of your work and your ability to look past the obvious. We expect our team to be grounded and serious about the advice we provide, as the decisions we help our clients make often involve significant capital and long\-term commitments. By focusing on the sequence of events and the behavior of counterparties, we help our clients achieve outcomes that are durable and commercially sound.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 To drive the delivery of a risk\-based Technology Audit portfolio, providing strategic assurance and insights that strengthen IT governance, controls, and business performance. The role leads complex technology audit engagements standalone or integrated with business audits, develops high\-performing teams, fosters collaboration, and ensures the Internal Audit function adds measurable value to organizational objectives.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Technology Audit and Advisory Delivery** 




  




* Supports with the technology component of a risk\-based IA plan by coordinating and managing the delivery of the IT risk assessment and annual planning activities. This involves proposing audit engagements for inclusion in IA plans, including the scope, timing, and required resources.
* Acts as the Engagement Manager\* for multiple or large integrated audit engagements concerning technology audit areas within the IA Department. Responsible for the day\-to\-day project management of the engagements across planning, fieldwork and reporting, ensuring delivery of high\-quality assurance and advice, on time and within allocated budget.
* Establishes and maintains regular coordination between the IA Director (or Executive Director), management and the engagement team on the
* progress of engagements, ensuring corrective actions are taken to address any identified issues impacting the engagement plan.
* Regularly monitors and reports on the progress of management action plans, facilitating the effective and timely implementation of management action plans. This involves guiding action owners (where necessary), challenging revised due dates, escalating overdue actions and managing the verification of closed actions.
* Supports and coach engagement teams throughout the engagement lifecycle, to facilitate the correct application of the IA methodology, and enhances the teams’ functional and leadership competencies.
* Supports the VP, Internal, IA Director (or Executive Director) with the delivery of their role, as delegated.
* Ensure delivery of high\-impact, risk\-based audits that enhance control effectiveness and strengthen control environment and organizational governance.



  





**IT Governance Framework, ERP and Data Analytics** 



* Evaluate the design and effectiveness of IT governance frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ISO 27001, ITIL etc.), ensuring alignment with organizational policies, regulatory expectations, and risk‑management objectives.
* Assess ERP environments (SAP S/4 Hana etc.) for configuration adequacy, access controls, change‑management practices, and process integrity across key business cycles.
* Perform technology risk assessments to identify control gaps, security vulnerabilities, and compliance issues within core IT processes and enterprise applications.
* Leverage data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Python) to perform automated testing, trend analysis, anomaly detection, and continuous\-monitoring routines.
* Develop sound audit findings and recommendations that strengthen IT controls, improve system performance, and enhance data reliability, while collaborating with stakeholders across IT, finance, and operations.



  





**Leadership** 



* Plans, manages, and reviews team performance to monitor achievement of key performance indicators.
* Provides timely feedback, coaching, and development to strengthen team capabilities.
* Proposes and implements initiatives aligned with the IA strategic direction.
* Leads or supports IA strategic initiatives and advocates for positive change in work practices.
* Build a high\-performing, future\-ready IA team aligned with strategic business goals.



  





**Quality \& Operations** 



* Ensures QAIP feedback is addressed effectively to enhance engagement quality and team capability.
* Promotes adherence to quality standards across all IA activities.
* Supports continuous improvement by identifying and implementing process enhancements and best practices.
* Drive culture of continuous improvement and excellence in audit execution.



  





**Business Partnering** 



* Builds and maintains strong client relationships to stay informed and aligned with evolving business needs.
* Develops cross\-functional relationships across TAQA to enable knowledge sharing within IA and across TAQA.
* Supports Directors at portfolio\-level reporting and insights, as required.
* Strengthen IA’s role as a trusted advisor and strategic business partner.



  





**Collaboration \& IA Strategy** 



* Shares knowledge and expertise across the IA team to enhance capability and consistency.
* Collaborates with peers and other IA teams to optimize resource use and deliver quality outcomes.
* Constructively challenges peers to enhance performance
* Recognize and celebrate collaborative behavior.
* Leverages IA Operations support to minimize administrative workload and improve efficiency.
* Foster collaborative, high\-performing culture that drives collective IA team success.
* Actively support in strategic initiatives implementation ensuring quality and timely completion of assigned tasks.



  





**Policies and Procedures** 



* Undertake all audit activities in line with IA’s policies and procedures.
* Ensure performed audit work comply with the pertinent internal audit P\&Ps and Global IIA Standards.
* Ensures consistent compliance for all assigned audit activities, reinforcing the credibility and reliability of the Internal Audit Function.



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* Professional certification: Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA),



 Certified Risk and Information System Controls (CRISC)
 



 Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
 



  





**Experience** 



* 8\-10\+ years of experience in leading technology audits or advisory in related areas. 3 to 4 years of leading audit teams.

**Market Development Lead**

**About the Role** 




 Beyon Connect is seeking a commercially driven Market Development Lead to own and progress growth opportunities across its digital platforms.
 



 Reporting to the Head of Market Development, the role is responsible for managing assigned accounts, qualifying and advancing pipeline opportunities, driving sector activation, and contributing directly to revenue growth across priority industries. The successful candidate will lead client engagement, shape commercial propositions, progress qualified opportunities through the sales cycle, and ensure effective transition from commercial discussions to execution and delivery.
 



 This is a client\-facing commercial role within a high\-profile digital organization, suited to someone who combines structured thinking, strong relationship\-building skills, commercial discipline, and the ability to move opportunities from identification through to revenue realization.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\.Account Ownership and Pipeline Development** 



* Own and manage selected client accounts within assigned sectors.
* Identify, qualify, and progress new commercial opportunities in line with business priorities.
* Maintain a disciplined view of account activity, pipeline status, next steps, and revenue potential.
* Lead structured client discussions and follow\-through across defined opportunities.
* Drive deal progression by coordinating internal inputs, resolving blockers, and maintaining momentum.
* Ensure opportunities are properly qualified, commercially viable, and aligned to strategic priorities.
* Contribute directly to revenue growth through account development, cross\-sell, upsell, and new opportunity conversion.



  





 2\.
 **Sector Activation and Commercial Execution** 



* Execute sector growth plans across priority industries and client segments.
* Translate sector opportunities into actionable account plans, commercial proposals, and delivery pathways.
* Develop pricing models, commercial frameworks, and business cases to support deal progression.
* Prepare commercial positioning, proposal, and negotiation materials.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth transition from commercial agreement to operational execution.
* Track progress against agreed commercial actions, client commitments, and delivery milestones.



  





**3\.Market Insight and Opportunity Structuring** 



* Conduct structured market, client, and competitive analysis to identify growth opportunities.
* Translate regulatory, sector, and industry dynamics into practical commercial recommendations.
* Assess client needs and align Beyon Connect solutions to relevant use cases and business outcomes.
* Support the development of sector\-level propositions that can be scaled across multiple accounts.
* Provide clear updates on pipeline movement, account priorities, and revenue opportunities to senior stakeholders.



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* Demonstrated experience in business development, account management, commercial strategy, consulting, project management, or client\-facing commercial roles.
* Strong understanding of pipeline management, opportunity qualification, and deal progression.
* Ability to take ownership of accounts and drive commercial follow\-through independently.
* Analytical and financial modelling capability.
* Comfortable leading client discussions independently within defined commercial parameters.
* Structured thinking and clear communication skills.
* Strong execution discipline and ability to coordinate across internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience in regulated industries preferred.
* Fluency in Arabic and English.



  





**Profile:** 



* Commercially minded, client\-focused, and growth\-oriented.
* Accountable for pipeline movement, client follow\-through, and revenue contribution.
* Comfortable operating between commercial strategy and hands\-on execution.
* Able to build trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Structured, proactive, and able to maintain momentum across multiple opportunities.
* Interested in developing long\-term sector expertise.



  





**Why Join Us:** 



* Direct exposure to sector\-level growth, client development, and nationally significant digital initiatives.
* Active ownership of accounts, pipeline opportunities, and commercial execution.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to revenue growth across regulated industries.
* Close collaboration with senior commercial leadership.
* High\-impact role within a fast\-growing and strategically important organization.

data.jd_text:
**About Keyrock**
 Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change\-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
   

  

 Today, we rock with over 180 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Brussels and Singapore, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
   

  

 We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well\-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high\-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks.
   

  

 But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We're pioneers in adopting the Rust development language for our algorithmic trading, and champions of its use in the industry. We support the growth of Web3 startups through our Accelerator Program. We upgrade ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
   

  

 At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
   

  

**Mission statement**
 The
 **Tech Lead** 
 plays a pivotal role in bridging
 **business objectives** 
 with
 **technical execution** 
 . This role is not purely managerial nor solely individual contributor, but a
 **hybrid position** 
 that combines
 **hands\-on engineering** 
 ,
 **architectural leadership** 
 , and
 **team enablement** 
 . A Tech Lead ensures delivery excellence by actively contributing to the codebase, guiding the team technically, and aligning execution with long\-term strategic goals.
   

  

 At Keyrock, the
 **Tech Lead** 
 is a
 **senior technical contributor** 
 who drives the
 **implementation and delivery** 
 of engineering initiatives within their Business Unit. The Tech Lead is accountable for
 **technical execution and delivery quality** 
 , ensuring that systems are built to high standards of reliability, performance, and maintainability.
   

  

 While the
 **Head of Engineering (HoE)** 
 focuses on
 **strategic alignment \-** 
 ensuring that engineering outcomes meet the broader objectives agreed with the
 **Head of Product (HoP) \-** 
 the Tech Lead operates as the
 **executional deputy** 
 , translating those strategic objectives into code, architecture, and delivery outcomes.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Act as the technical point of accountability for the Service Market Making Business Unit.
* Balance strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery, ensuring systems are built to last while meeting immediate needs.
* Champion collaboration across teams, ensuring alignment between product, design, QA, and engineering.
* Inspire and develop engineers through mentorship, coaching, and technical guidance, fostering growth and autonomy within the team.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Drive Delivery and Alignment: Partner with the Head of Engineering to own delivery of entire work\-streams, ensuring architecture and engineering decisions align with both immediate requirements and business strategy.
* Balance Code and Leadership: Contribute directly through coding, while also focusing on architecture design, peer reviews, and cross\-functional communication.
* Mentor and Elevate Engineers: Provide structured feedback through design and code reviews, support skill development, and empower junior and mid\-level engineers to take ownership.
* Technical Leadership: Guide system design, ensure scalability and resilience, and optimise performance across applications and infrastructure.
* Maintain Standards: Uphold engineering best practices, enforce coding guidelines, and partner with QA to embed automation and validation in the delivery pipeline.
* Codebase Health: Manage technical debt, lead refactoring initiatives, and ensure long\-term maintainability and operational excellence.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to define scope, refine requirements, and plan delivery in a transparent and predictable manner.
* Risk Management: Anticipate technical risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs early, and propose mitigations to safeguard delivery timelines.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years in a Technical Leadership position guiding teams, shaping architecture, and driving delivery of complex projects
* Demonstrated expertise in architecting and maintaining high\-concurrency, low\-latency trading systems at scale
* Advanced proficiency in Rust; working knowledge of Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript) and Python is an advantage
* Deep experience with data\-intensive architectures and real\-time data pipelines
* Proven track record deploying, optimising and operating AWS environments for ultra\-low\-latency workloads
* Hands\-on experience containerising applications and managing Kubernetes clusters in production
* Familiarity with GitOps workflows to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and deployments
* Solid command of software engineering best practices, including Agile methodologies, DevOps principles and end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines
* Knowledge of DevSecFinOps principles to embed security, compliance and cost\-governance throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Demonstrated leadership of engineering teams, with a commitment to fostering collaboration, mentorship and continuous professional growth
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills, able to partner effectively with Product, Architecture, Quantitative Research and Operations
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, with a passion for building scalable, reliable and secure systems
* Deep domain knowledge of finance and trading, particularly within the cryptocurrency sector
* Experience in fast\-paced, dynamic financial or fintech environments is highly desirable


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

 Soft Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Ownership \& Reliability – Take full responsibility for your work. Deliver high\-quality service, meet deadlines, and follow through on commitments. Anticipate and proactively address potential issues before they arise.
* Initiative \& Problem\-Solving – Approach challenges with a problem\-solving entrepreneurial mindset. Make sound, independent judgments and take the initiative to drive solutions rather than waiting for instructions.
* Operational Diligence – Respond strategically to technical and operational challenges, ensuring robust and reliable trading infrastructure while instilling confidence in the team’s processes.
* Curiosity \& Growth Mindset – Continuously seek to improve your technical skills and knowledge. Stay ahead of industry trends and take the initiative to practice and explore new technologies that excite you.
* Excellent Communication Skills with a team player mindset, collaborating within a fully remote global team.


 We would like the successful candidate to be based in the UK or Europe. Remote and flexible work options are available.
   

  

**Our recruitment philosophy**
 We value self\-awareness in our recruitment process. We seek people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
   

  

**Our offer**
* A competitive salary package, with various benefits depending on the method of engagement (employee or freelancer).
* Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
* The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence


 As an employer we are committed to build an inclusive, diverse and non\-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
   

  

 Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

data.jd_text:
We are seeking an exceptional Finance Director to serve as the principal financial confidant and strategic adviser within a dynamic entrepreneur's Private Office. This is a rare, standalone appointment offering unparalleled direct access and genuine influence at the very centre of a high\-profile individual's business and personal financial world.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Embedded within the Private Office and reporting exclusively to the principal, you will serve as the financial backbone of a fast\-moving entrepreneurial operation — spanning a diverse portfolio of business interests, personal wealth, and investment assets including property and tangibles. This is not a corporate finance role. You will operate with full independence from all existing business lines, acting as the principal's most trusted financial voice: candid, proactive, and wholly aligned to his interests.
 



  





 You will be an exceptionally competent accountant and expected to think and act like a true business partner — anticipating needs, identifying risks and opportunities, and bringing genuine commercial instinct to every interaction.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Act as the principal financial adviser across all private office matters, business interests, and personal wealth
* Own the consolidation and interpretation of financial data across a complex, multi\-entity portfolio — translating it into clear, actionable intelligence for the principal
* Provide proactive, commercially sharp advice on tax planning, cash management, and capital allocation
* Monitor performance across the portfolio, flagging issues and opportunities with candour and speed
* Oversee financial governance, reporting cadences, and controls appropriate to a private entrepreneurial structure
* Support deal evaluation, acquisitions, and new ventures as they arise — the principal moves quickly and expects his Finance Director to move with him
* Maintain absolute confidentiality and discretion across all matters at all times



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with substantial post\-qualification experience (min 10 years), ideally with exposure to private office, family office, or entrepreneurial environments
* A genuine entrepreneurial mindset — you thrive in ambiguity, move at pace, and are energised rather than unsettled by a principal who operates across multiple ventures simultaneously
* Proven experience providing financial counsel directly to a business owner, principal, or UHNW individual — not just reporting upwards within a large organisation
* Deep familiarity with complex, multi\-entity financial structures; comfortable across both corporate and personal financial matters
* Exceptional analytical capability combined with the judgement to know what matters and the confidence to say so plainly
* Outstanding interpersonal skills — this role demands a trusted relationship with a highly successful, highly demanding individual; you must be direct, reliable, and easy to work alongside
* Unimpeachable discretion; the handling of sensitive personal and commercial information is central to this role
* Self\-directing and highly organised — you will set your own agenda and be held accountable for outcomes, not activity

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

**Mandatory requirements:**
* Proven, hands\-on retail bank merger integration experience (Day 1 readiness through post\-merger stabilisation)
* Experience operating or establishing an Integration Management Office (IMO)
* English Fluency (\& Arabic Preferred)
* Immediately Available


**Purpose of Project:**
 As part of the retail bank merger, this role is responsible for owning and managing all technology and technical product elements of the integration programme. The Technical Product Manager bridges the gap between business integration objectives and technical execution — defining the technology roadmap, managing system integration work streams, and ensuring seamless delivery of core banking, digital, and data migration components across the merging entities.
   

  

**Key Activities:**
* Own the technology integration roadmap from discovery through to live cutover and post\-migration stabilisation
* Lead API mapping, system architecture design, and integration specifications across all platforms
* Manage core banking system integration, digital channel consolidation, data migration, and infrastructure cutover
* Coordinate with engineering teams, technology vendors, and business work stream leads to align technical deliverables to programme milestones
* Define and maintain integration playbooks, API specifications, technical run books, and cutover plans \[jobs.dcg.co]
* Monitor system performance (latency, reliability, transaction integrity) during and post\-integration


**Core Responsibilities:**
* Technology Strategy \& Roadmap Ownership — Define, own, and execute the technology integration strategy and product roadmap, aligning to the merger's business objectives, regulatory requirements, and IT architecture standards. Prioritise technology workstreams to maximise integration velocity and minimise customer disruption.
* Core Banking \& System Integration — Lead the integration of core banking platforms, digital channels, payment systems, and data infrastructure across the two merging entities. Manage vendor relationships with core banking providers, ensuring timely certifications and technical sign\-off at each integration milestone.
* Product Lifecycle Management (SDLC) — Drive end\-to\-end product delivery using Agile and SDLC best practices — from requirements gathering and technical design, through development, UAT, and live deployment. Maintain integration backlogs, sprint plans, and release schedules in tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Technical Communication — Act as the primary liaison between senior business stakeholders, engineering teams, IT vendors, and Compliance/Legal. Translate complex technical dependencies into business\-friendly language for SteerCo and executive audiences.
* Data Migration \& Quality Assurance — Oversee end\-to\-end data migration strategy, including data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, and post migration validation. Ensure data integrity and regulatory compliance (GDPR, local data residency laws) throughout.
* Risk, Performance \& Continuous Improvement — Identify, assess, and mitigate technology risks (integration failures, system downtime, data loss). Monitor live integration performance metrics and iterate rapidly to resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and SLA adherence post\-cutover.


**KPIs**
* % of technology milestones delivered on schedule and within budget
* System uptime and availability during cutover windows (target: 99\.9%\+)
* Data migration accuracy rate (target: 100% reconciled with zero data loss)
* Number of integration defects / severity\-1 incidents post\-cutover
* API integration delivery timelines vs. plan
* Time to complete core banking system cutover vs. target
* Business stakeholder satisfaction with technical delivery (SteerCo rating)


**Knowledge And Experience**
* 8\+ years of product management or technology delivery experience in fintech, banking, or financial services
* 3\+ years leading integrations with banks, payment processors, or core financial systems \[tealhq.com]
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of core banking platforms (e.g., Temenos T24, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Finacle, Mambu, Fiserv, Jack Henry)
* Expertise in payment rails: SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, RTP, and local real\-time payment schemes
* Experience with data architecture, pipelines, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Solid understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and DevOps practices \[jobs.anitab.org]
* Experience working in regulated banking environments — familiar with regulatory technology requirements and compliance obligations during system transitions


**Mandatory Skills\*\***
* Proven experience managing technology integration workstreams in a banking M\&A or large\-scale transformation context
* Hands\-on technical fluency with core banking platforms, APIs, and system architecture
* Track record of end\-to\-end product lifecycle management in regulated financial environments
* Familiarity with payment rails (SWIFT, ACH, local real\-time payment schemes), data migration, and digital channel consolidation
* Agile/SAFe certified (PMI\-ACP or equivalent); TOGAF or ITIL
