**About Becurious Preschool**
 https://becurious.odoo.com/jobs/director\-of\-operations\-47
   

  

 BeCurious is a premium Finnish\-method preschool operating across three branches in Kuwait — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa. Founded on the principle that curiosity is the most powerful force in early childhood learning, BeCurious has built a proprietary curriculum framework, a structured operating system, and a community of families who choose us for the quality of thinking behind everything we do.
   

  

 We are growing. We are building. And we are looking for the person who will run the engine.
   

  

**The Role**
* The Director of Operations is the operational backbone of BeCurious.
* This is not a coordination role. It is not a support role. The DOO is the person who makes sure that every session in every branch is delivered at the BeCurious standard — consistently, day after day, across all three locations.
* The DOO sits between the General Manager (who sets direction and owns the brand) and the Branch Supervisors (who run daily operations). Everything that matters operationally flows through this role.
* This role is right for you if you have a genuine love for early childhood education, a precise and organized mind, and the ability to hold a high standard without rigidity. You must be comfortable holding people accountable with warmth — not through fear, and not by doing their job for them.


**Responsibilities**
* Operations — Three Branches, One Standard:
* Own the daily operational standard across all three branches — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa.
* Conduct monthly Branch Reviews with each Branch Supervisor (08\.1\) — reviewing KPIs, flagging patterns, agreeing action plans.
* Ensure every SOP in the BeCurious OS is being followed at branch level — and escalate deviations immediately.
* Manage the scheduling system — session allocation, teacher assignment, Home Preschool routing during continuity periods.
* Own the Feedback Log (08\.4\) — capture, categorize, and respond to all feedback across branches.
* Lead the Quarterly SOP Review (08\.2\) with the GM — identifying what is working, what needs updating, what needs a rebuild.
* Ensure branch readiness for Ministry inspections at all times — not just before announced visits.


**Team And Teaching Quality**
* Line manage Branch Supervisors — three direct reports. Support them. Challenge them. Hold them to the standard.
* Ensure all teaching staff are progressing through the Teacher Training Framework (02\.1\) at the required pace for their role.
* Conduct or coordinate classroom observations at minimum once per quarter per branch (03\.8 Classroom Observation Guide).
* Own the teacher evaluation process (04\.3\) — ensure evaluations are completed on schedule and that feedback leads to action
* Identify teaching staff who are ready to grow and flag them to the GM. Identify those who are struggling and build a support plan.
* Ensure no teacher leads a session alone without completing the required training stage for their role.


**Admissions And Enrollment**
* Own the admissions pipeline across all branches in Odoo — lead stages, conversion rates, follow\-up discipline.
* Oversee the Admissions Coordinator role — review their performance, support their work, escalate decisions that require GM involvement.
* Monitor enrollment capacity across branches — flag when a branch is approaching capacity or running below target.
* Ensure every family completing a tour receives a structured follow\-up within the required SOP timeframe.
* Review lead\-to\-tour and tour\-to\-enrollment conversion rates monthly — identify patterns and surface them to the GM.


**Curriculum And Learning Quality**
* Ensure monthly theme plans are submitted by Lead Teachers on schedule and reviewed before the month begins.
* Ensure weekly planning documents (03\.3\) are completed and filed — not treated as optional paperwork.
* Monitor child observation records (03\.7\) for consistency and quality — flag teachers who are not completing them.
* Ensure the Curiosity Lens Framework is visible in classroom practice — not just in documentation.
* Coordinate with the GM on curriculum development priorities for the year.


**Governance And Reporting**
* Attend the Weekly Leadership Meeting every Monday — present the Weekly Scorecard (09\.3\) and surface decisions that require GM input.
* Ensure the OS Change Log (00\) is updated whenever an SOP, template, or standard is modified.
* Manage incident documentation — ensure every incident has a completed 07\.5 Incident Report filed within 24 hours.
* Maintain the staff register in Odoo — civil IDs, health certificates, first aid certifications current for all staff at all times.
* Support the GM in preparing for the Annual Blueprint Review (08\.3\) — compiling the years evidence and identifying structural questions.


**What This Role Is Not**
* The DOO does not teach classes. This is a leadership and operational role.
* The DOO does not bypass Branch Supervisors to manage teachers directly — the chain of command is respected in both directions.
* The DOO does not make brand decisions — that is the GM's domain. The DOO executes brand standards. They do not change them.
* The DOO does not have financial signing authority above the limits in the authority matrix (04\.0\). Spending decisions above those limits go to the GM.
* The DOO's job is to make the standard work at scale. Not to be liked by everyone. Not to avoid difficult conversations. To make BeCurious excellent, consistently, across three branches.


**You Are The Right Person If**
**You will thrive in this role if you** 
 \|
 **This role is not right for you if you:**
* Have genuine experience in early childhood education or school operations — at least 4 years \| Are looking for a purely administrative or desk\-based role.
* Have managed a team before and understand that management means accountability, not friendship \| Expect to be liked by everyone you hold to a standard.
* Are organized to a degree that other people find remarkable — you track details without being reminded \| Find systematic documentation burdensome rather than protective.
* Can hold a high standard with warmth — you challenge people without humiliating them \| Prefer to avoid difficult conversations until they become crises.
* Are bilingual Arabic\-English — you operate at full professional quality in both languages \| Cannot communicate fluently and professionally in Arabic.
* Believe that curiosity in children is worth protecting — this is not a generic school for you \| See early childhood as a stepping stone to a different field.
* Understand that a system is what makes quality scalable — and you want to build that system \| Prefer to rely on improvisation and personal judgment over documented process.


**Required**
**Qualifications and Experience:**
* Minimum 4 years of experience in early childhood education, preschool management, or educational operations.
* Demonstrated experience managing a team — minimum 3 direct reports.
* Bilingual Arabic and English — professional fluency in both.
* Practical experience with a school management system (Odoo, Brightwheel, or equivalent).
* Based in Kuwait or able to relocate immediately — this is a full presence role across three branches.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Bachelor's degree in Early Childhood Education, Educational Leadership, or Business Administration.
* Experience with Finnish or play\-based education methodology.
* Experience leading or contributing to a curriculum quality review process.
* Experience with the Kuwait Ministry of Social Affairs licensing and inspection process.
* Demonstrated track record of improving operational consistency in a multi\-site environment.


**What BeCurious Offers**
**What You Get \| Detail:**
* A real leadership role \| Not a coordinator title with manager responsibilities. The DOO has genuine authority and is expected to use it.
* A built operating system \| BeCurious has a documented OS — SOPs, templates, review cycles, governance. You are inheriting a system and improving it. You are not building from nothing.
* Direct access to the founder \| Weekly leadership meeting with the Strategic Head and General Manager. Your voice shapes what BeCurious becomes.
* A curriculum you can believe in \| The Curiosity Lens Framework is a genuine educational philosophy. This is not a franchise curriculum or a generic play programme.
* Compensation \| Competitive, commensurate with experience. Discussed at the offer stage.
* Growth \| As BeCurious grows — more branches, Club, Camp — the DOO role grows with it. The person who builds the operational foundation at this stage has a significant role in the next one.


**How to Apply?**
 Send your CV and a short cover note (no more than one page) to the BeCurious HR Lead. In your cover note, answer one question: 'What does operational excellence look like in an early childhood setting, and how have you contributed to it?'
   

  

 We do not require a formal cover letter. We require a genuine answer to that question. Applications without a response to the question will not be reviewed.
   

  

 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
   

  

* First stage: written review of CV and cover note.
* Second stage: structured conversation with the General Manager.
* Third stage: structured conversation with the Strategic Head.
* Final stage: offer and reference check.


 We move fast for the right person.
   

  

**About Emerge General Contracting Company**
 BeCurious is a Finnish\-inspired, play\-based preschool in Kuwait where children learn by doing, imagining, and exploring. We create joyful, inclusive classrooms and partner closely with families to help every child feel seen and thrive. As a team member, you’ll design hands\-on learning experiences, nurture curiosity and character, and work within a warm, supportive culture that celebrates each child’s uniqueness. If you’re caring, creative, and collaborative, you’ll feel right at home with us.

**Building on our past. Ready for the future**

**About The Job**
 We’re looking for a Leader, Construction / Construction Project Manager to join our Ahmadi, Kuwait team. Be a part of Worley's dynamic team as we extend our management of the KERP program for another five years. With million m2 of land successfully cleared from contamination and million tons remediated, we're leading the charge in sustainable environmental restoration. Join us and contribute to this incredible journey of transforming contaminated sites into thriving ecosystems.
   

  

 When you work for us, you get the chance to join nearly 50,000 people all driven by a common purpose – delivering a more sustainable world. We’re excited about the challenges ahead. If you ask us, there’s never been a more rewarding time to work in the energy, chemical and resources sectors.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Management, control, coordination and supervision services as well as assistance for the assigned project inclusive of budget formulation, cost control and quality assurance.
* Management of support services for supervising and directing engineering, procurement and management of construction contractors appointed by the Client.
* Management of services for Oil \& Gas production activities including start\-up and initial operations assistance as well as operational personnel and systems as required by the Client.
* Reports to the Line Manager and is authorized to deputize for him during his absence with a proven track record of managing multi\-projects in general and Design \& Engineering and Construction function in particular, in the oil and gas industry
* Is responsible for developing the overall strategy for soil remediation in the assigned areas, it includes contracting strategies and management of contractors.
* Manage and coordinate multidiscipline engineering activities to ensure projects such as FEED (front end engineering design) studies and preparation, ITB (invitation to bid) check estimate preparation, LSTK (lump sum turnkey) tender package preparation are executed in a safe, efficient, cost effective and timely manner.
* Act as primary technical coordination interface with client to ensure that the client’s expectations are satisfied.
* Ensure the project conforms to the client’s approved Basis of Design and all applicable regulatory and code requirements.
* We’re looking for a Leader, Construction / Construction Project Manager to join our Ahmadi, Kuwait team. Be a part of Worley's dynamic team as we extend our management of the KERP program for another five years. With million m2 of land successfully cleared from contamination and million tons remediated, we're leading the charge in sustainable environmental restoration. Join us and contribute to this incredible journey of transforming contaminated sites into thriving ecosystems.
* When you work for us, you get the chance to join nearly 50,000 people all driven by a common purpose – delivering a more sustainable world. We’re excited about the challenges ahead. If you ask us, there’s never been a more rewarding time to work in the energy, chemical and resources sector


**What You'll Have**
**HSE Management**
* Maintains HSE focus within the team to ensure OHSE requirements included in design and procurement.


**Client Relationships**
* Maintains and builds healthy client relationships.
* Proactively resolves performance, scope and schedule issues with the Client as they arises
* Identifies, documents, communicates and meets the client’s requirements


**Scope Management**
* Compliance with WPMP (Worley Project Management Plan)
* Compliance with requirements of the contract.
* Effective change control process application.
* Achievement of claims mitigation and claims management if appropriate.


**Cost Control**
* Monitors cost aspects of the project within direct control to forecast final costs, identifies trends and takes action to avoid cost overruns.
* Promotes implementation of VIP (value improving practices) on the assigned project to achieve overall effectiveness of the use of capital on projects.


**Quality Management**
* Contributes to compliance with Worley policies and procedures.
* Strong working knowledge of Worley engineering and procurement systems and procedures.


**Team Management**
* Focuses team on achievement of milestones and other key project objectives.
* Listens to the team, discusses the issues, resolves problems and directs activities to remove roadblocks and achieve objectives.


**Design Management**
* Sets clear objectives to the design team, including achieving productivity and budget targets.
* Ensures design team aware of, and complies with, applicable regulations and codes.
* Manages inter\-discipline interfaces effectively.


**About You**
 You will have Bachelor's degree in Engineering with a remarkable year of experience.
   

  

* Remarkable year of experience.
* You are an individual who is self\-motivated, proactive, and works well with a team.
* You will be seen as the Subject matter specialist for the resolution of issues arising across all areas of the job and be able to clearly explain complex processes that surround the role.
* We expect you to ensure the integrity of the work scope and that all work is carried\-out in accordance with applicable codes and standards.
* We expect you to mentor of less experienced members of staff including ‘hands on’ approach to the formulation and delivery of training programs for local Kuwaiti personnel.


**Why you should apply**
* Providing an agile culture and challenging work opportunities results in a positive work environment. Our people enjoy competitive compensation packages and a fun, personal, collaborative and safe working environment. We value equal employment opportunity and are committed to promoting fairness, equality and diversity.
* Our policy is to conduct background checks for all candidates who accept an offer of employment with us.


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The AI Solution/Platform Architect defines technical solution designs and ensures alignment with Group AI reference architecture across all AI initiatives. This role conducts architecture reviews, provides design guidance to delivery teams, resolves complex technical dependencies, and ensures OpCo implementations comply with Group standards. The Architect partners with the Director, Tech \& Platforms on platform strategy and reference architecture evolution, engages with OpCo technical teams on solution design, and serves as the technical escalation point for delivery teams. This role requires deep understanding of AI architectures, enterprise integration patterns, and the ability to balance technical purity with pragmatic business constraints in a federated organization.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* Design end\-to\-end technical solutions for AI use cases ensuring alignment with Group reference architecture
* Conduct architecture reviews and provide design guidance to delivery teams and OpCo technical staff
* Resolve complex technical dependencies across enterprise systems, data sources, and platforms
* Ensure OpCo AI implementations comply with Group architecture standards or have documented exceptions
* Partner with Director, Tech \& Platforms on reference architecture definition and evolution
* Define integration patterns for AI systems with enterprise platforms (CRM, BSS/OSS, data platforms)
* Support platform evaluation and vendor selection with technical due diligence and architecture assessment
* Create architecture blueprints, design patterns, and technical reference materials for reuse
* Serve as technical escalation point for delivery teams on complex architecture challenges
* Engage with OpCo architects and technical leads to drive architecture alignment and knowledge sharing


**KPIs Include But Are Not Limited To**
* Architecture compliance: percentage of solutions compliant with reference architecture
* Design quality: solution architecture quality as measured by peer reviews and production issues
* Reusability: number of reusable patterns and accelerators created and adopted
* OpCo alignment: percentage of OpCos aligned to Group architecture standards
* Technical escalation resolution: time to resolve complex architecture issues


 What We Need From You
   

  

 Educational Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.
   

  

 Experience: 10\+ years in technology roles with 5\+ years in solution architecture or enterprise architecture. Experience designing AI/ML solutions, enterprise integrations, and cloud architectures. Background in telecom BSS/OSS systems or complex regulated industries valuable.
   

  

 Knowledge: Deep understanding of AI/ML architectures (GenAI, traditional ML, automation), enterprise integration patterns, cloud platforms, and data architectures. Experience with architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman) and governance. Strong communication skills to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
   

  

**About Application Process**
 If you meet the criteria and you are enthusiastic about the role, we would welcome your application. To complete the application you would need the following document(s):
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Passport\-size photograph
* Highest Education Qualification

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Department: Center of Continuing Education**
**Reports to:** 
**Director \- CCE**
**Scope And Purpose**
 Center for Continuing Education (CCE) is committed to providing a wide range of professional development courses, training workshops, certificate programs, and customized corporate training solutions designed to meet the needs of individuals, businesses, and the community. By partnering with international certifying bodies and industry experts, the Center ensures that its programs are globally relevant, innovative, and aligned with labor market demands.
   

  

 The Training Operation Officer supports the effective delivery of CCE programs and training services by managing daily operational, logistical, and administrative processes. This role ensures that classes, instructors, and facilities are efficiently scheduled and prepared, that quality standards are consistently maintained, and that all post\-training documentation and reports are accurately completed. Working closely with the Team leader \- Training operation \& testing and the CCE Director, the training operations officer plays a key role in ensuring a seamless learning experience for participants and operational excellence across all CCE activities.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Coordinate Training Operations: Plan and manage the scheduling and setup of CCE training programs, ensuring all logistical, technical, and material requirements are met.
* Administer CCE Systems, Data, and Operational Schedules: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records within CCE’s management systems, including product sheets, class openings, participant and instructor data, and operational reports. Develop and monitor the annual training calendar, trainers’ schedules, and classroom allocations to ensure effective resource management, operational efficiency, and accurate reporting.
* Monitor Quality and Service Standards:Oversee training delivery and gather feedback from participants and instructors to uphold CCE’s quality benchmarks.
* Support Instructors and Participants:Communicate essential course information, coordinate instructor schedules, and provide responsive support to ensure a positive learning experience.
* Oversee Facilities and Logistics:Ensure training venues, equipment, and course materials are properly arranged and maintained to create an effective learning environment.
* Maintain Administrative Efficiency:Process course\-related forms, certificates, cancellations, and transfers promptly to ensure compliance and smooth program operations.
* Manage Testing Center Operations: Coordinate scheduling, setup, and supervision of CCE testing activities, ensuring proper administration of exams, adherence to testing protocols, and maintenance of a secure and professional testing environment.
* Process Trainer Payments and Financial Requisitions: Prepare and process trainer payment requests \& handle BC petty cash advances.


**Qualifications**
**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Education, Management Information Systems, or a related field is required.


**Experience**
* Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in training administration, program coordination, or operation management, preferably within a university, continuing education, or professional training enviroment.
* Demonstrated experience managing trainign logistics, scheduling course setup, and reporting systems.
* Experience with testing center operations,including exam scheduling, supervision, and compliance with testing protocols, is highly desirable.


**Key Competencies**
* Administration: Effectively plans and coordinates tasks, resources, and schedules to ensure smooth execution of training and testing activities.
* Quality Management: Maintains high standards of accuracy and thoroughness in all operational and administrative processes.
* Applying Technology: Demonstrates proficiency in CCE systems, digital tools, and IT processes required for training delivery and reporting.
* Process Excellence: Understands, follows, and improves operational workflows to enhance efficiency and service quality.
* Information and Data Management: Collects, organizes, and analyzes data to generate accurate reports that support decision\-making and performance tracking.
* Office Management: Manages physical and digital resources—such as training rooms, materials, and equipment—to ensure readiness and proper utilization.
* Communication Skills: Communicates clearly, respectfully, and effectively with colleagues, trainers, and learners to foster collaboration and understanding.
* Service Orientation: Demonstrates commitment to providing high\-quality service to internal and external stakeholders through responsiveness and professionalism.
* Accountability: Takes ownership of responsibilities, delivers on commitments, and ensures consistent performance and dependability.
* Teamwork: Works cooperatively with others across departments to achieve shared goals and support organizational effectiveness.
* Adaptability: Responds positively to change, adjusting priorities and approaches to meet evolving operational and institutional needs.
* Self Management: Seeks opportunities to enhance personal effectiveness, update knowledge, and contribute to process improvement within the CCE.


**Certifications (preferred)**
* Project Management certification.
* Training Administration or Learning Management Systems (LMS)certification.
* Customer Service or Quality Management certification.
* Information Technology proficiency certification.

**About BeCurious**
 BeCurious is a premium Finnish\-method preschool operating across three branches in Kuwait — Salam, Shuhada, and Salwa. Built on the belief that curiosity drives learning, BeCurious combines a strong curriculum with a structured operating system.
   

  

 Each branch must operate at the same standard — every day, in every classroom. The Branch Manager is the person who makes that real on the ground.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Branch Manager owns the day\-to\-day operation of one BeCurious branch.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is not administrative oversight. The Branch Manager ensures that every session, every teacher, and every family experience meets the BeCurious standard — consistently, without exception.
   

  

 You are responsible for execution. What is designed at system level must work in your branch — through people, discipline, and attention to detail.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Daily Operations — One Branch, Full Standard:
   

  

* Own the daily running of the branch from opening to closing.
* Ensure all sessions run on time and to standard.
* Execute all SOPs exactly as designed in the BeCurious OS.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and fully prepared environment at all times.
* Ensure readiness for inspections at any time.


**Team Management**
* Manage all teachers and support staff within the branch.
* Lead daily briefings and ensure team alignment.
* Hold staff accountable to performance standards.
* Support teacher development through coaching and feedback.
* Ensure no teacher leads a session without required training completion.


**Teaching \& Classroom Quality**
* Monitor classroom delivery daily.
* Conduct regular classroom observations.
* Ensure lesson plans and weekly planning are completed and followed.
* Ensure child observation records are completed properly.
* Maintain visible application of the Curiosity Lens Framework.


**Parent Experience**
* Ensure a high\-quality, consistent parent experience.
* Handle parent concerns professionally and promptly.
* Ensure proper communication standards are followed.
* Support tours and convert interest into enrollment in coordination with Admissions.


**Admissions Support**
* Support branch\-level enrollment targets.
* Ensure tour readiness and professional delivery.
* Follow up with prospective families when required.
* Maintain accurate information flow to the admissions system.


**Inventory \& Supplies**
* Monitor branch\-level inventory and usage.
* Coordinate with Purchasing Manager for supply needs.
* Ensure materials are available and organized for all sessions.
* Reporting \& Compliance.
* Report daily and weekly updates to Director of Operations.
* Maintain accurate records (attendance, incidents, staff data)
* Ensure incident reports are completed within required timelines.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements.


**What This Role Is Not**
* The Branch Manager does not operate without structure — SOPs are followed, not reinvented.
* This is not a passive supervisory role — you are actively managing every day.
* The Branch Manager does not avoid accountability conversations.
* This role is not about being liked — it is about maintaining standards.


**You Are The Right Person If**
 You will thrive in this role if you:
   

  

* Are highly organized and present on the floor.
* Can manage people with clarity and firmness.
* Pay attention to detail others miss.
* Take full ownership of outcomes, not excuses.
* Can maintain energy and consistency every day.


**This Role Is Not Right For You If You**
* Prefer planning over execution.
* Avoid difficult conversations with staff or parents.
* Struggle with structure and process discipline.
* Need constant direction instead of taking ownership.


**Required**
**Qualifications and Experience:**
* Minimum 3–5 years experience in education, preschool, or operations.
* Experience managing a team.
* Strong organizational and leadership skills.
* Arabic and English proficiency.
* Based in Kuwait or able to relocate immediately.


**Preferred**
* Experience in early childhood education.
* Experience in a structured, multi\-branch environment.
* Familiarity with school systems (Odoo, Brightwheel, etc.).


**What BeCurious Offers**
* A clear operating system — you execute with clarity, not guesswork.
* A real leadership role at branch level.
* Direct impact on children, families, and team quality.
* Growth as the organization expands.
* Compensation.
* Competitive, based on experience. Discussed at offer stage.


**How To Apply**
* Send your CV and a short note answering:
* “What does a high\-performing branch look like in a preschool, and how have you contributed to it?”
* Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

 BeCurious is a Finnish\-inspired, play\-based preschool in Kuwait where children learn by doing, imagining, and exploring. We create joyful, inclusive classrooms and partner closely with families to help every child feel seen and thrive. As a team member, you’ll design hands\-on learning experiences, nurture curiosity and character, and work within a warm, supportive culture that celebrates each child’s uniqueness. data.jd_text:
**Position Overview**




 We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Lighting Sales Manager with a strong background in managing medium and large\-scale lighting projects across Kuwait. The ideal candidate will have well\-established relationships with engineering consultants, main contractors, and end clients, and will be capable of leading a sales team while personally driving key account development. You will take ownership of the full project sales cycle — from early specification influence through to order closure and delivery coordination.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Sales Leadership \& Strategy** 



* Develop and execute a structured sales strategy for lighting projects aligned with the company's annual revenue targets and growth objectives.
* Lead, mentor, and manage the lighting sales team, setting individual targets and conducting regular performance reviews.
* Report weekly and monthly project pipeline status and sales performance directly to the Managing Director.



**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with key engineering consultants, MEP contractors, main contractors, interior designers, and project owners across Kuwait.
* Conduct regular client visits, site surveys, and design\-stage meetings to influence lighting specifications in favour of the company's portfolio.
* Act as a senior point of contact for key accounts, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction and repeat business.



**Technical \& Commercial Sales** 



* Prepare and present detailed technical proposals, lighting design concepts, and commercial quotations tailored to project requirements and budgets.
* Review tender documents, BOQs, and consultant specifications to ensure correct product selection and full compliance.
* Negotiate pricing, contract terms, and supply agreements with clients, contractors, and manufacturers to close orders profitably.
* Collaborate with manufacturer representatives and technical teams to deliver customised lighting solutions, mock\-ups, and value\-engineering alternatives.



**Project Execution \& Coordination** 



* Oversee order handling, delivery scheduling, and documentation (product data sheets, photometric reports, warranties, and certifications) to ensure on\-time project delivery.
* Monitor active projects to ensure alignment with client timelines, budget constraints, and technical specifications.
* Resolve post\-sale technical issues and coordinate with suppliers to manage warranties, replacements, and site support.



**Market Intelligence \& Business Development** 



* Identify and pursue new project opportunities in commercial, hospitality, retail, government, healthcare, and infrastructure segments across Kuwait.
* Conduct ongoing market research to track competitor activity, new project awards, and emerging lighting technology trends.
* Evaluate and expand the company's lighting product portfolio in response to market demand and project requirements.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements**



* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Architecture, or a related discipline (preferred).
* Minimum 8 years of lighting project sales experience in Kuwait, with a demonstrated track record of managing medium and large\-scale projects from specification to delivery.
* Strong existing network of relationships with engineering consultants, MEP contractors, and procurement decision\-makers in the Kuwait market.
* Proficiency in lighting design and calculation software (DIALux, Relux, or equivalent) is a strong advantage.
* Solid commercial acumen with experience in tender preparation, BOQ analysis, and contract negotiation.
* Prior experience in a managerial or team\-lead sales capacity.
* Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English
* Valid Kuwait driving licence; must be based in Kuwait with a transferable residency visa.

* Review and assess the regulatory circulars/notices, discuss with GSO\-HO and enforce security controls as applicable.

* Experience in managing security compliance teams.
* Knowledge of CBK regulatios on Cyber security, Business continuity, \& local privacy regulations.
* Ability to comply with Data Privacy Policy / procedures, draft / update local Data Privacy Polcies. Review local Business initiatives and SOPs where required, for compliance with Data Privacy Compliance requirements in co\-ordination with H.O. Teams.
* Ability to make good judgments regarding security risk and to prioritize resources and activity around managing those risks.
* Able to conduct the role independently and with integrity.
* Ability to plan, organize and prioritize tasks and projects.
* Good personal communication skills capable of dealing with wide range of stakeholders, including senior management.
* Fluent (spoken and written) in English, Arabic.

**About ZAD** 




 ZAD is a Kuwaiti fintech company regulated by the Capital Markets Authority (CMA). Our mobile platform lets users buy and sell US\-listed stocks and ETFs. With over 60 professionals in Kuwait and a Product team in Turkey, we are one of the region’s fastest\-growing capital markets platforms. As we prepare to launch the local Kuwait Stock Exchange offering, we are building the leadership team that will take ZAD to the next level.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Finance Director is a strategic leadership role at the heart of ZAD’s growth. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will own the full financial function of a CMA\-regulated fintech company — from day\-to\-day operations and regulatory reporting through to financial strategy, investor relations and capital planning.
 



 This is a role for a seasoned finance leader who is comfortable operating at both the strategic and operational level, who understands the regulatory nuances of the Kuwaiti capital markets environment, and who can build and lead a high\-performing finance function as the company scales.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Financial Strategy and Leadership** 



* Define and execute ZAD’s financial strategy in alignment with the company’s growth ambitions and the CEO’s vision
* Serve as a key strategic advisor to the CEO and executive leadership on all financial matters
* Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and long\-range modeling
* Build, manage and develop a high\-performing finance team as the company grows



  





**CMA Regulatory Compliance and Reporting** 



* Own ZAD’s compliance with all Capital Markets Authority (CMA) financial reporting requirements
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of all regulatory filings, disclosures and returns
* Stay current on CMA regulations, circulars and policy changes and proactively adapt internal controls accordingly
* Lead relationships with the CMA, external auditors and legal counsel on regulatory matters



  





**Financial Operations and Controls** 



* Oversee all financial operations including reconciliation, treasury, cash management and banking relationships
* Implement and maintain a robust internal control environment appropriate for a regulated financial institution
* Manage risk exposure across currency, liquidity and operational finance
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of all financial data and reporting systems



  





**Financial Reporting and Investor Relations** 



* Prepare and present financial statements, management accounts and board reporting packs
* Lead investor relations from a financial standpoint, including reporting, communications and due diligence support
* Support fundraising, capital raises and any M\&A activity with financial modeling and analysis
* Deliver clear, actionable financial insights to the board and CEO



  





**Process, Systems and Scalability** 



* Lead the design and implementation of scalable financial systems, processes and technology
* Identify and eliminate inefficiencies across the finance function
* Partner with Technology and Operations on system integrations that affect financial data flows
* Support the rollout of new products and markets with robust financial infrastructure



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 




**Required** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field
* 12\+ years of progressive finance experience, including at least 3 years in a senior leadership role
* Deep knowledge of Capital Markets Authority regulations and financial compliance requirements in Kuwait
* Proven experience in a regulated financial services, fintech, brokerage or capital markets environment
* Strong command of financial reporting, treasury, budgeting and internal controls
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop finance teams
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at board and executive level



  





**Preferred** 



* Professional qualification: CFA, CPA, ACCA, CA or equivalent
* Experience working with or reporting to the Kuwait Capital Markets Authority (CMA)
* Exposure to US\-listed equities, ETFs or multi\-market capital markets platforms
* Experience supporting fundraising, investor relations or M\&A processes
* Strong Arabic and English language skills



  





**Leadership Competencies** 




**Competency** 




**What We Look For** 




**Strategic Thinking** 




 Connects financial decisions to long\-term business outcomes and company direction
 



**Regulatory Expertise** 




 Deep, current knowledge of CMA requirements applied proactively, not reactively
 



**Executive Presence** 




 Credible, clear and concise communicator with boards, investors and regulators
 



**Leadership** 




 Builds and retains strong teams, creates accountability and develops talent
 



**Analytical Rigor** 




 Data\-driven decision maker who can translate complex financials into clear business narrative
 



**Integrity** 




 Uncompromising standards of accuracy, ethics and transparency in a regulated environment
 



**Adaptability** 




 Comfortable leading in a high\-growth, fast\-moving fintech environment with evolving priorities
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* A C\-suite adjacent leadership role with direct access to the CEO and founders
* Real ownership of the finance function in a CMA\-regulated fintech at a pivotal growth stage
* The opportunity to shape ZAD’s financial strategy
* A high\-caliber, collaborative team that values precision, initiative and long\-term thinking
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with seniority and experience



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your CV and a brief cover note explaining why this role is the right fit to:
 



**careers@joinzad.com** 




 Please include “Finance Director” in the subject line.

data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 The Director, Tech \& Platforms serves as the technical co\-leader of the AI Center of Excellence, owning the architecture, platforms, and engineering foundations that enable AI at scale across Zain Group. This director\-level role engages as a peer with Group technology directors (CTO, IT, Data, Security) and OpCo AI Office Heads to set technical strategy, enforce architecture standards, and ensure production\-ready AI systems. The Director defines Zain's AI reference architecture, leads platform selection and vendor management, establishes engineering practices, and builds internal technical capability. This role requires deep AI/ML platform expertise, enterprise architecture leadership, and the executive presence to influence senior stakeholders across a federated organization.
   

  

 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* Define and maintain Group AI reference architecture for GenAI, Agentic AI, ML, and intelligent automation
* Own AI platform strategy and service catalog including LLM platforms, orchestration, MLOps, and data platforms
* Lead platform evaluation, vendor selection, commercial negotiations, and implementation oversight
* Establish and enforce technical standards for AI delivery including coding practices, deployment patterns, and monitoring
* Chair Group AI Architecture Review Board with OpCo CTO/IT directors to drive alignment and manage exceptions
* Enable delivery teams with proven engineering practices, tooling, accelerators, and technical problem\-solving
* Define and oversee AI production operations including SLAs, monitoring, incident management, and continuous improvement
* Partner with Group CTO, IT, Data, and Security directors on platform integration, infrastructure, and compliance
* Serve as technical peer to 6 OpCo AI Office Heads for architecture guidance and cross\-OpCo alignment
* Build and develop high\-performing technical team of architects and engineers
* Manage structured knowledge transfer from Strategy\& and delivery partners to build internal capability


**KPIs Can Include But Are Not Limited To**
* Platform adoption: percentage of OpCos using shared Group AI platforms
* Time\-to\-production: average time from use case approval to production deployment
* Architecture compliance: percentage of initiatives aligned to reference architecture
* System reliability: uptime and performance of AI platforms meeting defined SLAs
* Internal capability: percentage of use cases delivered by internal team vs. external vendors


 What We Need From You
   

  

 Educational Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field. Master's degree in AI/ML, Data Science, or Computer Science preferred.
   

  

 Experience: 15\+ years in technology leadership roles with progression from engineering to architecture to leadership. Experience building and operating AI/ML platforms at enterprise scale, designing reference architectures, and leading technical teams in federated organizations. Telecom or complex regulated industry experience highly valuable.
   

  

 Knowledge: Deep expertise in GenAI/Agentic AI, MLOps/LLMOps, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), data platforms, and enterprise integration. Strong understanding of architecture governance, platform operations, and vendor management. Experience with telecom BSS/OSS systems advantageous.
   

  

**About Application Process**
 If you meet the criteria and you are enthusiastic about the role, we would welcome your application. To complete the application you would need the following document(s):
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Passport\-size photograph
* Highest Education Qualification

data.jd_text:
This role drives the overall strategy of the Directorate and oversees finance and investment operations. It achieves this by cascading strategic objectives to ensure sound and accurate financial reporting, well\-informed board decision\-making, effective implementation of financial and investment strategies, and the development of sustainable budgets. Additionally, this role guides the procurement strategy, oversees the collection of shareholder contributions, evaluates and advises on investment strategies, and strives to optimize return on investment.
 



  





**Key Duties \& Responsibilities** 




**Strategic Formulation** 



* Guide the development and execution of the Finance \& Investment Directorate's strategy in alignment with the organization’s short\-, medium\-, and long\-term goals.
* Develop and track primary goals, strategic objectives, KPIs, and business plans to ensure alignment with organizational strategy.
* Develop the annual workplan and oversee implementation, monitoring, and review to ensure objectives are met within timelines.



**Policies, Processes \& Procedures** 



* Oversee enhancements and updates to policies, systems, and procedures in line with best practices and relevant regulations.
* Review and approve policy updates and ensure annual review and alignment with organizational and regulatory changes.



**Financial Accounting** 



* Oversee financial accounting policies and ensure compliance with IFRS, local GAAP, and statutory requirements.
* Supervise financial closing processes and review management reports and statements.
* Ensure accurate and timely financial insights and reports are provided to support executive and board decision\-making.
* Coordinate with external and internal auditors to address audit findings and finalize audited statements.
* Provide guidance on complex financial matters across departments and ensure consistency in accounting policies.



**Financial Planning, Budgeting \& Control** 



* Lead the development of financial planning frameworks aligned with organizational initiatives.
* Design effective financial control systems ensuring operational efficiency and adherence to budgets.
* Lead the development of the annual master budget, consolidate directorate inputs, and present the finalized version to executive leadership and the board.
* Monitor budget performance, review variances, and implement corrective actions when required.



**Investment \& Treasury** 



* Assist in identifying diversified funding and investment opportunities to ensure long\-term sustainability.
* Propose annual investment plans and oversee portfolio management across various asset classes.
* Evaluate investment performance, risk exposure, and ensure proper asset allocation.
* Manage liquidity and treasury operations to ensure cash flow adequacy and financial stability.
* Maintain relationships with financial institutions, investment managers, and funding partners.



**Shareholder Contributions Management** 



* Maintain relationships with shareholder entities to ensure efficient contribution collection.
* Oversee contribution cycles, ensure timely collections, and assess their impact on financial stability.



**Procurement Management** 



* Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee procurement processes including RFPs, vendor selection, and contract management.
* Ensure transparency, compliance, and alignment between procurement plans and overall organizational strategy.



**Continuous Improvement** 



* Stay updated with evolving financial, investment, and procurement best practices.
* Encourage innovation and continuous improvement across systems and processes.
* Promote employee development and identify professional training opportunities.



**People Management** 



* Provide guidance and feedback to subordinates, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
* Oversee workforce planning, KPI development, and performance evaluations.
* Recommend promotions, rewards, and adjustments based on performance outcomes.



**Documentation \& Reporting** 



* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant reporting as per organizational policies and standards.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.



**Health, Safety \& Environment** 



* Support contingency planning and ensure compliance with safety and sustainability measures.
* Maintain adherence to all relevant health, safety, and environmental policies and controls.



  





**Job Requirements** 



* Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Investment (equivalency required where applicable).
* Professional certifications such as CIC, CA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent.
* Minimum 12–14 years of experience within finance and investment
* Minimum 5–6 years in a senior leadership role
* Preference will be given to Kuwaiti nationals in line with local employment regulations.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring that Country’s Corporate Bank Business is optimally managed with the appropriate levels of co\-ordination between the constituent parts of the unit. This includes ensuring that, revenue potential is realized in a cost effective, low risk manner. The target client portfolio is developed in line with QNB’s stated strategic intent and, maximum revenue potential of relationship officers is realized via effective coaching, training and communication.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective departmental/ unit heads and monitor exercise of the same
* Implement the bank’s approved strategy / plan to facilitate achievement of related short and long term business goals in the most effective and efficient manner.
* Oversee the development and subsequent implementation of annual plans by the individual departments / functions comprising Corporate Banking to ensure achievement of pre\-set targets / objectives, including but not limited to business growth and expansion.
* Approve / amend Key Performance Indicators for the purpose of performance monitoring and quality measurement of the Corporate Banking Division and systematic monitoring of their achievements in terms of assets and liabilities.
* Manage the development and subsequent implementation of market best practices across all activities / operations comprising the Corporate and Institution Banking Department to promote efficiencies in work processes, ultimately resulting in increased customer satisfaction.
* Review / analyse the Corporate and Institution Banking Department management accounts (comprising the balance sheet, income statement along with the budgeted figures) on a monthly basis and positively address adverse variances noted with the respective departmental / function heads.
* Observes and promotes cost consciousness and efficiency, and enhance productivity, to minimize costs, avoid wastes, and optimize benefits for the bank
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Ensure the provision of value added corporate products and services to existing / potential corporate banking customers who seek banking relationships with the bank.
* Endeavour to enhance, maintain and deepen relationships with existing corporate customer base, as well as building new relationships. Ensure, by monitoring the performance of the country FI / GSF / GTB resource, that the FI customer base is developed in accordance with approved country/regional strategy for FI’s / GTB and GSF.
* Oversee the implementation and constant enhancement of the overall customer service culture within Corporate Banking team.
* Approve Service Level Agreements with other branch divisions/ departments/ units to achieve improvements in turnaround time, which will also help increase external customer satisfaction.
* Maintain and enhance relationships with Central Bank / other regulators and professional firms as appropriate. Ensure the promotion of QNB’s footprint and product and service offering through professional and other relevant forums.
* Support the local development of GAM accounts where appropriate.
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/ units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong and effective relationship with all other related departments and units to achieve the Group’s goals/objectives.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external and internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk Functions as and when required.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Responsible for establishing and maintaining sound internal control environments across Corporate Banking team.
* Ensure that the approved strategy, business plans, budgets along with the approved policies / procedures and subsequent amendments thereto are timely communicated to the respective departmental heads to the extent these relate to their areas of responsibility, to enable them to be guided by / pursue or comply with the same.
* Strive to maintain continuous compliance of the policies / procedures with prevailing practices / regulations pertaining to Corporate Banking promulgated by the respective regulators (viz. Central Bank as well as other regulators in jurisdiction).
* Resolve / address resource issues (includes labor and systems) faced by the respective departments / functions either directly or through timely coordination with other Group divisions / departments to enable them to meet their assigned targets.
* Oversee the rollout of innovative corporate banking products by the respective heads of departments / functions and monitor their performance.
* Manage, control, monitor and assume responsibility for the Corporate Banking risk profile and portfolio quality in line with the expectations of Credit Committee / Executive Committee.
* Monitor / review the Corporate Banking portfolio by segment on overall basis and by product, corporate profile, country, industry and other parameters on periodic basis to evaluate the quality and performance of the same. Ensure customer revenues accord with business and return criteria.
* Lead the development of ‘early warning systems’ that highlight possible risk deterioration in the corporate credit portfolio, in order to allow for timely corrective action. Also, monitor critical portfolio caps at required intervals and take prompt action in coordination with Credit Risk when required to uphold the quality of the portfolio.
* Responsible for overseeing the overall action plans for addressing control weaknesses or compliance issues noted by Internal Audit Department, external auditors or the Compliance function.
* Coordinate Corporate Banking marketing initiatives with other line department /groups to maximize cross\-selling and advisory services opportunities for the benefit of the client and the Group as a whole.
* Continuous Improvement:
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognize the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Hold meetings with staff and assess their performance as well as the function’s overall performance on a regular basis.
* Manage all administrative operational aspects of division personnel (e.g. leave schedule, training, appraisal, remuneration etc.) in accordance with established HR policies and procedures.
* Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved staff grievances or conflicts within the team.
* Possess a superior knowledge of the corporate banking business, its products and related risks together with a good knowledge of operations and control.
* Identify areas for professional development of self and other staff.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Anti\-Bribery and Corruption, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other:
* Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.
* All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.
* All other ad hoc duties and/or activities related to QNB that management may request of the employee from time to time


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* University graduate preferably with a Major in Finance, Banking, Economics or Business Administration (related field of study), Masters preferred
* At least 15 years of relevant banking experience, preferably with at least 5 years at a senior managerial position in corporate banking within a highly rated international bank.
* Well\-informed of the market competitive structure, industry practices and regulations for the corporate banking segment preferably with at least 5 years’ experience in the local/ regional environment and preferably 3 years international banking experience.


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of your Passport
* Copy of Education Certificate

**About the Role** 









 The
 **Service Operations Manager** 
 is based in Oman and is responsible for leading and driving the overall service operations performance across the country. The role focuses on delivering operational excellence, achieving revenue and profitability targets, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction across all service segments, including maintenance, repairs, spare parts, and retrofit projects.
 



  





 This position plays a critical role in managing service delivery through internal teams and Authorized Service Providers (ASPs), optimizing resources, and strengthening operational processes. The role also supports business growth by closely aligning with service sales, enhancing customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with company standards, local regulations, and ISO management systems.
 



  





**How You Will Make an Impact** 




  




* Report directly to the Service Director and take full responsibility for Service Operations across Oman.
* Drive revenue growth and profitability by ensuring operational excellence, cost control, and efficient execution of service activities.
* Lead, develop, and coach the operations team to achieve business targets, including revenue, margin, collections, and cost management.
* Conduct regular operational reviews, including bids, quotations, contracts, and estimates to ensure accuracy and competitiveness.
* Establish and enforce operational discipline through standardized tools, processes, and performance management.
* Act as a key member of the DAOM leadership team, providing regular performance updates and strategic inputs.
* Monitor, analyze, and improve the performance of operations teams, ASPs, contractors, and third\-party manpower.
* Ensure timely execution and invoicing of service jobs to meet monthly revenue recognition targets.
* Drive key service KPIs such as response time, first\-time fix rate, and customer satisfaction.
* Support service sales by generating leads for AMC, OMC, T\&M, spare parts, and replacement opportunities.
* Plan and manage operational budgets, manpower, and resources to support current operations and future growth.
* Develop and strengthen the ASP network, ensuring proper contracts, performance tracking, and payment structures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, contractors, dealers, and service partners.
* Handle and resolve escalated service issues, ensuring timely closure and high customer satisfaction.
* Communicate regularly with DAOM management and regional teams on service performance, profitability, and improvements.
* Oversee performance management and development of the service operations team.
* Monitor job progress and ensure timely closure of pending service activities.
* Coordinate closely with spare parts teams to ensure availability of materials and minimize service delays.
* Oversee spare parts operations, including planning and inventory management for internal and external customers.
* Ensure full compliance with local regulations, company policies, and ethical standards.
* Drive implementation and maintenance of ISO standards (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001\) within the department.
* Lead recruitment, development, and retention of operational staff.
* Ensure full compliance with EHS requirements for employees, ASPs, and subcontractors.








**What You Need to Succeed** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical / Electrical or equivalent).
* Minimum 10 years of experience in HVAC service operations, with at least 3 \- 5 years in a managerial role.
* Proven track record of successfully managing HVAC service operations within Oman or GCC markets.
* Strong technical expertise in VRV/DX systems, chillers, controls, and airside products.
* Extensive experience managing technicians, engineers, contractors, and service providers.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including contracts, pricing, margins, and cash flow management.
* Experience in spare parts operations, inventory planning, and service logistics.
* Familiarity with ISO standards (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001\) and operational best practices.
* Strong leadership, team management, and coaching capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to drive performance improvements.
* Customer\-focused with a strong commitment to service excellence.
* Proficiency in English (written and spoken); Arabic is an advantage.
* Experience in multinational HVAC organizations.

**Role: On\-Site Delivery Manager (SSK \& SBD Project)** 




**Location:** 
 Muscat International Airport (with support to Salalah rollout)
 



**Duration:** 
 6 Months
 



  





**1\. Objective** 




 The On\-Site Delivery Manager will be responsible for end\-to\-end coordination and execution of the Self\-Service Check\-in Kiosk (SSK) and Self Baggage Drop (SBD) implementation at airport level, ensuring timely delivery, integration, testing, and go\-live in line with the project schedule.
 



  





**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




**A. On\-Site Project Coordination** 



* Act as the single point of contact on\-site between Oman Air, vendor(s), airport authorities, and third parties.
* Coordinate daily activities across all workstreams: kiosks, SBD, BHS, network, power, and civil works.
* Ensure alignment between design, delivery, and installation activities.



**B. Installation \& Site Readiness** 



* Ensure site readiness (power, data, space, civil works) before equipment arrival.
* Coordinate installation activities for kiosks and SBD units at MCT and SLL.
* Monitor compliance with approved layouts and technical specifications.



**C. Vendor \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Manage Elenium and other vendors on\-site.
* Coordinate with:
* Airport operator (MCT/SLL)
* BHS provider
* IT/network teams
* Security and access control teams
* Escalate delays, risks, and blockers proactively.



**D. Integration Oversight** 



* Coordinate SSK application integration with
 **Sabre DCS** 
 , ensuring readiness of:
* Check\-in flows (passenger retrieval, seat selection, boarding pass issuance)
* Baggage tagging and linkage with SBD
* Ancillary services (if applicable)
* Validate that required
 **interfaces, connectivity, and credentials** 
 are available and tested on\-site.
* Ensure alignment between
 **Voyager application, kiosk hardware, and Sabre DCS** 
 during testing phases.
* Support troubleshooting of
 **real\-time transaction issues** 
 during SIT/UAT and go\-live.
* Coordinate integration activities with:
* BHS/BRS systems
* Sabre (via central team)
* Network and infrastructure
* Ensure all dependencies are met before testing phases.



**E. Testing \& Acceptance** 



* Support and coordinate:
* End\-to\-end
 **check\-in and baggage drop scenarios**
* Sabre DCS transaction validation (PNR retrieval, check\-in, tag issuance)
* Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) readiness (logistics side)
* Site Acceptance Testing (SAT)
* Combined UAT (Kiosk \+ SBD \+ Voyager \+ BHS)
* Confirm readiness for
 **airline operational acceptance** 
 before go\-live.



**F. Go\-Live \& Hypercare** 



* Lead on\-site readiness for go\-live at:
* MCT (target: 7 Dec 2026\)
* SLL (target: 14 Dec 2026\)
* Coordinate operational teams during go\-live.
* Support hypercare period and issue resolution.



**G. Reporting \& Governance** 



* Maintain daily/weekly status reporting:
* Progress vs plan
* Risks and issues
* Dependencies
* Maintain site tracker covering:
* Installation progress
* Equipment delivery
* Testing status
* Provide clear escalation to project steering team.



  





**3\. Key Deliverables** 



* Site readiness validation reports
* Installation progress tracker (daily/weekly)
* Risk \& issue log with mitigation actions
* Testing coordination plan (SAT/UAT)
* Go\-live readiness checklist
* Daily updates during critical phases (installation \& go\-live)



  





**4\. Timeline Coverage (6 Months Focus)** 




 The role will primarily cover:
 


* Equipment delivery \& logistics
* Site readiness and installation (MCT \& SLL)
* BHS integration coordination
* Testing phases (FAT follow\-up, SAT, UAT)
* Go\-live and stabilization



  





**5\. Success Criteria** 



* On\-time go\-live delivery (MCT \& SLL)
* No major delays due to site readiness or coordination gaps
* Smooth integration with BHS and infrastructure
* Successful UAT sign\-off without critical defects
* Controlled and stable go\-live with minimal operational disruption



  





**6\. Required Profile** 



* 8\+ years of experience in on\-site project delivery, preferably in airport or similar operational environments
* Proven experience with kiosk, SBD, or passenger processing systems
* Good understanding of check\-in flows and airline operations
* Experience coordinating multiple vendors on\-site
* Exposure to DCS integration (preferably Sabre) and ability to support testing and troubleshooting
* Familiarity with BHS/baggage systems and airport infrastructure
* Hands\-on, proactive, and able to manage issues on\-site in real time
* Experience in testing (UAT) and go\-live support


- 


**7\. Reporting Line** 



* Reports to: Project Manager / Digital \& Airport Systems Lead
* Works closely with: IT, Ground Operations, Airport Authority, Vendor teams



  





**8\. Notes** 



* Role is execution\-focused (not design or strategy).
* Must be physically present on\-site during installation, testing, and go\-live phases.
* Flexibility required for extended hours during critical milestones.

**Job title:** 
 Manager, Geoscience
 



**Stream:** 
 Commercial
 



**Function:** 
 Investment Valuations \& Strategy

 Head Investment Integrated Valuations \& Strategy
 



**Direct reports: 3** 




**Job purpose** 




  





 Lead and integrate all Geoscience (Geology, Geophysics, and Petrophysics) activities under the Commercial structure to maximize subsurface value, mature hydrocarbon resources, reduce geological uncertainty, and support economically sound investment decisions. The role ensures delivery of high\-quality subsurface interpretations, volumetric assessments, prospect maturation, and reservoir characterization to enable exploration success, field development optimization, reserves growth, and commercial negotiations.
 



  





 The position will act in accordance with the OQEP’s Mission, Vision, Values \& Strategies, as well as, policies, guidelines, and international standards, supported by an IT Technology platform, QHSE \& Energy Management System requirements standards, Omani’s government \& other legal justifications, and best international practices in consonance with national objectives.
 



**Main tasks and responsibilities:** 




  





**Strategic \& Commercial Alignment** 



* Align G\&G strategies with corporate growth objectives, portfolio strategy, and commercial targets.
* Translate subsurface insights into value\-driven business cases and investment proposals.
* Support farm\-in/farm\-out evaluations, asset acquisitions, and divestments.
* Contribute to reserves booking strategy and certification processes.



  





**Exploration \& Prospect Maturation** 



* Oversee basin analysis, play fairway evaluation, and prospect generation.
* Ensure robust risking, volumetrics, and uncertainty analysis for exploration opportunities.
* Approve prospect maturation workflows prior to drill\-ready status.
* Present subsurface evaluations to management and investment committees.



  





**Reservoir Characterization \& Development Support** 



* Integrate seismic, geological, petrophysical, and well data into coherent reservoir models.
* Guide static model construction and ensure subsurface integrity for FDPs (Field Development Plans).
* Support well planning, placement, and post\-well evaluation.
* Drive uncertainty reduction strategies to improve recovery factors and reserves classification.



  





**Technical Governance \& Quality Assurance** 



* Establish G\&G technical standards, workflows, and best practices.
* Ensure independent technical assurance and peer reviews.
* Validate subsurface risks prior to major capital commitments.
* Maintain compliance with international reporting standards (e.g., SPE\-PRMS).



  





**Data \& Digital Integration** 



* Oversee subsurface data management, seismic reprocessing strategies, and petrophysical database integrity.
* Promote digital subsurface solutions, AI\-based interpretation, and integrated modeling technologies.
* Ensure effective knowledge management and lessons learned capture.



  





**Leadership \& Capability Development** 



* Lead and develop Principal\-level technical experts.
* Foster a high\-performance, collaborative subsurface culture.
* Build succession planning and technical competency frameworks.
* Act as senior technical authority in G\&G matters.



  





**Stakeholder \& External Engagement** 



* Represent the company in JV technical committees and regulator discussions.
* Support commercial negotiations with technical subsurface insights.
* Coordinate with Drilling, Reservoir Engineering, Production, and HSSE functions.



  





**Key interactions:** 




**Internal:** 
 Operations team, Exploration team, Subsurface, support functions.
 



**External:** 
 Partners, OQEP JVs, consultancy firms, Government related entities
 



**Notable Working Conditions.** 
 Office environment, intensive computer screen use, sporadic visits to operation site.
 



**Education requirements:** 




 BS Degree in Geology, relevant science subject or equivalent. MSc degree desirable
 



**Language requirements:** 




 Excellent knowledge of written, read, and spoken English (required) Arabic \- Native (desirable)
 



**Background and experience** 




  





 • 8\+ years of relevant experience in similar role with an operator, preferably with experience in Exploration or New Ventures with various subsurface fields experience and different environments.
 


* Broad geoscience knowledge, with experience in both geophysics , geology and petrophysics.
* Experienced with both exploration and development upstream oil and gas activities including Design and Execution of FDPs.
* Experience in M\&A/International assets with VDRs and Deals Delivery is prioritized including knowledge of transactional processes and technical interface with commercial workflows.
* Managing G\&G studies and activities, as well as leading the FDPs process.
* Relevant software experience, Landmark, Petrel and ArcGIS is preferred.
* Demonstrated strong experience in the following fields:
* Well operations planning and execution
* Field appraisal and development planning
* Petrophysical evaluation and Reservoir characterization
* Prospect generation, evaluation and proposal
* Exposure to regional and new venture evaluations
* 3D Geological modelling skills, preferably in Petrel Software
* Mastery level expert user of geological interpretations systems
* Ability to work in a multi\-disciplinary team environment
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written) with proficiency in written and spoken English
* Preferably, an exposure of working in different local Oman/GCC geological settings clastics, carbonates, passive margins, thrust belts etc.
* Track record of deadline delivery and result oriented with ability to prioritize and deliver

**Competencies and skills:** 




**Soft:** 



* People and Leadership skills
* Leading multidisciplinary integrated teams and contribution to exploration opportunity risking and ranking.

**Technical:** 



* Computer literacy including MS Office
* Technical Leadership \& reviews
* Audits and preparation of Field Development Plans
* Self\-starter with the ability to multi task while maintaining priorities
* Project Management skills
* Possess organizational skills
* Geophysics , Petrophysics \& Geology
* Knowledgeable in geophysical, petrophysical and geological analysis integration
* Petrel \& Techlog software
